rows.Name: Lord of Deceit
rows.Description: Hail! I trust you are well? I have a mission for you should you be [interested].
rows.TargetName: Captain Rhodri;1|Overseer Tepok;24|Captain Rhodri;1|Twr ap Alsig;1|Captain Rhodri;1|Delfina;1|Twr ap Alsig;1|Captain Rhodri;1
rows.SourceText: Seek out Captain Rhodri at the Snowdonia border keep. (whisper: assist us)|||||||
rows.TargetText: I had not expected you to arrive so soon. Give me a moment to gather my thoughts. It is good to see you in excellent health. Sir Bors will be most pleased it is you who answered his call for help. We are in need of your skill and the insight you have into the locals of Barfog. As I indicated in your message, you will be rewarded well for your efforts. Are you still willing to [assist us]? This is good! I am relieved this matter will be resolved quickly in your hands. I shall not waste any more of your time than is necessary. As you are aware, the Twp ap Alsig believe it is the dwarves who have been assisting Tepok with funds and supplies. I truly doubt that dwarves would stomach working with such creatures. Yet, we cannot turn a blind eye to our newest of allies and the mine has proven a burden for too long. Therefore Sir Bors has decided that you must descend into Tepok mines, locate and slay Tepok himself. I am sure this deed should pose no problems for one of your skill. It is said Tepok carries with him a sack containing all this precious items. Return this to us as it may contain clues to location these dwarves. Best of luck to thee. Ah! Were you able to retrieve Tepok's precious bag? Give him the bag. This is what we have been looking for! [Twr ap Alsig] has been deceived. I knew the dwarves have nothing to do with this plot. This dispatch proves as much! The person who write this speaks of supplies. Supplies that originated within Pennine and from a group that makes their home there. While I do not fully rule out the dwarves, we would be wise to turn our attention north and into the mountains. Were you able to deliver the dispatch to Twr ap Alsig? Very well then! We can now move forward with our plans. While you were away Sir Bors instructed his scouts to scour the borderlands. What they found was quite alarming. It seems the goblins had tunnelled under the pass wall and were using this passage as a means to receive supplies from the north. Before we were able to follow the goblins to the source of their supplies our [scouts were spotted] and the tunnel destroyed. Aye! We are unsure if there are other such passages but if there are, we shall find them. We still need to search Pennine and locate the source of these supplies! Unfortunately we cannot afford to use any of our own scouts. I have been asked to task you with this delicate mission. We can no longer limit our source of information to observation alone. Someone must [venture into the camps] of each race within the Pennine and return solid reports. Not to worry Cabalist! We will not send you into these camps blindly. We have been observing the inhabitants of Pennine for quite some time. Are you still [willing to assist] us in this matter? Then let us begin! Your first task will be to infiltrate a camp of Tylwyth Teg elves. There is one among them named Delfina. She carries the reports of their people to and from the Tylwyth Teg homelands. Our time is short Cabalist. Do not toy with the targets! Simply locate this Delfina, slay her, and return her reports. I await your return. May your blade be swift and quite! Once again your swiftness is most impressive! Do you have Delfina's reports? This done not bode well. I didn't review the documents in depth, but I don't see any mention of goblins here. Our scribes will have to go over them more closely. You have done well Cabalist! We will require your assistance once we have had more time to review Delfina's reports. Return to me later and perhaps I will have news. Good day to you!||I had not expected you to arrive so soon. Give me a moment to gather my thoughts. It is good to see you in excellent health. rows.SourceText: Slay Sir Dillus and his renegade officers.|||
rows.TargetText: |Yes Inconnu? What do you want? Support you say? Why should we? Your kind has forever forgotten its way. The light of that Camelot has blinded you. We know you have killed him! You have not won us with that! Do you have proof of anything that may keep us from killing you on the spot? Heavens! How can this be? I scarcely believe my eyes! I truly wish I could take your word on just this, yet I must be [certain] where your loyalties lay. There roams about this land the undead cythraul. Should you destroy one of these and bring back its skull as proof, I will lend the support you seek." (Also has been known to send someone to go kill a Bwgan Hunter.) [Step#3] Slay a cyhraul within Llyn Barfog! (Cythraul can be found around loc=51921, 44182 also can be found at loc=36350, 53887) [Step#4] Speak to Twr ap Alsig at the local outpost in Llyn Barfog. I still seek proof of your deeds. Do you have something for me? You have done well Inconnu! We shall support your cause and welcome you always. Please take this as a token of trust between our people.||Yes Inconnu? What do you want? Support you say? Why should we? Your kind has forever forgotten its way. rows.Name: Regal Nobility
rows.Description: Ah <Player>! You have returned and just in time as well. We have prepared our case and are prepared to leavel for Camelot. We wish your journey to Camelot and inform our Scribe Veral of our wish to lend support to Barfog. Take this as proof of our [intentions]. We will be along shortly.
rows.SourceText: <Player>! You have done us the greatest of services! These Arawnites have caused us nothing but trouble since you dispatched Sir Dillus. Sir Bors can offer nothing that would fully repay the debt you have fashioned this day. Let this (reward) be the start of what little we have to offer. In time we shall find greater reward for your deeds and when that time comes, we shall once again call upon (prof name) and thier most cunning (class name)!||
rows.TargetText: Hail traveler! How may I be of service to you? You are from Sir Bors? How can it be you have not see* the [local report] yet? Yes! There is news that Bors is a target for assassination. The report does not specify who will attempt the deed, only that it will be attempted soon. I will take your case before King Constantine, but you must return with haste, and assist in thwarting this treachery!||
rows.StepText: Take the documents to Scribe Veral in Camelot.|Search the Snowdonia border keep for the assassin and slay him.|Speak to Captain Rhodri.

rows.Name: Symbol of the Broken
rows.Description: I have requested The Academy send someone who would be able to help. I am far to weak to travel and fear my powers would fail in battle. You don't need to assist this old man, but if you will [take up the cause] to defend this realm from Morgana's evil ways then your help would be welcome.
rows.SourceText: Your choice is a wise one! I will not waste anymore time with banter. There is a rumor of an Arawnite shaman by the name of Saelonna who has seen into the future. The rumors say the shaman has been driven insane by her visions. It is my hope that Saelonna has seen Morgana's evil and perhaps inscribed it in her [Book of Arawn].||||
rows.TargetText: |||Interesting, I have never heard of that name. I will attempt to determine what use this wood may have. One moment please! Quite interesting indeed! This wood has only been used for one purpose, to build a necromantic altar! This is very bad. If this altar exists, it could be used to summon up demons from places best not spoken about. I assume The Academy has sent you on this mission? It may be wise to inform them of this evil wood and the power it commands!|
rows.StepText: Seek out the Arawnite shaman Saelonna and retrieve her Book of Arawn.|Return the Book of Arawn to Master Ferowl in Cotswold.|Find Treefall in the southern Pennine Mountains and retrieve his remains.|Deliver the bark to Caelin Finan at Castle Sauvage.|Inform the Academy of Morgana's interest in raising up demons. (whisper: raising up demons)
rows.FinishText: Seek out this Saelonna within the borders of Snowdonia and retrieve this book at whatever the cost. Return to me when you have completed this task. May your travel be swift and uneventful!

rows.Name: The Lost Stone
rows.Description: Welcome back. I have been watching your training and you seem to be blessed with many skills. Those skills will come in handy in the near future. I have been sending reports of your progress to my superiors at the Defenders hall in Camelot and they have decided that it is time to [test your limits and skills].
rows.SourceText: Seek out Gavon Montgomery at Caifelle. (whisper: <your name>)|||
rows.TargetText: Greetings Friar. I see that your trainer received the message fromt he Defenders. What is your name? We have quite a task ahead of us. I was once a Scout for the Defenders of Albion before I hurt my leg. Since I can no longer do my duty, the Defenders have helped set me up s as merchant. It's not what I had planned to be doing , but it puts food on my table. Even though I am not an active member of the Defenders, I still do what I can to help. Lately that has meant [tracking down lost objects]. As you may know, the Defenders of Albion are always searching for better ways to defend the realm from enemies. Our duty is hard, for these days we face not onlythe enemies that nip at our borders but also the ones that exist amongst us. Anything that can be done or used to make our fight a little easier is always well supported among the Defenders. That is [why I was sent] here. One of the Inconnu that has been helping us to defend the realm against the Drakoran located and recovered a stone that seems to weaken the Drakoran. Our Theurgists back in Camelot wish to examine and study this stone so that it can possibly be duplicated and used to aid us in this fight. If we [only had it now]! This Inconnu was coming back from getting the stone when he was attacked and overpowered by a pack of urchin rabblerousers. They stole the stone and ran off into the wilds when the Inconnu mandaged to crawl back here. So far no one has been able to capture the little rabblerouser that has it. Go now and seek out the urchin rabblerouser that has it. They are tricky and throw it around, so keep trying until you find it. We are counting on you. Were you able to find the stone? The Defenders in Albion are waiting for it so they can begin trying to duplicate it. I must send it to them soon. This isn't the stone I seek! I was told it was plain, flat, gray stone. It may have special properties, but the Defenders will have to investigate it. Did you find another stone? This stone doesn't look like it will do much, but we hope that it will. I shall get this over to Camelot right away. The Defenders of Albion sent this over for the person who was able to recover the lost stone. Here take it, and know that you have helped to defend the realm!|||Greetings Friar. I see that your trainer received the message fromt he Defenders. What is your name? rows.Description: Welcome young one! It is good that you have decided to join the forces of Albion as this is a dark time for its people. Our borders are in need of [adventurers] such as you.

rows.TargetText: You have been chosen to assist me in delivering [a message]. I'm sure it will be worth your time. Yes! There is a guardian by the name of Aron. Hurry to him!|

rows.Name: Cellar Infestation
rows.Description: You have barely begun training; yet already there is a need for you to lend your strength for the protection of this town. I know some of the locals are suspicious of the Inconnu, well, that is not to be helped. They are a mysterious people, and their sudden appearance one stormy night, well, that causes a large amount of [suspicion], as you can imagine, They are here to help us, I do believe that, and so must you. But some of the locals, they are not so sure.
rows.SourceText: Right, I expected you would do so. Now, go talk to Ylaine Barrett.||
rows.TargetText: Ah. G'day. And who might you be? I see, you're a fighter. Has Mistress Laws, Master Reginald, or Delore sent you here to help me out? Why don't they just send you out after the goo? That's all I really want. You know, I don't remember that there were that many of these strange creatures crawling around the village [before]. Yes, well, before, well, before they came. Don't you remember? That night? All day long, everything's fine. Set itself uop for a fine next day, as well! The night, it was clear. Not a sign of a storm in sight! Why, no one prepared for it! Then, in the darkest part, suddenly, the storm starts! We were woken from the noise of it! It was awful, but we didn't dare go outside! Some of the men, they did, but they came back pale as a corpse! Were shaken to their core! And some of these being the fightin' men! Best of the town! Aye, but the [swamp goo]. They've gotten into the food cellar! The slimy things were creeping all over that place! I've gotten rid of most of the swamp goo, but I know there's more just outside town working their way to my food stores. I think you could do a small favor for us all and get rid of some. Oh and while you are at it, the skin of the swamp goo, I've some uses for it. I'll pay you for a swamp goo skin. Just go and get me one of their skins, and I'll be satisfied with ya. Oh, you're back! Did you see how many there were? They are a nuisance, aren't they! Well, have you got me the skin? Ah, a good and slimy one! It's odd, these creatures, they've got some strangeness about them, but they've got their uses, as well. Thank you, then. Here, I promised I'd pay ya, and I will!||Ah. rows.Name: Inconnu Poison
rows.Description: I'm here to train you, to prepare you as best I can, for the day when you will choose your future path, as a necromancer or reaver, to do Arawn;s bidding, and [defeat Morgana].
rows.SourceText: Go speak to Trynt Madoc. He'll tell you what needs to be done.||||
rows.TargetText: Greetings young Disciple. What be thy name? Well, <Player>, I see that Magess Gwenllian has been doing her part to help improve the relations around her. You may not have noticed, but many people around here do not like Inconnu. I am not one of those people, but there is a man, a poison merchant just came to this land, Burton MacDougal, who believes that every last Inconnu us out to steal his soul. I have told him that I can [prove differently]. I told Burton that the Inconnu brought a poison with them that is very effective against Drakoran. He said he would believe that there Inconnu are here to help if he could get a sample of the poison and the list of components to make it himself. Lirele, an Inconnu who is working with us, has agreed to help but she needs [a certain component] to finish the poison. Lirele told me she needed the fin (of) a sea pup to complete the poison. They live in the waters around Gothwaite Harbor. Get one and take it to Lirele. [Step #2] Get the fin of a sea pup from the waters outside Gothwaite Harbor. Sea pups are located just to the end of town near the water's edge. Get a fin and take it to Lirele.||Thank you. This should only take a minute. Here, take the poison and this scroll to Burton MacDougal. Tell him it is from Lirele the Inconnu.|What do you want? I don't like your kind, so state your business quickly and get gone! Oh, you're from Lirele, eh? That doesn't change anything. That nasty Trynt told me the pale witch would be getting me some poison, but I haven't seen it yet. Did she send you over here with it? Let me have it. Hrmph, haven't seen something like this before. but this won't last me very long. Trynt said she'd tell me how to make it. I see the wench hasn't lived up to that promise. You just can't trust you Inconnu! Oh, hrmph, well, um, this is how to make it. Um, well, I guess that wench, er, Lirele, wasn't lying to me after all. Maybe she's not so bad after all, or you either, but I still don't trust the rest of 'em! Well, here, since you did some work, you can have this. But t his doesn't mean that I like you! Now, buy some poison or get out of here!|What do you want? I don't like your kind, so state your business quickly and get gone! Oh, you're from Lirele, eh? That doesn't change anything. That nasty Trynt told me the pale witch would be getting me some poison, but I haven't seen it yet. Did she send you over here with it? Let me have it. Maybe she's not so bad after all, or you either, but I still don't trust the rest of 'em! Well, here, since you did some work, you can have this. But t his doesn't mean that I like you! Now, buy some poison or get out of here!
rows.StepText: Speak with Trynt Madoc in the gazebo in Gothwaite Harbor.|Get the fin of a sea pup from the waters outside Gothwaite Harbor.|Take the sea pup fin to Lirele in Gothwaite Harbor.|Go to Burton MacDougal, the poison merchant, and give him the poison prepared by Lirele.|Give Lirele's scroll to Burton MacDougal.

rows.Name: Commencement
rows.Description: You have learned much. It would behoove you to venture further than you already have. Yet the roads are dangerous these days and to survive you will require [companions].
rows.SourceText: Seek out our local crier and he shall instruct your further.||
rows.TargetText: Hail! I am told you require instruction. Tis and easy [task] to learn. Seek out a fellow member of this realm. Fashion between you a group and return to me. I will instruct you further then.||Hail! I am told you require instruction. Tis and easy [task] to learn. Seek out a fellow member of this realm. Fashion between you a group and return to me. I will instruct you further then.
rows.StepText: Seek out Barnarn the crier in Humberton.|Form a group with a fellow member of this realm.|Return to Barnarn the crier while grouped.

rows.Name: Flint Weapons
rows.Description: Greetings, I'm the master of stonemason hereabouts. You look in need of a decent [weapon]. Perhaps I can help you in that regard, though it may put you in a bit of danger.
rows.SourceText: Bring a chert to the stonemason and he will make you a weapon.
rows.StepText: Bring a chert to the stonemason and he will make you a weapon.

rows.Name: Lost Potion
rows.Description: Trynt Madoc has said you did well. Now, he'd like you to help out again. It seems Sister Genette Ashlan has some problems with the Inconnu in general. It makes sense, as she is of the Church of Albion. We have always been rivals with the one god of that church. They are not known for their tolerance. But, Trynt Madoc believes it is important to have her stop [speaking out] against us in the town.
rows.TargetName: Sister Genette Ashlan;51|damp skeleton;51|damp skeleton;51|Lirele;51|Sister Genette Ashlan;51
rows.SourceText: Right then. Speak to Genette. Tell her Tryby sent you.||||
rows.TargetText: What do you want? I make no secret that I dislike your kind. If you have some business with me, speak up, otherwise go away! Trynt, eh? He's a troublemaker, trying to make people think you Inconnu are worth having around. He wasn't here when [the storm hit]! Aye, the storm that brought the likes of you to these shores. It has been a beautiful day that day. The evening started out beautiful too, clear and calm. A group of soldiers had left as the sun was just dipping below the horizon to go on patrol. With not a cloud in the sky, the group didn't take torches but relied upon the light of the stars to guide them. Out in the middle of nowhere, a group of those nasty Drakorans ambushed a group of soldiers. There was a violent fight with many dead on both sides. A few of the soldiers survived and managed to crawl back towards Caer Gothwaite. When they were spotted, the watchers [sent for me]. I gathered my things and hurried outside to meet those poor men and women. They were seriously hurt, but I thought I could save them. I began to treat using a magical healing potion given to me but another healer. It cleans the wound and makes it heal much faster and also counteracts the evil poison of the Drakorans. As I moved along treating each wound, a breeze began to blow gently. It took a few hours for me to treat each of them. As I reached the last one, the wind began to blow harder. One of my assistants suddenly gasped as dark clouds rolled in, blocking out the light of the stars. As the rain began to fall, [we gathered up] the wounded and hurried into the shelter of the Caer. Before we had even crossed the courtyard the lightning was blinding and the thunder deafening, and we wondered if we would be drown by the rain. In the chaos of the storm and protecting the soldiers, I dropped my healing potion. No one was brave enough to go back out and look for it. I tried to search for it, but the storm was too violent and I could not even make it out the door. I did my best to treat the last soldier, but [without the potion] I could not cure him of the poison and he died. All because of the likes of you! You caused the storm and make that soldier die! That is why I don't like your kind! Trynt said that Inconnu witch Lirele would replace my potion if I told her. The potion requires two bones from damp skeletons. Get them and take them to Lirele if you want to prove the Inconnu are not the evil creatures I believe they are! Oh, so your're back. Did she make my potion? I'm guessing she didn't! Hhmm, this looks like my potion, but I'm going to have to test it out. I cut myself earlier. I shall try it on that cut. Well, apparently that Lirele knows her stuff. This is the same as my potion. When this runs out maybe I'll ask her to make me some more. Egad, did I jsut say that? Ask an Inconnu for something? Well, maybe the Inconnu aren't so bad if they can keep making my potion. Ack, what is wrong with me, saying things like that? Anyway, take this and go away before I say something good about the Inconnu!|||I see you have returned, <Player>. Trynt Madoc said you would. Genette Ashlan needs her potion replaced. Please give me the first damp skeleton bone so I may begin the potion. I have been sent by the great Arawn to help the people of Avalon. I am to assist Trynt Madoc and any others who will help us. I am to retrieve sould and aid in the fight against the Drakoran. All are to help defeat the Drakoran! Thank you, <Player>. Now please give me the second one. Well done. Now the potion is complete. Please take it to Genette Ashlan and give her our most humble apologies for causing the loss of the first potion. rows.StepText: Speak with Sister Genette Ashlan in Caer Gothwaite. Tell her [Trynt sent] you.|Seek out the damp skeletons north-northeast of Caer Gothwaite and get two bones for Lirele. (1/2)|Seek out the damp skeletons north-northeast of Caer Gothwaite and get two bones for Lirele. (2/2)|Give Lirele the two damp skeleton bones in Gothwaite Harbor.|Give Sister Genette Ashlan the potion prepared by Lirele.

rows.Name: Disturbing Illness
rows.Description: Ylaine tells me she hasn't spotted any swamp goo in the cellars since you and some other young adventurers took a part in clearing them out. This is really good to hear. Of course, now we've new [troubles].
rows.TargetName: Sister Genette Ashlan;51|sea pup;51|Sister Genette Ashlan;51|Tage;51|swamp goo;51|Tage;51|Sister Genette Ashlan;51
rows.SourceText: Aye, speak to the healer, Genette, she is treating new illness that seems to be affecting only the Inconnu. She's worked with Dalvay, Arawn's priest, and together they've come up with some sort of cure.||||||
rows.TargetText: <Player>, are you the one that's here to help me? Aye, I've got to treat this illness afflicting the Inconnu. I've not seen anything like it. I've had to talk to that [strange priest]. Aye, I'll not understand the workings of your folk, <Player>, truly I shan't. But he is a strange fellow. Came to me at the oddest times to tell me your folk were getting sick, and needed tending, and about threatened me with Arawn's wrath when I said then Arawn should have thought of tending the Inconnu's illness' himslef before he threw that temple in the middle of our town. Aye, but I'm a healer, and heal I will, but you're a strange folk, and need a different sort of tending. I've got everything I need, but one thing. I need one more [ingredient] to this concoction I'm cooking up. Off the coast, near the water, you can usually see the sea pups out there. The skin of the sea pup has an oily feel to it. I need to scrape off the oils from the skin and boil it. Aye, it's my problem how, I'll manage that. You just go get me the skin. Ah, you've come back. Have you the item? Now then, give it here, and I will begin the prepartations. Great! Alright, now you need to speak to Tage. Dalvay's acolyte. Tell him I'm ready for the next portion of the remedy. Here, take this coin. I don't think he's any concept of payment for work rendered. Ah, you're back. Did that acolyte creep you out, as well? I still shiver just thinking about him and that priest! Well, did he have anything for me? I was told that only a mixture blessed by Arawn would work! The nerve! Thank you, <Player>. I'm sure I'll be able to heal your people, though you know, the blessings of our church should be more than enough. Really, Arawn's blessing is not needed in all things.||<Player>, are you the one that's here to help me? Aye, I've got to treat this illness afflicting the Inconnu. I've not seen anything like it. rows.StepText: Talk to Sister Genette Ashlan, the healer by the bind stone in Caer Gothwaite, about the Inconnu sickness.|Bring Sister Genette the skin of a sea pup from the water west of Caer Gothwaite.|Return to Sister Genette with the skin.|Tell Tage, Dalvay's acolyte at the three stones in Caer Gothwaite, that Sister Genette is ready for the next portion of the remedy.|Bring Tage a swamp goo from the water just down the hill from Caer Gothwaite.|Return the swamp goo to Tage.|Take the pulpy mixture to Sister Genette.

rows.Name: Association
rows.Description: Your service to Albion is notable! I am sure the guilds have taken notice of your [actions] this day!
rows.TargetName: Hunter Ceron;1|Grin the crier;1|Commander Buin;1|Master Torr;1
rows.SourceText: Locate and speak to Hunter Ceron on a ridge just north of Ludlow.|||
rows.StepText: Locate and speak to Hunter Ceron on a ridge just north of Ludlow.|Deliver the note to the crier in front of the tavern in Ludlow.|Deliver the note to Commander Buin at the tower just east of Ludlow.|Return to your trainer.

rows.Name: Nain Hunting
rows.Description: Hunt the Nain [dwarves] on the hill south of the castle and bring back proof.
rows.SourceText: Kill Nain dwarves south of the castle toward the Abbey and bring back proof for a minor reward.
rows.StepText: Kill Nain dwarves south of the castle toward the Abbey and bring back proof for a minor reward.

rows.Name: Rock Imps
rows.Description: Imps on the hill behind me are pushing boulders down on the town! Bring me evidence that you have killed them and you will be [handsomely] rewarded.
rows.SourceText: Kill the rock imps on the ridge due north of Ludlow, west of the road to the bridge, and bring Crep Pew their parts.
rows.StepText: Kill the rock imps on the ridge due north of Ludlow, west of the road to the bridge, and bring Crep Pew their parts.

rows.Name: Soul Hunt
rows.Description: Remember the swamp goo in the cellar? And the sickness that affected the Inconnu only? It seems that there is an undead that has been hiding from Arawn for years, <Player>, with the Inconnu walking the land, he's feeling [threatened].
rows.SourceText: Aye. Speak to Tage, he'll fill you in on the what Arawn has told him.|||
rows.TargetText: <Player>, one of our sould has disguised himself as a damp skeleton amongst the dead Morgana has raised. He thinks to distract us by infesting the town with the swamp goo, and creating an illness for the Inconnu. He must be returned to Arawn, before he does more harm. Everry night that he lives as one of the undead, he gains in power. If he is not returned soon, he will grow strong, and become a great threat to this fortress town. He must be returned. He roams with the rest of the undead. Go, return his essence to me. Have you Jocias' soul, <Player>? Ah. He shall be returned to Arawn. His place is the underworld. He must make retribution to Arawn. I thank you, <Player>. You have done well.|||<Player>, one of our sould has disguised himself as a damp skeleton amongst the dead Morgana has raised. He thinks to distract us by infesting the town with the swamp goo, and creating an illness for the Inconnu. He must be returned to Arawn, before he does more harm. Everry night that he lives as one of the undead, he gains in power. If he is not returned soon, he will grow strong, and become a great threat to this fortress town. He must be returned. He roams with the rest of the undead. Go, return his essence to me. Have you Jocias' soul, <Player>? Ah. He shall be returned to Arawn. His place is the underworld. He must make retribution to Arawn. I thank you, <Player>. You have done well.
rows.StepText: Speak to Tage.|Seek out Jocias among the damp skeletons and retrieve his soul.|Jocias fled into a damp skeleton. Find and retrieve Jocias' soul from the damp skeleton it fled to.|Return the soul to Tage.

rows.Name: Souls of the Dead
rows.Description: There's some group that is trying to have those of the Temple of Awarn leave. They feel as Sister Genette Ashlan did, that the town is better off [falling to the Drakoran] than working with us.
rows.TargetName: Trynt Madoc;51|Tessa Ohrman;51|headless dead;51|headless dead;51|headless dead;51|Lirele;51
rows.SourceText: Speak to Trynt Madoc about the group of people speaking out against the Inconnu.|||||
rows.TargetText: Greetings again. I am so glad you've been able to help improve the relations between some of the people here in Caer Gothwaite and the Inconnu. Sadly, there are still some who speak badly of the Inconnu. They have been going around telling everyone that the Inconnu are the [servants of Morgana]! Yes, I cannot believe it either, for I have seen the Inconnu out on the field of battle, sacrificing themselves in the fight against the Drakoran and Morgana's undead. They won't stop fighting until the last breath has passed through their lips. Yet still people do not believe they are here to help but will [be our downfall]. Now, not everyone believes this, but there is a core group that does. The group's second in command is a woman named Tessa Ohrman. She is always saying the Inconnu are here to stir up the undead, not gather up the souls ripped from their peaceful slumber by Morgana. We need you to prove to Tessa that she is wrong about the Inconnu. If we win Tessa to our side, she will convince the leader, Calder to change his mind. Go to Tessa now, and speak with her. I told her you would be coming to speak with her.|So, you're the one Trynt said he'd send to me. What's your name? Well, I'll be honest with you. I don't like Incommu and I only agreed to speak with you because Trynt wouldn't go away until I did. If you want to know what the cause of all the problems around here is, look no farther than the Inconnu! The got all these undead riled up, [causing trouble] with the people around here. The undead have been attacking people, especially the headless dead. They are the remains of people who have had terrible accidents upon the shores of this land. They never bothered us until the Inconnu came! Everyone said it was Morgana's doing, but I know the truth! If you think you can prove that the Inconnu are not here to cause trouble, [retrieve the souls] of three headless dead. When you have them, take them to that Inconnu Lirele over there. She claims she can send them away, but I don't believe her. You get them, take them to her, and I'll watch to see if she does it or if she turns them loosee on us here in Caer Gothwaite! Now go! I saw you over there with that Inconnu Lirele. I saw what she did with those spirits. She didn't make them come attack me! I thought she would, but she didn't. I'd have to see her do it more, but maybe I was wrong. Yes, even I [can admit] I am wrong! It's not easy, and I don't trust the Inconnu, but I will stop saying that they are here to cause trouble, and I will work on changing Calder's mind too. I don't know if he will listen, but I will try. To show I am not such a bad person as some think, please [sic]take this.||||It is good to see you again. I overheard your conversation with Tessa. She fears us, and together you and I shall show her she has no reason to fear the Inconnu. Please give me the first soul. Good, now the second. Thank you. Now the third please.
rows.StepText: Speak with Trynt Madoc in Gothwaite Harbor about the group of people against the Inconnu.|Go speak with Tessa Ohrman in Gothwaite Harbor.|Get the souls of three headless dead that roam east of Gothwaite Harbor. (1/3)|Get the souls of three headless dead that roam east of Gothwaite Harbor. (2/3)|Get the souls of three headless dead that roam east of Gothwaite Harbor. (3/3)|Turn in the three souls to Lirele in Gothwaite Harbor.

rows.Name: Guild Introduction
rows.Description: You are destined for service as a necromancer in the Temple of Arawn. Speak to Carys to learn about the role of [Necromancers].
rows.SourceText: Good. Speak to Carys to learn about the role of Necromancers.
rows.TargetText: If you are strong enough to handle the power, Lord Arawn will give you control over the dead. You will be able to manipulate the spirits of the dead. This will scare many who do not understand our power, and they will fear and shun you. But you will h ave the power of Lord Arawn at your command. As a disciple, this is your only choice. You are designed by Arawn to be a necromancer.
rows.StepText: Speak to Carys, the Necromancer trainer.

rows.Name: Guild Introduction
rows.Description: Ah, <Player>, soon you must choose which [professioin] to follow. There are a couple of choices, but not all are open to you. I suggest you speak to the trainers that will accept you, before you make your decison.
rows.SourceText: Smart choice! Speak to Lietenant Newster. The professoin of Scout, in the Defenders of Albion, is open to you.|
rows.TargetText: So you wish to learn about life as a Scout, eh? Well, we are part of the Defenders of Albion. Your bow, that should be your main choice for weapons. You do your best work at a distance, as a Scout, and should be the [first line] of offense. Certainly. It is not only here in the Isle of Glass that your skills as a Scout will be sought after. Back in Albion, in the frontier lands, our enemies seek to overtake the realm. It is something you should [consider]. Yes, but don't make any hasty decisions. You should speak to Elaru, with the Guild of Shadows, to learn of life as an Infiltrator.|Ah, you wish to learn of life as an Infiltrator in the Guild of Shadows. Yes. The Guild of Shadows also has welcomed the Temple of Arawn into it's halls. As an Infiltrator, you will serve the Guild of Shadows. [Stealth] will be your greatest friend. Yes, and twilight your sawn, for the work of an infiltrator is best accomplished when the sky is darkened and the land asleep. You will be sent to the enemy's arms. and expected to return successfully. [Death] is the only excuse for failing. Consider your choices when the time comes. Think well what Arawn would wish for you.
rows.StepText: Speak to Lieutenant Newster about life as a Scout and the Defenders of Albion.|Speak with Elaru about life as an Infiltrator and the Guild of Shadows.

rows.Name: Guild Preparation
rows.Description: It is time for you to make yourself known to the [guilds] in this realm.
rows.SourceText: Your service to them will dictate your fate. Are you [prepared] to [pursue] understanding at this time?||
rows.StepText: Seek out a future guild trainer. Do not join a guild at this time or you will fail this quest!|Seek out another guild trainer.|Return to your original trainer.
rows.FinishText: The Academy is Albion's tome of knowledge! From withing it's walls ushers forth untold power!

rows.Name: Zombie Problem
rows.Description: Help! Evil is walking the land and it has despoiled my farm. An army of [zombie swine] has invaded my land, they are led by the walking corpse of the farmer who owned the land before me.
rows.SourceText: Thank heavens, one less monster to ruin my land. Here is a small payment for your troubles.
rows.StepText: Kill the zombie sows at Gronyr's farm by night and give him their hog tails.

rows.Name: Bandit Ears
rows.Description: I am [offering] a reward for the ears of any bandits you kill.
rows.SourceText: Bring Hunter Derwyn, at the bandit tower, the ear of a bandit.|
rows.StepText: Bring Hunter Derwyn, at the bandit tower, the ear of a bandit.|Take the writ of bounty to Sir Dorian in the tower.

rows.Name: Cleric Mulgrut
rows.Description: So you want to buy something eh? Well here is what I have.
rows.SourceText: It is said that upon his death, he carried into the after life an item of great worth. Some say he still walks the cemetery not far from here!
rows.StepText: Locate and slay Mulgrut Maggot west of Prydwen Keep for his magical item. He walks with two decayed zombies and a putrid zombie between the cemetery and the hill with the tall stone.

rows.Name: Ripper
rows.Description: Hail! Ever heard of [throatripper]?" (South Black Mountains - 5963,59063,1024)
rows.SourceText: Thank you! I might actually get some sleep tonight.||||
rows.TargetText: |Wow! You did it! As promised, here is your reward. You should take that pelt into Ludlow and talk to [Marie]. It might be more valuable than you think!|Hello, you appear to need my [services]. Well I can do most any leatherwork you may require. Do you have a [pelt] that you wish me to examine? I assume you required my leatherworking skills do you not? Let me see it! Ah! A fine pelt indeed! I will fashion this a jerkin but you will need to obtain another item so that I can sew it properly. Seek out a large skeleon and from it bring me a piece of polished bone.||Hello, you appear to need my [services]. Well I can do most any leatherwork you may require. Do you have a [pelt] that you wish me to examine? I assume you required my leatherworking skills do you not? Let me see it! Ah! A fine pelt indeed! I will fashion this a jerkin but you will need to obtain another item so that I can sew it properly. Seek out a large skeleon and from it bring me a piece of polished bone.
rows.StepText: Find and slay Throatripper near the edge of the forest between the cutpurse and dwarf camps.|Return to Lieutenant Jursen for your reward.|Travel to Ludlow and show Seamstress Marie the ripper pelt.|Kill large skeletons near Cotswold and Prydwen Keep until you get a polished bone.|Give Seamstress Marie the polished bone.
rows.FinishText: She is a Seamstress in Ludlow.

rows.Name: Simple Request
rows.Description: I need someone to perform a simple errand: take this sealed note to [Lieutenant] Kuebler at Castle Sauvage.
rows.SourceText: Take the sealed note to Lieutenant Kuebler at Castle Sauvage.|
rows.StepText: Take the sealed note to Lieutenant Kuebler at Castle Sauvage.|Return the reply to Lieutenant Brude at Snowdonia Fortress.

rows.Name: Camdene's Components
rows.Description: I need three [components] to make some special dyes, and I will reward you if you collect them for me.
rows.TargetName: swamp rat;1|rot worm;1|bogman grappler;1|Dyemaster Camdene;1|Dyemaster Camdene;1
rows.SourceText: Get a rat tongue from a swamp rat.||||
rows.StepText: Get a rat tongue from a swamp rat.|Get a worm rot from a rot worm.|Get bog mud from a bogman grappler.|Return to Dyemaster Camdene in Adribard's Retreat and speak to him.|Give him the components one at a time, in order.

rows.Name: Goblin Incursion
rows.Description: We have a goblin problem and are awaiting news from a scout. Run to Commander Jusen past the second marker beyond the bridge toward [Snowdonia] Station.
rows.TargetName: Commander Jusen;1|Guard Reed;1|Grilo;1|Fusnup;1|Guard Reed;1|Guy Reed;1|Maggie McClellan;1|Maggie McClellan;1
rows.SourceText: Find Commander Jusen past the second marker beyond the bridge toward Snowdonia Station.|||||||Choose your reward: [Bracelet of Denied Bloodshed], [Bracelet of Mercifulness], [Bracelet of Wound Knitting], [Bracelet of Preservation].
rows.StepText: Find Commander Jusen past the second marker beyond the bridge toward Snowdonia Station.|Hand the note back to Guard Reed in Humberton.|Go to the goblin camp north of Humberton and kill its leaders, Grilo and Fusnup.|Kill Fusnup.|Return to Guard Reed.|Warn Guy Reed, the guard's son, in Ludlow that the goblins will attack.|Talk to Maggie McClellan.|Choose your reward: whisper Maggie McClellan the name of the item you want (Bracelet of Denied Bloodshed, Bracelet of Mercifulness, Bracelet of Wound Knitting, Bracelet of Preservation).

rows.Name: Heart of Sephucoth
rows.Description: I can fashion pendants of intricate beauty and make them talismans of power, but the [centerpiece] must be the heart of a terrible beast and the set piece a polished bone.
rows.SourceText: Collect the heart of Sephucoth, who appears among the river sprites by the sunken ship south of Cotswold.|||Choose your reward: [Crystallized Heart Pendant], [Crystallized Heart Talisman], [Crystallized Heart Necklace], [Fiery Crystal Pendant].
rows.StepText: Collect the heart of Sephucoth, who appears among the river sprites by the sunken ship south of Cotswold.|Collect a polished bone from the large skeletons.|Return the reagents to Elvar Ironhand in Cotswold.|Choose your reward: whisper Elvar Ironhand the name of the item you want (Crystallized Heart Pendant, Crystallized Heart Talisman, Crystallized Heart Necklace, Fiery Crystal Pendant).

rows.Name: Hunt for Slith
rows.Description: Some talk of a red snake that will only come should he become [displeased].
rows.SourceText: Good! This rare snake was last seen to the east. Not far from the walls of Camelot. Best of luck in your endeavor!|
rows.StepText: Locate and kill Slith northeast of the gates of Camelot; kill the broodlings to flush him out.|Bring Slith's tail to Commander Burcrif.

rows.Name: Search for Sil
rows.Description: Sil has gone [missing]. Will you find him for me?
rows.SourceText: Ask Sir Dorian at the tower by the Cotswold bindstone if he has seen Sil.||
rows.StepText: Ask Sir Dorian at the tower by the Cotswold bindstone if he has seen Sil.|Sil was killed by the spriggarn Ygwrch Gyrg on the hill with the stone head statue. Kill things on the hill until Ygwrch appears.|Return to Nob and tell him of Sil's fate.

rows.Name: Sunken Cargo
rows.Description: What am I to do? My boat has sunk in the river and the [cargo] lost. Oh what am I to do?
rows.SourceText: Follow the river south from Cotswold to the sunken ship surrounded by river sprites; kill them until Sephucoth appears.|
rows.StepText: Follow the river south from Cotswold to the sunken ship surrounded by river sprites; kill them until Sephucoth appears.|Bring the brandy back to Cullen Smyth in Cotswold.

rows.Name: Father Hugrath
rows.Description: My dad went into the ruin [nearby] and never came back. I fear he may be dead.
rows.SourceText: Find Hugrath, undead and surrounded by friends, in the smaller broken tower southeast of the Demon Tower, upriver from Frip's bridge.|
rows.StepText: Find Hugrath, undead and surrounded by friends, in the smaller broken tower southeast of the Demon Tower, upriver from Frip's bridge.|Let Frip know about his dad.

rows.Name: Lady Leana
rows.Description: Nob the [Stableboy] has a problem with faeries. Go talk to him.
rows.SourceText: Talk to Nob the Stableboy about the faeries terrorizing his animals.||
rows.StepText: Talk to Nob the Stableboy about the faeries terrorizing his animals.|Find Lady Leana at the pond in the nearby weeping willow grove and talk to her. Do not kill her faeries first.|There is no peaceful solution: slay Lady Leana.

rows.Name: Protecting Anniogel
rows.Description: <Player>, I am Kaere and I was sent here by Lady Eilwen and Davay to help Lady Treva Evasca defend this town. The task has not been easy for the Drakoran are a formidable enemy. Every day Lady Treva and her guardians live with the knowledge that the Drakoran may not be satisfied with over running the forts to the north and will attack the town. I have been [gifted with the knowledge] that may yet save this town from the Drakoran.
rows.SourceText: You have survived, <Player>. You must have courage and bravery that will serve you well. Now, I must add the items to the potion in a specific order, so listen closely to what I ask for. First I need the vial of water from the lesser water elemental.||||||
rows.TargetText: ||||Now I must have the tail of the giant dragonfly.||
rows.StepText: Capture a draft of water from a lesser water elemental with Kaere's vial.|Take the glowing spirit stone from one of the ghosts that roam the land.|Get the tail of a giant dragonfly.|Get the dirt from an urchin rabblerouser.|Bring the components to Kaere in Anniogel.|Use the potion in Anniogel to protect the town.|Return to Kaere.
rows.FinishText: Some of the finest craftspeople in the land worked hard to create this, <Player>, and now we present it to you. We cannot thank you enough for your service to Anniogel, <Player>. Lord Arawan and Lady Lile shall look upon you with favor for your help. Fare thee well, <Player>.

rows.Name: Dunan's Bear Tooth
rows.Description: Gundron McCory and the Black Mountain Blades attacked me and stole an [unfinished] charm made from a rare bear tooth. Should he meet his death, I would complete the charm and pass it to you.
rows.SourceText: Search the area around Ludlow for the Black Mountain Blades leader, Gundron McCory. He is rarely alone!||Choose your reward: [Beartooth Pendant of Might], [Beartooth Pendant of Power], [Beartooth Pendant of Alacrity].
rows.StepText: Search the area around Ludlow for the Black Mountain Blades leader, Gundron McCory. He is rarely alone!|Return the bear tooth to Apprentice Dunan in Ludlow.|Choose your reward: whisper Apprentice Dunan the name of the item you want (Beartooth Pendant of Might, Beartooth Pendant of Power, Beartooth Pendant of Alacrity).

rows.Name: Price of Courage
rows.Description: Young Trini Piper lost her parents to the [goblins] at an early age. Talk to her.
rows.TargetName: Trini Piper;1|Jezzy Piper;1|Grilk's ratmaker;1|Grilk's footscratcher;1|Grilk's bonescraper;1|Commander Jusen;1|Trini Piper;1|Jezzy Piper;1|Maggie McClellan;1|Maggie McClellan;1
rows.SourceText: Talk to Trini Piper.|||||||||Choose your reward: [Heart of the Determined], [Heart of the Intellect], [Heart of the Sly], [Heart of the Zealot].
rows.StepText: Talk to Trini Piper.|Talk to Jezzy Piper, who raised Trini.|Slay Grilk's goblin servant the ratmaker, south of Tepok's Mine.|Slay the footscratcher.|Slay the bonescraper.|Take the three goblin heads to Commander Jusen in the tower due east of the mine.|Take the King's token to Trini.|Talk to Jezzy Piper.|Return to Maggie McClellan at the Ludlow tavern.|Choose your reward: whisper Maggie McClellan the name of the item you want (Heart of the Determined, Heart of the Intellect, Heart of the Sly, Heart of the Zealot).

rows.Name: Thinking Cap
rows.Description: My cousin [Bouditha] is abusing a family cap. Get it back from her!
rows.SourceText: Find Bouditha atop the hill across from Ludlow and take back the cap.|
rows.StepText: Find Bouditha atop the hill across from Ludlow and take back the cap.|Return the cap to Cranly at Snowdonia Station.

rows.Name: Departed Hero
rows.Description: Morgana has raised the knight Sir Gerenth from the dead and left him in the hands of druids in a cemetery in the North Black [Mountains]. Put him to rest and bring back his bone dagger.
rows.SourceText: Put Sir Gerenth to rest in the cemetery southeast of the goblin camp near Snowdonia Station.|
rows.StepText: Put Sir Gerenth to rest in the cemetery southeast of the goblin camp near Snowdonia Station.|Return the bone dagger to Lieutenant Brude.

rows.Name: Dragon Ant Charm
rows.Description: I can make a new charm for you, but I need a [dragon] ant larva to do it.
rows.SourceText: Kill ants on the hill northwest of Snowdonia Station until the dragon ant queen appears, and take her spotted larva.|
rows.StepText: Kill ants on the hill northwest of Snowdonia Station until the dragon ant queen appears, and take her spotted larva.|Bring the spotted larva to Ember at the back of the Snowdonia Station inn.

rows.Name: Intervention
rows.Description: Take this document to Brother Don at the Abbey in the southern Black [Mountains].
rows.SourceText: Take the document to Brother Don at Vetusta Abbey in the southern Black Mountains.|
rows.StepText: Take the document to Brother Don at Vetusta Abbey in the southern Black Mountains.|Return the wax-sealed note to Sir Defi.

rows.Name: Tale of Druids
rows.Description: Good day to you. I don't really have time to tell [the tale] again. Perhaps you could return later?
rows.TargetName: Master Kless;1|filidh sacrificer;1|Master Kless;1|Sir Tilian;1|Omis;1|Librarian Pelan;10|Master Kless;1
rows.SourceText: There is a wizard who may be able to assist you. Master Kless has studied the druids at much length and often leads students in instruction. If you travel into Cotswold you can find his within the dye shop. I must get back to my cleaning now. We sometimes have problems with pixies and they get into everything. Best of luck to you.||||||
rows.TargetText: Good day to you! A question appears to hang about your lips. What can I instruct you in? Ah! The druids of [new and old] hold quite a bit of history my friend. I would be glad to detail a bit of it for you if you wish? Yes! While both still practice the basic paths taught them generations ago, it is the newest of druids that seek to reclaim that which they lost so long ago. Their hold on Salisbury and parts of the Campacorentin Forest are proof of this. Some have actually pressed into the Black Mountains seeking to claim land closer and closer to Camelot. There are many within our realm that now fight to ensure this spread will not continue. I know three thta keeps tabs upon the very movement of these druids and research their history in depth. Though I fear this will do [little to assist] us now, I am certain it will allow us to take greater action in the future. Already we are having difficulty in stopping the druids to our north. rows.TargetText: Good day to you! A question appears to hang about your lips. What can I instruct you in? Ah! The druids of [new and old] hold quite a bit of history my friend. I would be glad to detail a bit of it for you if you wish? Yes! While both still practice the basic paths taught them generations ago, it is the newest of druids that seek to reclaim that which they lost so long ago. Their hold on Salisbury and parts of the Campacorentin Forest are proof of this. Some have actually pressed into the Black Mountains seeking to claim land closer and closer to Camelot. There are many within our realm that now fight to ensure this spread will not continue. I know three thta keeps tabs upon the very movement of these druids and research their history in depth. Though I fear this will do [little to assist] us now, I am certain it will allow us to take greater action in the future. Already we are having difficulty in stopping the druids to our north. They gain greater courage the closer they come to Camelot. Unlike the [druids of old] that held land for a generation or so before moving on, these fruids move with blazing speed. Their thirst to reclaim all that was taken from them seems never to be filled. From what I've learned, once their priest had taken Keltoi as their primary place of learning the druidic spread all but stopped. They turned their attention to developing a culture within our lands and building places of worship. Now it seems these druids press into our realm as if on act of vengeance. Their only goal is to secure all land that was once their own regardless of the [bloodshed]. You should witness this for yourself. To be told the deeds of these people is nothing compared to actually experiencing their wrath first hand. If you would be willing to travel into the black mountains and [slay a sacrificer] I will reward you. That's correct! Bring me the sacrificer's dagger as well. I believe the hill they occupy is just north of the double bridge. Best of luck to thee.||Good day to you! A question appears to hang about your lips. What can I instruct you in? Ah! rows.StepText: Speak to Master Kless in the last house on the right in Cotswold. Ask him of [druids].|Travel NNE from the twin towers at the north end of the double bridge to the druid circle on the North/South Black Mountains border and slay a filidh sacrificer.|Return the filidh's dagger to Master Kless at Cotswold.|Speak with Sir Tillian upstairs in Castle Sauvage. Ask him of [druids].|Speak with Ornis inside Swanton Keep.|Seek out Librarian Pelan upstairs in the Academy in Camelot. Ask him of [standing stones].|Take the book to Master Kless in Cotswold.

rows.Name: Cloak of Shades
rows.Description: Meran the Weaver in [Prydwen] Keep can make a Cloak of Shades, if you gather what she needs.
rows.TargetName: Meran the Weaver;1|red adder;1|will o' wisp;1|Meran the Weaver;1|Thrurin the Dyemaster;1|dryad;1|Thrurin the Dyemaster;1|red dwarf chief;1|Thrurin the Dyemaster;1|Aldous Wynedd;1|Thrurin the Dyemaster;1|boulderling;1|Thrurin the Dyemaster;1|Meran the Weaver;1
rows.SourceText: Talk to Meran the Weaver along the back wall of Prydwen Keep.|||||||||||||
rows.StepText: Talk to Meran the Weaver along the back wall of Prydwen Keep.|Kill a red adder in Salisbury Plains for its glowing snake skin.|Kill a will o' wisp east of Caer Ulfwych in Campacorentin Forest.|Return the components to Meran the Weaver.|Find Dyemaster Thrurin, who wanders the woods along the road between Camelot and Ludlow.|Kill a dryad in the woods around Snowdonia Station for a container.|Return the container to Thrurin; he lost the dye to a thief.|Kill the red dwarf chief in the valley below the bull carved into the hill, east of the double bridge, and recover the horn of drinking.|Return the horn to Thrurin.|Kill the bandit Aldous Wynedd on top of the hill east of Ludlow and recover the dye.|Return the dye to Thrurin.|Get black rocks from a boulderling in Camelot Hills.|Return the black rocks to Thrurin.|Give Meran the components to receive the Cloak of Shades.

rows.Name: Niea's Missing Brother
rows.Description: Gwulin has information about my brother's [disappearance] and may need coercion. Take this pack of money and find him.
rows.SourceText: Find Gwulin on the road from the Camelot Hills bridge toward Salisbury Plains and give him the pouch of money.||
rows.StepText: Find Gwulin on the road from the Camelot Hills bridge toward Salisbury Plains and give him the pouch of money.|Gwulin attacks! Slay him.|Take the flute to Andryn the stableboy at West Downs.

rows.Name: Sals' Jar
rows.Description: Aldous Wynedd stole the jar I was going to use to enter the [Potter's] Guild. I want it back.
rows.SourceText: Kill Aldous Wynedd on top of the hill north of Ludlow.|
rows.StepText: Kill Aldous Wynedd on top of the hill north of Ludlow.|Return the jar to Sals Pew in Ludlow.

rows.Name: Sir Gleran's Lost Necklace
rows.Description: Complete the quest Roan had [undertaken], if only to clear his name: retrieve the necklace he was to deliver.
rows.SourceText: Kill the filidh leader Kedalinde Teanidd in the small valley behind West Downs.|
rows.StepText: Kill the filidh leader Kedalinde Teanidd in the small valley behind West Downs.|Give the necklace to Sir Gleran in Castle Humberton.

rows.Name: Staff of Life
rows.Description: Slay the filidh Aithne Con to the south. She is [dangerous]; bring a friend.
rows.SourceText: Cross the river, head south, then due east to the stone ring on a hillside, where Aithne Con spawns.|
rows.StepText: Cross the river, head south, then due east to the stone ring on a hillside, where Aithne Con spawns.|Take her head back to Llewellyn Camber by the water south of Prydwen Keep.

rows.Name: Tainted Magic
rows.Description: [Yasminea] Dardin has had trouble casting magic on her pet Pebbles, but Bouncer Corwin won't let anyone near her.
rows.TargetName: |Bouncer Corwin;1|Yasminea Darden;1|goblin shaman;1|Keenar Woedin;1|The Great Gobzini;1|Yasminea Darden;1|Bouncer Corwin;1|Bouncer Corwin;1
rows.SourceText: Get three ales from the Ludlow bartender.||||||||Choose your reward: [Boots of Legerdemain], [Sleeves of Legerdemain], [Gloves of Legerdemain].
rows.StepText: Get three ales from the Ludlow bartender.|Give the ales to Bouncer Corwin; he starts crooning a love song to Yasminea.|Talk with Yasminea Dardin.|Get the pouch of a goblin shaman from the camp near Tepok's Mine.|Bring the pouch to Keenar Woedin in the Ludlow tavern.|Kill The Great Gobzini, performing just north of Tepok's Mine.|Bring the magical bag back to Yasminea.|Talk to Corwin, who offers [Gloves], [Sleeves] or [Boots].|Choose your reward: whisper Bouncer Corwin the name of the item you want (Boots of Legerdemain, Sleeves of Legerdemain, Gloves of Legerdemain).

rows.Name: Bandit Camp
rows.Description: Cleddyf and Cilydd Difwych feud from their camps east of the road to Forest Sauvage. A messenger runs between them; take his place and [intercept] the messages.
rows.TargetName: bandit messenger;1|Cleddyf Difwych;1|Sir Kenley;10|Cleddyf Difwych;1|Sir Kenley;10
rows.SourceText: Find and kill the messenger on the dirt hill behind the bandit tower.||||
rows.StepText: Find and kill the messenger on the dirt hill behind the bandit tower.|Wear the bandit tunic and deliver the note to Cleddyf.|Deliver the sealed note to Sir Kenley (take off the tunic first).|Wait for midnight, when Cleddyf leaves his camp for the meeting point with a bandit lieutenant, and kill him.|Deliver Cleddyf's head to Sir Kenley.

rows.Name: Guarding the Stone
rows.Description: My squire Graid guards a stone in [Salisbury] Plains and has not reported. Find him.
rows.SourceText: Find Squire Graid at the large rock in Salisbury Plains and talk to him.|||
rows.StepText: Find Squire Graid at the large rock in Salisbury Plains and talk to him.|Deal with the Ghostwalker's Apprentice and the undead that accompany him.|Hand Squire Graid the apprentice's pack.|Return to Sir Jerem in Prydwen Keep and give him the pack.

rows.Name: Information / Trickery
rows.Description: Three Drakoran border watchers each carry a scroll with [information] I want. And one of the ladies here needs the essence of a corpse candle.

(3/3)|Kill a corpse candle in the trees directly south of Anniogel for its essence.|Return to General Wystan in Caer Gothwaite.

rows.Name: Information / Trickery
rows.Description: Three Drakoran border watchers each carry a scroll with [information] I want. And one of the ladies here needs the essence of a corpse candle.
rows.TargetName: drakoran border watcher;51|drakoran border watcher;51|drakoran border watcher;51|corpse candle;51|General Wystan;51

(1/3)|Kill three Drakoran border watchers by the trees past the farthest fort southwest of Anniogel. rows.Name: Barnett's Shield
rows.Description: My best man Barnett was ambushed and killed defending my Lady's honor. Find both halves of his shield and bring me the head of Mootang, who is [responsible].
rows.SourceText: Get the two shield halves from boulderlings high on the mountainside behind Swanton Keep. (1/2)|||
rows.StepText: Get the two shield halves from boulderlings high on the mountainside behind Swanton Keep. (1/2)|Get the two shield halves from boulderlings high on the mountainside behind Swanton Keep. (2/2)|Kill Mootang in the back left hut of the goblin camp near Swanton Keep.|Return the shield halves and Mootang's head to Sir Gleran in the order he requests.

rows.Name: Growler's Necklace
rows.Description: [Sub-quest] of The Growling Ghost: bring Growler his necklace and free his bones.
rows.SourceText: Kill the bandit Cyfwlch Difwych at his camp on the road to Castle Sauvage.||
rows.StepText: Kill the bandit Cyfwlch Difwych at his camp on the road to Castle Sauvage.|Return the necklace to Growler.|Free his bones: slay Growler.

rows.Name: Lady Judith's Circlet
rows.Description: Lady Judith's gold and pearl circlet has been stolen, but she [recognized] the robber. Get it back.
rows.SourceText: Kill the bandit Cyfer Difwych in the central camp due east of the east Camelot gates.|||
rows.StepText: Kill the bandit Cyfer Difwych in the central camp due east of the east Camelot gates.|Return the opal to Gaevin Sebryn.|Cyfer traded the circlet to the demon Fielath for a spell. Seek him out in the broken tower in the undead ruins by the river.|Return to Gaevin for your reward.

rows.Name: Slythcur Cloak
rows.Description: Collect a pile of drake scales and a brown drake eye from the carrion drakes, then the hide of the drake [Slythcur], and I will make you a cloak.
rows.SourceText: Collect a pile of drake scales from the carrion drakes in Salisbury Plains.|||
rows.StepText: Collect a pile of drake scales from the carrion drakes in Salisbury Plains.|Collect a brown drake eye from the carrion drakes.|Kill Slythcur, a named drake, for its hide.|Return to Anga Weaver in Adribard's Retreat and give her the parts in order.

rows.Name: The Captured Courier
rows.Description: Find Dustan and help him deliver a box. He was [ambushed] in Camelot Hills.
rows.SourceText: At the bandit camp near the Tomb of Mithra, find Cilydd Difwych and kill him for the box.|||
rows.StepText: At the bandit camp near the Tomb of Mithra, find Cilydd Difwych and kill him for the box.|Kill the druid Zelsania Nodith, who holds Dustan hostage just west of the circle of stones in northwest Salisbury Plains.|Talk with Dustan and give him the key and box.|Head to Adribard's Retreat and give Brother Onoloth the pendant.

rows.Name: The Growling Ghost
rows.Description: A [growling] ghost haunts the plains. Speak with Growler, and see that he is put to rest.
rows.SourceText: Speak with Growler near the northwest guard tower of Salisbury Plains.||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Growler near the northwest guard tower of Salisbury Plains.|Kill the bandit Cyfwlch Difwych on the road to Castle Sauvage for Growler's necklace.|Return the necklace to Growler.|Free his bones: slay Growler.|Return proof of Growler's rest to Sergeant Alain on the south side of the Camelot Hills bridge.

rows.Name: Drakoran Watchers
rows.Description: A Drakoran scout has been spotted a little too close to [Gothwaite]. Speak to Ely in Caifelle.
rows.SourceText: Speak to Ely in Caifelle.|||||
rows.StepText: Speak to Ely in Caifelle.|Find the wandering Drakoran scout east of Anniogel and northwest of Caifelle.|Read the sealed letter.|Take the sealed letter back to Ely and decide what to do.|Kill the Drakoran leader Ariach.|Take the attack plans to Frederik Rolby in Gothwaite Harbor.

rows.Name: Reaching Beyond
rows.Description: Take this ticket to West Downs and speak to Larson [O'Riley].
rows.SourceText: Speak to Larson O'Riley just west of West Downs.||||
rows.StepText: Speak to Larson O'Riley just west of West Downs.|Get a feather from the named basilisk Tuka on the ridge across the road from West Downs.|Swim at the base of the Prydwen Keep / Salisbury bridge and search for the root.|Give Larson the feather and the root.|Return to Edith Waring and give her the potion.

rows.Name: Siom's Staff
rows.Description: Retrieve a sack of red dust from Kedalinde Teanidd, somewhere in [Salisbury] Plains.
rows.SourceText: Kill Kedalinde Teanidd, leader of the filidhs behind West Downs, for the red dust.|||
rows.StepText: Kill Kedalinde Teanidd, leader of the filidhs behind West Downs, for the red dust.|Return the dust to Siom Felanis in Humberton.|Retrieve the backbone of Mystic Ulfwag, leader of the goblin fort northwest of Snowdonia Station.|Return the backbone to Siom Felanis.

rows.Name: Bedelia's Grief
rows.Description: My son Barnett was sent on a mission and killed. I hope to get some of his [belongings] back. Take this portrait to Sir Gleran to prove I sent you.
rows.TargetName: Sir Gleran;1|large boulderling;1|large boulderling;1|Mootang;1|Sir Gleran;1|Bedelia;10|King Smugluk;1|Bedelia;10
rows.SourceText: Give the portrait to Sir Gleran in Castle Humberton.|||||||
rows.StepText: Give the portrait to Sir Gleran in Castle Humberton.|Recover both halves of Barnett's shield from the boulderlings behind Swanton Keep (Barnett's Shield). (1/2)|Recover both halves of Barnett's shield from the boulderlings behind Swanton Keep (Barnett's Shield). (2/2)|Kill Mootang at the goblin camp.|Return to Sir Gleran with the shield and Mootang's head.|Return Barnett's shield and sword to Bedelia.|Avenge her son: kill King Smugluk, who ordered Mootang to goad Barnett, at the same goblin camp.|Give King Smugluk's head to Bedelia.

rows.Name: Willing Sacrifice
rows.Description: Do you attend services regularly? The Cult of Mithra gathers in the tomb. Someone must be willing to sacrifice themselves, and the cult's password must be [discovered]. Take my journal.
rows.TargetName: |Anilius;21|Favonius Facilis;21|Virilus;21|forgotten promise;21||Acolyte Nascita;21|High Priest Andania;21|Brother Codeth;1|Brother Codeth;1
rows.SourceText: Check Brother Codeth's Journal to see what to do now.|||||||||Choose your reward: [Scorpio Belt of Mithra], [Crown of Mithra], [Crown of Mithra (cloth)], [Mithrian Vest of Taurus], [Mithran Gloves of Hydra], [Mithran Gloves of Hydra (leather)], [Mithran Boots of Leo], [Mithran Sleeves of Perses], [Gurz], [Ormuzd].
rows.StepText: Check Brother Codeth's Journal to see what to do now.|The first test of the cultists is given by Anilius. Kill him in the west of the Tomb of Mithra.|Kill Favonius Facilis.|Kill Virilus.|Kill the Forgotten Promise; it tells of the room with the password: west, then north, then west, then north.|Discover the cult password in the room west, north, west, north (the cultists there attack).|Acolyte Naseita must complete the ritual: someone must be willingly slain by him. Then follow the slave.|Follow the slave to High Priest Andania and kill him.|Return to Brother Codeth, give him his journal and tell him the cult's password.|Choose your reward: whisper Brother Codeth the name of the item you want (Scorpio Belt of Mithra, Crown of Mithra, Crown of Mithra (cloth), Mithrian Vest of Taurus, Mithran Gloves of Hydra, Mithran Gloves of Hydra (leather), Mithran Boots of Leo, Mithran Sleeves of Perses, Gurz, Ormuzd).

rows.Name: Ivy Weave Gloves
rows.Description: Retrieve the holy book from Brother Jarrel on the ruined bridge in [Salisbury] Plains. He must be freed from his chains.
rows.TargetName: Brother Jarrel;1|Brother Onoloth;1|wood ogre seer;1|ebony fellwood;1|Brother Onoloth;1
rows.SourceText: Free Brother Jarrel from his chains on the ruined bridge east of the Fallen Tower and retrieve the holy book.||||
rows.StepText: Free Brother Jarrel from his chains on the ruined bridge east of the Fallen Tower and retrieve the holy book.|Return the holy book to Brother Onoloth in Adribard's Retreat.|Find the first item among the wood ogres southwest of Caer Ulfwych.|Find the second item on an ebony fellwood.|Bring both items to Brother Onoloth.

rows.Name: Ivy Weave Gloves
rows.Description: Retrieve the holy book from Brother Jarrel on the ruined bridge in [Salisbury] Plains. He must be freed from his chains.
rows.TargetName: Brother Jarrel;1|Brother Onoloth;1|wood ogre seer;1|ebony fellwood;1|Brother Onoloth;1
rows.SourceText: Free Brother Jarrel from his chains on the ruined bridge east of the Fallen Tower and retrieve the holy book.||||
rows.StepText: Free Brother Jarrel from his chains on the ruined bridge east of the Fallen Tower and retrieve the holy book.|Return the holy book to Brother Onoloth in Adribard's Retreat.|Find the first item among the wood ogres southwest of Caer Ulfwych.|Find the second item on an ebony fellwood.|Bring both items to Brother Onoloth.

rows.Name: Contyth's Hammer
rows.Description: Take this letter to Calya in Caer [Ulfwych].
rows.SourceText: Deliver the letter to Calya in Caer Ulfwych.||||
rows.StepText: Deliver the letter to Calya in Caer Ulfwych.|Kill the spirit of Brother Jarrel on the broken bridge east of the Fallen Tower.|Kill Kearcs at the slaver camp in Salisbury Plains.|Return to Calya in Caer Ulfwych for the third item.|Return to Contyth in Humberton and give him the items in order.

rows.Name: Kindred of the Fallen
rows.Description: Speak to Sir Tillian [upstairs] in Castle Sauvage.
rows.TargetName: Sir Tilian;1|ashen fellwood;1|Sir Tilian;1|Aiellana;1||Aiellana;1|wood ogre lord;1|Aiellana;1||Fallen Druid Seer;1|Sir Tilian;1|Lieutenant Kuebler;1
rows.SourceText: Talk to Sir Tillian upstairs in Castle Sauvage.|||||||||||
rows.StepText: Talk to Sir Tillian upstairs in Castle Sauvage.|Get living tissue from a fellwood; the higher the fellwood's level, the better your chance.|Return the living tissue to Sir Tillian.|Take the box to Aiellana in Adribard's Retreat.|Find the two standing stones of power in Forest Sauvage (southern tip of the river, then southeast).|Return to Aiellana.|Get the wounding stone from a wood ogre at the ogre camp in Campacorentin Forest.|Return with the stone to Aiellana.|Use the wounding stone between the standing stones, closer to the larger one.|Kill the druid summoned by the stone.|Tell Sir Tillian [Evil has been destroyed].|Take Sir Tillian's note to Lieutenant Kuebler.

rows.Name: Lord Aryon's Box
rows.Description: Lord Aryon's box holds papers written by him and by King Arthur himself, but the key was stolen from his grave by tomb [robbers], and the box is warded.
rows.SourceText: Find Halena Edulan in the tomb robber camp in eastern Salisbury Plains.||
rows.StepText: Find Halena Edulan in the tomb robber camp in eastern Salisbury Plains.|Get the scroll that removes the wards from the undead Dread Lord Aryon in the broken church ruins in Avalon Marsh.|Return both the key and the scroll to Sister Elaydith at the Church in Camelot.

rows.Name: The Stolen Spells
rows.Description: Some pixies stole three spell [scrolls] from the Magic Shoppe. Return them.
rows.SourceText: Get the blue spell scroll from the druid Elithralia Nodith next to the entrance to Keltoi Fogou.|||
rows.StepText: Get the blue spell scroll from the druid Elithralia Nodith next to the entrance to Keltoi Fogou.|Get the green spell scroll from Veviel the grove nymph in Salisbury Plains.|Get the purple spell scroll from the pixie queen south of the road from Caer Ulfwych to Avalon Marsh.|Return the scrolls to Vadri Pade upstairs in the Magic Shoppe.

rows.Name: Druid Medicine
rows.Description: My son will die without his medicine, and a druid seer [attacked] us and stole it.
rows.SourceText: Kill the druid seer in the grove of trees east of the southwest tower, between the two stone rings.|
rows.StepText: Kill the druid seer in the grove of trees east of the southwest tower, between the two stone rings.|Return the vial to Landon Huntingdon.

rows.Name: Bishop Burhoff's Curse
rows.Description: Greetings, my brother. Are you [well this day]?
rows.TargetName: Dark Bishop Burhoff;1|Brother Lensar;10|Bishop Burhoff;10|Bishop Burhoff;10|forest adder;1|Bishop Burhoff;10
rows.SourceText: Your help is most appreciated, <Player>. I have prepared a ritual prayer that will help us [determine Burhoff's will].|||||
rows.TargetText: ||You wish to speak to me? Am I in [a church]? If I am in a church, then perhaps the time has come to lift the curse that is upon me. If I only I could rid myself of this curse. I could seek out Lord Aryon in the otherworld and [beg his forgiveness]. But as long as I am cursed, I cannot seek him out to beg his forgiveness. Aye, I would beg his forgiveness. I was entranced by Morgana's beauty and spells, and didn't see the error of my ways until I lay dying. I only wish now to make it right. But I need help to [break the curse]. To break the curse, I need a adder fang. I will use it to slice my [ties to this earth], breaking the curse. When I was alive, you could find them in Forest Sauvage. I'd start there. Once you have it, return to me here. Take this skull with you, so that you may speak to me again when you return. The blessing of the Church upon you, my child. You have returned. Do you have the adder fang for me? I wish to leave this world and seek out Lord Aryon in the beyond. Please give it to me now. Thank you! I have a reward for you for helping me. It is something I will no longer need now, but I think you will like it and it will serve you well. I thank you again for helping me, and I know the Church thanks you too. rows.StepText: Get Bishop Burhoff's skull from the Dark Bishop, who haunts the ruins of Lord Aryon's castle in Avalon Marsh at night.|Return to Brother Lensar in Camelot City.|Find the ghost of Bishop Burhoff in the graveyard behind the Church in Camelot at night and give him the skull.|Talk to Bishop Burhoff and find out about his curse.|Get an adder fang from a forest adder in Forest Sauvage.|Return to Bishop Burhoff in the Camelot graveyard at night and give him the skull and the adder fang.
rows.FinishText: Wonderful, you have survived that encounter. Search the graveyard for Bishop Burhoff. I have seen him wandering there at night. Give him the skull and he will speak with you.

rows.Name: Escaped Bandits
rows.Description: Help Guard Dafydd at the guard tower just outside [Campacorentin] Forest.
rows.SourceText: Talk to Guard Dafydd at the tower outside Campacorentin Forest about the escaped prisoners.||
rows.StepText: Talk to Guard Dafydd at the tower outside Campacorentin Forest about the escaped prisoners.|Find the escaped bandits south of the first druid ring due east of the tower, and slay their leader.|Return the cloak to Guard Dafydd.

rows.Name: Goblin Hunting
rows.Description: Bring back the bows of two sylvan goblin hunters and the [remains] of the boy they took.
rows.TargetName: sylvan goblin hunter;1|sylvan goblin hunter;1|sylvan goblin hunter;1|Huntress Lenna;1
rows.SourceText: Kill sylvan goblin hunters on the hill behind Caer Ulfwych for two bows. (1/2)|||
rows.StepText: Kill sylvan goblin hunters on the hill behind Caer Ulfwych for two bows. (1/2)|Kill sylvan goblin hunters on the hill behind Caer Ulfwych for two bows. (2/2)|Recover the boy's remains from the goblin hunters.|Bring them back to Lenna in Caer Ulfwych.

rows.Name: Oaken Boots
rows.Description: I am an [apprentice] smith, and I have a tale to tell you of oaken boots.
rows.TargetName: Oaken Knight;1|Contyth, Apprentice Smith;1|ghost miner;1|Mathien;1|Guards' Armorer;1
rows.SourceText: Get oaken bark from an oaken knight west of the road at the forest's northern edge.||||
rows.StepText: Get oaken bark from an oaken knight west of the road at the forest's northern edge.|Take the bark to Calya's brother Contyth in Humberton.|Get metal shavings from the ghost miners north of Snowdonia Station; they appear at night up the hill past the dragon ants.|See Mathien, their father, at Snowdonia Station.|Take the nails and bark to the guards' armorer in Swanton Keep.

rows.Name: The Hunt for Arachneida
rows.Description: Kill the giant spider [Arachneida]. First you'll need a bloated spider fang.
rows.SourceText: Kill a bloated spider east of Caer Ulfwych for a bloated spider fang.||
rows.StepText: Kill a bloated spider east of Caer Ulfwych for a bloated spider fang.|Kill Arachneida, who spawns with the bloated spiders.|Return to Kealan at Campacorentin Station with the fang and chitin.

rows.Name: Nenet's Research
rows.Description: I am researching a new line of mind spells and need magical acorns from an oak man - a very rare find - and a druid's wand of oak. Only druids carry the wand, not seers or [sacrificers].
rows.SourceText: Get magical acorns from an oak man far to the east, north of the main road near Salisbury Plains.||
rows.StepText: Get magical acorns from an oak man far to the east, north of the main road near Salisbury Plains.|Get a druid's wand of oak from a druid in the southeast of the forest.|Return to Scholar Nenet at the Lethantis Association.

rows.Name: The Heretical Hermit
rows.Description: Sirelian, once a student at the Lethantis Association, was discovered learning black magic from Morgana. Spurned by her, he lives as a hermit in [Campacorentin] Forest. Hunt him down.
rows.SourceText: Find the hermit Sirelian somewhere in Campacorentin Forest and eliminate him.|
rows.StepText: Find the hermit Sirelian somewhere in Campacorentin Forest and eliminate him.|Return to Aiellana in Adribard's Retreat.
