rows.Name: Outcast Ormgarth
rows.Description: Ah! Perhaps you [can help] us!
rows.SourceText: Oh thank you! He was last seen not far from here. Northeast, into the woods!
rows.StepText: Find and kill Ormgarth northeast of the Ring of Sentasil. A dozen snakes attack with him.

rows.Name: Dugan's Magical Totem
rows.Description: I am a wood carver, and if you are up for an [adventure] I can make you a totem. First I need a sliver of ashen wood and the eyes of Brodecia.
rows.TargetName: ashen fellwood;1|Brodecia;1|Dugan Advien;1|Urfgrat the Green;1|Dugan Advien;1
rows.SourceText: Get a sliver of ashen wood from an ashen fellwood in Campacorentin Forest or Forest Sauvage.||||
rows.StepText: Get a sliver of ashen wood from an ashen fellwood in Campacorentin Forest or Forest Sauvage.|Kill Brodecia at the ettin camp northeast of Castle Sauvage, on the south bank of the river.|Return to Dugan Advien at Caer Witrin.|Recover Dugan's carving kit from the goblin Urfgrat the Green, who walks with his cronies between the goblin camp and the ogre camp northwest of Caer Ulfwych.|Return the carving kit to Dugan.

rows.Name: Uncle Thulin
rows.Description: Greetings to you this fine day friend. I am Achae Smith. Over there is my daughter Aelbfeld Smith. My husband is the hard working man, but I sometimes regret coming [out here].
rows.TargetName: Gracien Adamson;51|Achae Smith;51|Gracien Adamson;51|Elyn Badam;51||drakoran mage;51|apple fly;51|Elyn Badam;51|Achae Smith;51|forged servant;51|Achae Smith;51
rows.SourceText: Oh! You will! Excellent! Thank you so much! I am very worried for my <Player>'s safety, and I would hope you find him alive, but if you don't, please bring his [remains] back to me.||||||||||
rows.TargetText: Yes? What can I do for you? Or are you here to waste my time? Oh yes... I am quite familiar with that creature, well, with most of the cabalist's former servants, I must say. But what interest do you have in the forged servant? You haven't, by chance, been talking to [Achae Smith], have you? Yes... I heard about her uncle's strange disappearance. And then her finding of that metal. It's hardly what I'd call evidence, as you can find pieces of forged servants just about everywhere. Still, if she wants me to talk with you, I see [no harm]. The forged servants are constructs made out of a dense steel, the same you'd find in an anvil. You'll sometimes hear them referred to as [anvil monsters], but I don't know how common that name is. I'm sure you know that they were made by Meical in order to serve him. Make no mistake, friend. These creatures are pure evil, a menace to us and any who come upon them. I'll tell you [what], though. I know and alchemist who could determine if a forged servant really did make off with Achae's uncle. All you need is to get that piece of metal her and then come back to me. Don't worry, I'm sure she'll give it to you. Yes, those do look like pieces from a forged servant, but without scribibg, it's nearly impossible to tell. Alright then, here is what you're going to do]. Take the metal bits with you to Wearyall Hill. There you will find a woman named Elyn Badam. She is a friend of mine, the alchemist I spoke of earlier. Give her this note. She should help you out after that. Good luck friend.|Oh, you're back. Did you talk with Gracien? What did he have to say?|Yes? What can I do for you? Or are you here to waste my time? Oh yes... I am quite familiar with that creature, well, with most of the cabalist's former servants, I must say. But what interest do you have in the forged servant? You haven't, by chance, been talking to [Achae Smith], have you? Yes... I heard about her uncle's strange disappearance. And then her finding of that metal. It's hardly what I'd call evidence, as you can find pieces of forged servants just about everywhere. Still, if she wants me to talk with you, I see [no harm]. The forged servants are constructs made out of a dense steel, the same you'd find in an anvil. You'll sometimes hear them referred to as [anvil monsters], but I don't know how common that name is. I'm sure you know that they were made by Meical in order to serve him. Make no mistake, friend. These creatures are pure evil, a menace to us and any who come upon them. I'll tell you [what], though. I know and alchemist who could determine if a forged servant really did make off with Achae's uncle. All you need is to get that piece of metal her and then come back to me. Don't worry, I'm sure she'll give it to you. Yes, those do look like pieces from a forged servant, but without scribibg, it's nearly impossible to tell. Alright then, here is what you're going to do]. Take the metal bits with you to Wearyall Hill. There you will find a woman named Elyn Badam. She is a friend of mine, the alchemist I spoke of earlier. Give her this note. She should help you out after that. Good luck friend.|And what might I be able to do for you today? Ah, my dear friend Gracien... I do wish he'd come here for a... visit. But, that's really not what you're here to discuss, is it? It says in this note that you have some metal bits for me to look at? Well, hand them to me. Yes, I can discover if it was indeed the creature that took the woman's uncle. But I need for you to fetch me some ingredients in exchange for the information. Here is the [list] of what I will need. First, I need a piece of bark from Brother Josef's tree. It's the large one on the hill over yonder, you can't miss it. Secondly, I need a Golden Orb from a Drakoran Mage. Lastly, I need a [pair of wings] from an apple fly. I suggest you get the items sooner rather than later. The longer we wait, the harder it will be for me to garnish whatever information I can from this metal bit. Welcome back friend. I take it you were successful in retrieving the items I sent you after. If you were, please hand the Wearyall Tree Bark to me first. Now, for the Drakoran Golden Orb please. This is an absolute must for my ritual. Yes. Quite nice. And in excellent condition too. Now, for the apply fly wings. I hope they weren't too diffucult for you to obtain. Most excellent. You have done well my friend, and I am please with what you have brought me. Now, if you will please wait, I will begin. It's done my friend. I'm afraid that <Player> is no longer among the land of the living. A forged creature did take his life, along with several others. You should return to Achae Smith with this information.||||And what might I be able to do for you today? Ah, my dear friend Gracien... I do wish he'd come here for a... visit. But, that's really not what you're here to discuss, is it? It says in this note that you have some metal bits for me to look at? Well, hand them to me. Yes, I can discover if it was indeed the creature that took the woman's uncle. But I need for you to fetch me some ingredients in exchange for the information. Here is the [list] of what I will need. First, I need a piece of bark from Brother Josef's tree. It's the large one on the hill over yonder, you can't miss it. Secondly, I need a Golden Orb from a Drakoran Mage. I'm afraid that <Player> is no longer among the land of the living. A forged creature did take his life, along with several others. You should return to Achae Smith with this information.|You need the metal bit I found? Well, alright. Gracien does know best I suppose. Here you are. I hope it helps to find my uncle! Please hurry froend! I want him home, safe and sound.||
rows.StepText: Speak with Gracien Adamson in Fort Gwyntell about the [forged servant].|Return to Achae and get the [metal bit] from her.|Show the metal bit to Gracien.|Take the note and metal bits to Wearyall Village and hand the note to Elyn Badam.|Search around the Wearyall Tree for a piece of its bark.|Find a Drakoran mage and retrieve its golden orb.|Get a pair of apple fly wings from the apple flies near Wearyall Hill.|Return to Elyn in Wearyall Village with all the items.|Return to Devwy and tell Achae that her uncle is [deceased].|Search for Thulin's remains among the forged servants.|Return Thulin's remains to Achae Smith.
rows.FinishText: This was <Player>'s most prized possession. He gave it to me before he left on his fatal trip, telling me it was time to pass it on to another. I know I can not put it to use, perhaps you can. Here is al littler coin as well. I know it isn't much, but perhaps it will aid you in your battles. Thank you again friend. Even though these are sad times, I am strenghtened by your courage and kind heartedness. Thank you.

rows.Name: Failing Magic
rows.Description: Another spelled failed. That has been happening more and more lately. I do not feel that my power has faded, nor do I detect it fading in Lurlei, yet together we only successfully cast half our spells, if even that many. And when we do cast protection spells around the armies, the Drakoran magic cuts right through them! Its like we have no resistance to their magic anymore! Lurlei and I fear that someone is [increasing their power] or weakening ours.
rows.SourceText: Thank you, <Player>! I shall not forget this. When you meet with Dory, tell him I sent you. In the meantime I will arrange for you to be properly rewarded for helping me out this way. I am counting on you to act in my name, <Player>. Make Avalon proud of you!|||||||Choose your reward: [Opalescent Longsword], [Lapis-Inlaid Spiked Mace], [Opaline Pike], [Onyx-tipped Cat o' Nine Tails], [Jade-tipped Longbow], [Gem Flecked Quarterstaff], [Crystal-Topped Staff], [Ruby-Topped Staff], [Bloodstone-topped Staff], [Sapphire-topped Staff].
rows.TargetText: You've got some nerve, <Player>? Speaking to me after what you did? Don't try to look innocent! You got me in trouble with General Wystan and if wasn't for the intervention of Eilwen and Lurlei he'd have shipped me back to Camelot by now. You had better have a bloody good reason for bothering me. Oh, so she did? She must not have realized that you were the one who got me in trouble with Wystan because I doubt she would have sent you otherwise. Let's see if you can keep your mouth shut this time if you're asked to. Now, since Eilwen sent you, I'm sure you know about [her little problem]. I've been working on solving that problem for her. See, I can do good things, contrary to what Wystan believes! In my, um, profession, I have quite a few contacts. When I heard the rumors that the Inconnu were responsible for Eilwen's failing spells, I asked around and got an answer from a fine Cabalist. She assured me that the Inconnu were not responsible for Eilwen's problems. I bet you think I'm lying, but I'm not! Brishene is an Inconnu and I think she knows what she's talking about. Brishene is not one to lie, even if she is a member of the Guild of Shadows! She identified the cause as Morgana and has begun to [search for a solution]. Since Eilwen is not here, I guess I'll have to tell you of what Brishene has found so far to help with the solution. She spent good gold getting this information, so keep your mouth closed and your ears open! Long ago, before the coming of the Drakoran, a cabalist named Meical became fed up with the war raging between the three lands. He had seen too many friends and enemies die and it pushed him over the edge of sanity. He became obsessed with creating life, not destroying it. Meical fled the mainland for the Dales of Devwy and built a hall to lock himself away [from the world]. Yes, Meical did not want to have any dealings with the people of this world. Instead he set about fulfilling his obsession. Using his magical skills, he began to create new creatures out of rope and wood and metal. But Meical's insanity warped his magic and over time the creatures developed the same insanity that possessed Meical. The creatures rose up and killed Meical, then spread into the surrounding area where they still roam today. But [Brishene discovered] something about those creatures. The magic that animates them seems to be undimished, unlike the magic of the Avalonians. Brishene doesn't know why, but she's trying her best to find out what's going on. Since you ratted me out to Wystan before, you're going to make up for it now! Brishene thinks there's a sphere of metal [in the creatures] that contains a bit of their magic and she wants to study it. Brishene asked me to get the spheres from the forged servants that roam around outside Meical's Hall. She wants two so she can conduct her experiments on them. I need you to go out and get the spheres for Brishene. Wystan is watching me closely so I can't leave the Caer to go do it myself. When you have the spheres, go to Brishene at Wearyall Village. She will be waiting for you there. You took your time getting back here, <Player>. I still wonder if I can trust you. Hopefully you weren't off reporting my every move to Wystan again. I see you carry a scroll with you. Is that my death order or something else? Hrmph. It appears that you did a decent job for Brishene. She says she's learning quite a bit about those creatures of Meical's. I have another meeting with Eilwen soon and I shall share this information with her. I still don't like you, but Eilwen seems to. She sent over weapons that were saved when Avalon was destroyed. You are to [choose one] that suits your needs. I hope I can trust you to continue to help Eilwen with this problem, <Player>. Now listen closely, for you can only choose one and once you make your choice you can't change your mind. You may choose from one handed [slashing], two handed [crushing], or a [thrusting] polearm a slashing [flexible] weapon, a [long bow], a [quarterstaff], or a [caster staff]? Here is your Gem Flecked Quarterstaff. Use it well, <Player>.|||Greetings, <Player>. Dory sent word to me that you would be coming to see me and be bringing me the spheres that I need. Please give the first sphere. Good, now the second one? Thank you, <Player>. I will begin my experiments but I wish I had [my pendant]. It is a pendant that allows me to focus my magic so that I may use it better. Dory wanted to borrow it to show it to Eilwen but some petty thief stole it from him before he could return it to me. I have [tracked its location] but I must begin working right away or I would go retrieve it myself. Every minute I delay hurts Eilwen and the Avalonian armies. Apparently the thief either traded it or lost it to the hands of a Drakoran because I've tracked it to one of their camps. There is a Drakoran there named Barak. My sources tell me that you will find Barak in the camp that lies east from the great tree of Wearyall Hill. I must have that pendant if I am to do my research correctly. I can start without it, but it will be better with it. Return to me when you have my pendant. That did not take as long as I expected, <Player>. Were you able to obtain my pendant? I am in your debt. This will allow me to continue working with the second mechanism that you brought me. I have been able to discover that Meical imbued the spheres of each creature with magic from a source other than what the Avalonians draw upon. It is a powerful source that Eilwen may be able to use if we can discover a way to tap into it. I shall continue my research and hopefully have good news for Eilwen soon. rows.Name: Tyngyr's Daughter
rows.Description: My daughter is safe at Caer Witrin, but she lost some very [sentimental] items in the ruined keep to the south.
rows.SourceText: Recover the first item from a ghostly knight in the church ruins on the peninsula at the southeast corner of Lake Witrin.|||
rows.StepText: Recover the first item from a ghostly knight in the church ruins on the peninsula at the southeast corner of Lake Witrin.|Recover the bracelet from a water leaper in the small pond across the road.|Take the two items to Tyna Blade at Caer Witrin, between the guards and the stable.|Return the letter to Tyngyr Blade in Adribard's Retreat.

rows.Name: Amulet of the Planes
rows.Description: I can give you a very powerful amulet if you follow my [instructions].

rows.Name: Weakened Bonds
rows.Description: The druids draw on the ley lines of [Salisbury]. Speak with Scout Dherin at the watch tower south of Castle Sauvage.
rows.TargetName: Scout Dherin;1|Gral Bermorn;1|giant skeleton;1|||||||||Archdruid Glasan;1|Gral Bermorn;1
rows.SourceText: Speak with Scout Dherin atop the watch tower just south of Castle Sauvage.||||||||||||
rows.TargetText: |Within Salisbury there exist eleven druid circles, eight major, three minor, and the axis circle where you obtained the darkenstone. Of the three minor circles, one lay in the south and two in the north. All others can be considered major including Stonehenge itself. If a darkenstone is taken into any of these circles, the holder will be made aware if it is major or minor. Each of the minor circles can be instructed to offer up a ley crystal by using the darkenstone. It will be the ley crystal that will allow you to [ switch ] the wells on. As the last rays of light fade from Salisbury, travel to each major druid ring and make use of your crystal. The crystal will be crushed in the process and will activate the ring's well. As Morgana's power has hold of the tombs below these rings, I am unsure what the mix of necromantic power and ley energy will have upon you and the circle itself. Be prepared for anything! If you find yourself without a ley crystal return to a minor circle and use the darkenstone to gain another. If you are foolish enough to lose your darkenstone, you may return to the [ axis circle ] and kill a skeleton to obtain another. All seven of the wells can only be activated using darkness. If dawn arrives and you have not visited all seven you must wait till the next night to complete the ritual. When you have established the alignment of these ley lines, travel to the heart of Stonehenge and use your darkenstone for the final time. Upon the stone's destruction the bonds that tie the portal close should ignite and allow it to be [ opened from the other side ]. You must be ready for Glasan at this point. When the arch druid arrives, you will have little time to attack him, as his power will grow quickly. If you are successful in slaying him, the staff should shatter on its own. Any shards left from the battle must be returned to me! Here, take these instructions to aid you. Good luck to thee Theurgist.|||||||||||Within Salisbury there exist eleven druid circles, eight major, three minor, and the axis circle where you obtained the darkenstone. rows.Name: Long Lion Fang
rows.Description: I will make you a weapon if you bring me the [materials].

rows.Name: Undead Infestation
rows.Description: Hello there friend. Welcome to the Isle of Glass. I am Eafa Thatcher, local to these parts. Well, maybe not a true local, in the honest sense of the word, but a local now nonetheless. A [misplaced] local, if you will.
rows.SourceText: Speak to Kennard Jameson, the stable master by the main gate of Caer Gothwaite, and say Reabus. (whisper: Reabus)|||||
rows.TargetText: Ah, yes, Reabus Drakehide, I've heard of him. He used to come around here a lot, but he kind of disappeared about a week ago, if I remember correctly. You must be here from [Eafa Thatcher] aren't you? I figured as much. He's been trying to talk adventurers like you into getting rid of the undead around here for ages. Hehe. He still hasn't succeeded. You'd think he'd [stop trying] by now. Well, I know it isn't a noble thing to do, to give up, but he's met with a lot of failures in this undertaking. It is rather monumental. Still, if there's anything I can do to help, I will. Now, we were [talking] about Reabus, right? Reabus used to like to hang around one of the kitchen servants, a girl named Hanna. She was pleasing to the eyes, I suppose, but she was beneath his station. Not sure what he saw in her, but maybe you could talk with her first.||Wha...? Reabus has vanished? Oh! This is all my fault. Curse these attacks. I was unable to get to Caer Gothwaite because we had come under attack by a band of orcs, and travel was [prohibited]. Captain Denholm thought it would be best if those who could defend the Caer remain here. I send word to Reabus, but it must not have reached him in time. Well, if he truly is missing, then I will aid you in your efforts to find him. I don't care what Captain Denholm says, I shall leave this place. Return to Hanna in Caer Gothwaite. I shall meet you there shortly. Hanna and I have already spoken and she has given me as much information as possible. I see only one way to solve this mystery. First, you must travel to [Anniogel]. Hanna tells me Reabus's mount, <Player>, is still there. There may be some clue to his disappearance. Give this note to Toby Keller, the Stable Master there. He will help you. I can not discern what has happened to Reabus with just these pieces. I believe the hair belongs to a thrawn ogre, but I have [not known them] to harm passers-by, especially those on horseback. They were, at one time, allied with the Avalonians, but their help was shunned by the Avalonians when the Drakoran attacked Avalon. Though somewhat discouraged, they would not attack. This must be a [trick]. Until I can discern more information from these scraps, I'm afraid our search is at a standstill. I will stay here with Hanna and see what information can be gained from these pieces. Thank you friend. I'm sorry this couldn't have ended on a more positive note, but such is the way of the world, eh? I hope this coin and this item will be of use to you. Thank you again. Once I have some more information, we can find Reabus and punish those that would think to harm one of Albions' children...|Wha...? Reabus has vanished? Oh! This is all my fault. Curse these attacks. rows.SourceText: Speak with Kimmy Glaze in Anniogel.||
rows.StepText: Speak with Kimmy Glaze in Anniogel.|Seek out Commander Slor'vid at the campfire in the central of the three camps in the northwest of the Isle of Glass (midnight to 3 A.M.). Attack his lieutenants and he will show.|Take the commander's head to Frederik Rolby in Gothwaite Harbor. Turn in any lieutenant heads to Kimmy Glaze first!

rows.Name: Wizard's Demand
rows.Description: A wizard ordered magical gloves, but I am out of the special skin and my supplier is missing. Take this scrap of skin to Mathien in [Snowdonia] Station to identify.
rows.SourceText: Take the scrap of skin to Mathien in Snowdonia Station.||
rows.StepText: Take the scrap of skin to Mathien in Snowdonia Station.|The skin is from a frog named Worry Wort. You need a complete skin, so you may need to kill him more than once.|Return a complete skin to Yorel in Swanton Keep.

rows.Name: Impossible Mission
rows.Description: Your assistance is needed to investigate the [disappearance] of the city of Lyonesse. The journey will be difficult and long; seek Edmond upstairs in Cornwall Station.
rows.SourceText: Seek out Edmond upstairs in Cornwall Station.||||||
rows.StepText: Seek out Edmond upstairs in Cornwall Station.|Kill two undead farmers in Lyonesse. (1/2)|Kill two undead farmers in Lyonesse. (2/2)|Find the ruined temple and locate its guards. Approach slowly; do not fight them.|Return to Edmond in Cornwall Station.|A moor bogey called Yog has ambushed Edmond's men by the road to the Catacombs. Take care of him.|Return to Edmond.

rows.Name: Reports
rows.Description: I have three reports I have not had time to follow up. Take them, and a ticket to [Wearyall] Village.
rows.SourceText: Calikana report: go to the three rocks on the coast in Aldland southwest of Wearyall Village. The orc acolyte Calikana attacks.||||
rows.StepText: Calikana report: go to the three rocks on the coast in Aldland southwest of Wearyall Village. The orc acolyte Calikana attacks.|Undead report: in the ghost village northeast of Wearyall toward Avalon, kill an undead ganger (or a spirit at night) for proof that Morgana controls them.|Woman in Black report: hide by the boat near the stable, watch for the woman in black, then search the stable chest for what she hid.|Return to Mistress Eveleen in Caer Gothwaite.|Give the token to Armorer Gamila and choose a weapon.

rows.Description: Collect what I need to even the odds [against] the orcs.
rows.TargetName: sea slime;51|sea slime;51|sea slime;51|Veena;51|inishail fly;51|Veena;51|tidal mongrel;51|Veena;51

rows.Name: Fall of an Emperor
rows.Description: Aye! The catacombs have stood for hundreds of years, weathering those who crawl about within and the attempts to steal what riches still remain. Vagabonds I tell you! The tomb is a place of the dead and should not be disturbed by those whose hearts still beat! While I too yearn to know what lay deep within its [hidden depths], I will not desecrate the emperor's tomb.
rows.TargetName: Iohannes Aldar;1|Spirit of the Emperor;23|Olivarius Princeps Praetorii;23||Taras Princep Praetorii;23||Crotus Princeps Praetorii;23||Amminus pilus;23||Emperor Seleucus;23|Iohannes Aldar;1|Grindan Halig;1|Grindan Halig;1
rows.SourceText: Travel to Cornwall Station and speak to Iohannes Aldar of the [catacombs].|||||||||||||Choose your reward: [Cloak of the Latent], [Cloak of Renitency], [Cloak of the Vital], [Cloak of the Resolute].
rows.TargetText: Ah! You must speak of the Catacombs of Cordova! What a wonderful place of adventure this is. Lately the catacombs have become of greater interest to the adventures you see about you. It seems one foolhardy wizard was casting a spell within the depths of the catacombs and destroyed a wall. This wall appears to have been built to seal up the [lower levels] of the tomb. Not many have returned from this new area, but those who have carry with them fabulous stories. Thier stories speak of a long hall, a hall with a light at the end. Within that light exists a great and powerful undead roman general. I can only imagine what else may lay within this [new found chamber]! Yes! I almost forgot to mention the voices! Some spirit that inhabits the passageways about the main chamber speaks continually. This is quite odd as from what I have heard, most spirits and undead are unwilling to speak openly. I would be willing to [pay generously] to have on hand the words that are spoken of this spirit. Oh! You are offering your services then? This is great (class name)! You must depart immediately then. Travel into the deepest parts of the Catacombs of Cardova. Travel into these newly found chambers and locate the talkative spirit. I will await you here when you have found the words it speaks. Good luck (class name)! I welcome your return (class name). How goes the search for that spirit? Oh my! This is most remarkable! I can barely believe what it is I hold here! I do hope it wasn't too much trouble to obtain this. I have little to repay you with save my thanks and the promise that I shall tell your entire story. I think I will close my shop early today. I have much to read now. Thank you once again <Player>!|||||||||||Ah! You must speak of the Catacombs of Cordova! What a wonderful place of adventure this is. rows.StepText: Travel to Cornwall Station and speak to Iohannes Aldar of the [catacombs].|Locate the talkative spirit within the chamber of cleansing.|Kill Olivarius.|Offer his focus in the chamber of cleansing.|Kill Taras.|Offer his focus in the chamber of cleansing.|Kill Crotus.|Offer his focus in the chamber of cleansing.|Kill Amminus.|Offer his amulet in the crypt of the displaced soul.|Kill Emperor Seleucus in the chamber with the snakes.|Return to Iohannes Aldar and give him Seleucus' book of deeds.|Return to Grindan Halig and tell him the name of the Emperor. (whisper: Seleucus)|Choose your reward: whisper Grindan Halig the name of the item you want (Cloak of the Latent, Cloak of Renitency, Cloak of the Vital, Cloak of the Resolute).

rows.Name: Spirits of the Orchard
rows.Description: Speak with Karayan; [mention] that I sent you.
rows.SourceText: Tell Karayan that Madilen sent you; he gives you a potion.||||||||
rows.StepText: Tell Karayan that Madilen sent you; he gives you a potion.|Go to Afal Dyffryn north of Wearyall and kill Nalsor.|Give the potion to Tomos, who appears when Nalsor dies, and tell him to [pour it over the seeds].|Return Brent's seeds to his orchard (they glow when you are there).|Return Lenor's seeds to her orchard.|Return Andryw's seeds to his orchard.|Return Tomos' seeds to his orchard.|Give the pouch to Karayan.|Return to Madilen for your reward.

rows.Name: Black Plague
rows.Description: About sever days ago, one of the city guards became suddenly ill during the night and I was called to her bedside. The guard was crying and in severe pain. She said that her back felt like it was on fire. I rolled her on her side to look at her back and the smell of [rotthing flesh] filled the air.
rows.TargetName: Berenger Brennar;10|Gaevin Sebryn;10|Keenar Woedin;1|Gaevin Sebryn;10|Dartmoor pony;1|Sister Elaydith;10|Malroch the Cook;249|Sister Elaydith;10
rows.SourceText: Good. I will need all the help I can get. I would like you to go meet with Berenger Brenner. He is the guardian of one of the latest people to show signs of the disease. I would like you to try and discover anything you can about the strange illness. I will try to make another potion to cure it while you are gone. May the light of Camelot shine upon you, ______.|||||||
rows.TargetText: |What are ye looking at? Didn't your sire ever teach you not to stare? Anyway, it's not important. I told the clerics everything I know about how I became sick. I went to bed one night feeling fine and I awoke the next morning with my back feeling like I had slept on a bed of hot coals. I haven't left the city in the past few weeks and I haven't been around sick people, at least none that looked [sick]. I have heard rumors spreading around the city about people falling ill, but the guards are keeping a tight lip if you ask them what is happening. I think the king is trying to keep this sickness a secret so people don't panic. Can I tell you my own [secret]? I am really scared, ______. I am putting a brave face on so that the city guard, Berenger, doesn't lock me up. I don't think I will live to see the next full moon. Can you do me a [favor], ______?' I need a message delivered to my hometown so they know what is going on. If I die, I don't want them to think I left home because of them. I just needed to get out and see the world, [understand]? I am sure you do. You seem the adventurous sort yourself. Now take this sealed letter to my brother, Keener, in Ludlow. He will make sure my parents get it. Tell him not to worry about me. He will know something is wrong when he gets my letter because I haven't tried to wrote to my parents in years. [Hopefully], the cleric will find a cure before you return. If not, I may not be hear to learn of any news you bring back. Now get out of here! I am tired of looking at your ugly mug. Thank you for bringing me this note. I am glad my parents know I am sick, but I am not sure I remember your name, <Class>. I haven't been [feeling] well lately at all. I can't lie down to sleep anymore. It causes so much pain if I touch the sores. I am getting sicker and I am so scared. A [strange man] came to visit me while you were gone. He was dressed in long robes and said he was Marquis Sabonach. That man did not look like a noble at all. He whispered some strange words in my ear and said I would be [ok]. He lied. I even feel worse than yesterday. My body hurts too much for me to try lying down again. I don't know what I am going to do. I hope the Healer has a cure for me soon. Could you ask Berenger if he has heard anything yet? I know Berenger thiks I have lost my mind but I am fooling him. Tehe haha.||What are ye looking at? Didn't your sire ever teach you not to stare? rows.StepText: Meet with Berenger Brennan, who watches over Gaevin.|Speak with Gaevin Sebryn.|Take the sealed letter to Gaevin's brother Keener Woedin in Ludlow.|Bring Keener's note back to Gaevin.|Go to Dartmoor and kill a Dartmoor pony for the horse fungus.|Return to Sister Elaydith.|Go into Darkness Falls and kill Malroch the Cook.|Return to Sister Elaydith.
rows.FinishText: This one potion should be more than enough. You can keep the other potion for yourself. It's a very powerful potion, so use it when in dire straights. I must begin to cure the other stricken people. You have earned a friend for life, ______. I shall remember your name if I am ever in need of help again.

rows.Name: Engraved Insignia Ring -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Kill the undead [northeast] of Avalon City and return their engraved insignia rings to me.
rows.SourceText: Bring Augebert, a guard on the north side of Wearyall, engraved insignia rings.
rows.StepText: Bring Augebert, a guard on the north side of Wearyall, engraved insignia rings.

rows.Name: Crushed Faith
rows.Description: See Sir Benitt in Castle Sauvage about a [glacial] hammer.
rows.TargetName: Sir Benitt;1|hill scrag;1|Sir Benitt;1|Snowdon Grim;1|Sir Benitt;1|grave goblin;20|Sir Benitt;1|Dash;1|Sister Rhigwyn;10|Sister Rhigwyn;10
rows.SourceText: Speak with Sir Benitt in Castle Sauvage.|||||||||Choose your reward: [Glacial Hammer], [Glacial Long Hammer], [Dash's Long Hammer].
rows.StepText: Speak with Sir Benitt in Castle Sauvage.|Seek the glacial hammer at the hill scrag camp west of Castle Myrddin.|No hammer. Return to Sir Benitt.|Kill the Snowdon Grim at the Snowdonia/Pennine pass.|Still no hammer. Return to Sir Benitt.|Kill a grave goblin in the Barrows.|Return to Sir Benitt.|Kill Dash, who appears at night south of Caer Boldiam tower 3 by the grimwoods and cockatrices.|Bring the hammer to Sister Rhigwyn.|Choose your reward: whisper Sister Rhigwyn the name of the item you want (Glacial Hammer, Glacial Long Hammer, Dash's Long Hammer).

rows.Name: The Forest Plot
rows.Description: The Mist Hunters need a scout's bow: kill a gytrash in the Pennines and an Arawnite shamaness in [Snowdonia].
rows.SourceText: Kill a gytrash in the Pennine Mountains (midnight to 6 A.M.).||
rows.StepText: Kill a gytrash in the Pennine Mountains (midnight to 6 A.M.).|Kill an Arawnite shamaness outside Snowdonia Fortress, at the first camp fire on the right.|Return to Rob Ria for your reward.

rows.Name: Zombies, Ghosts, and Necromancers
rows.Description: <Player>, is something wrong? I feel like something has been wrong for some time. I talk to the Swett's, and they say the same thing. Funny. I haven't talked to them in such a long time, and they are only next door. Do you [understand]?
rows.TargetName: Avice Swett;51|Eabae Dale;51|Avalonian Apparition;51|Priest of Arawn;51|Avice Swett;51|Necromantic Apprentice;51|Avice Swett;51|Avice Swett;51
rows.SourceText: Oh! Thank you! I hope you can help us! Try talking to Everard. Lucia only mumbles about going to the market. I think she is more affected by this than the rest of us.|||||||Choose your reward: [Hooded Blades Cloak], [Hooded Magic Cloak], [Hooded Shadow Cloak], [Hooded Pious Cloak].
rows.TargetText: |||<Player>, what brings you out here, to this remote land? Ah! This is a charm used by the drakoran mystics! We've been trying to acquire them, to try and find weaknesses in their magic. They are trying to use dark magics they don't understand, but we do. We ar hoping we can use their ignorance against them. Here, for that, I shall give you this, it is a sword forged in the realm of the dead, in the forges of Arawan. I know a bit about the workings of this world, and even more of the other. I know that there is someone who needs this sword. Be sure it gets to him.||||
rows.StepText: Talk to Avice Swett, standing next to Eabae Dale in the apparition houses near Fort Gwyntell.|Talk to Eabae Dale.|Kill one of the Avalonian apparitions around the ghost houses.|Talk to the Priest of Arawn in Fort Gwyntell.|Tell Avice Swett to [take the rod] and give it to her.|Kill the Drakoran necromancer's apprentice across the wooden bridge from the fort.|Bring the apprentice's rod of necromancy to Avice.|Choose your reward: whisper Avice Swett the name of the item you want (Hooded Blades Cloak, Hooded Magic Cloak, Hooded Shadow Cloak, Hooded Pious Cloak).

rows.Name: Voices of the Dead
rows.Description: I hear voices, and I am too weak to stop them. Speak to [Karayan].
rows.SourceText: Speak to Karayan in Wearyall Village.||||
rows.StepText: Speak to Karayan in Wearyall Village.|Arawn requires a spirit: kill a decaying marshman north of the city.|Take the spirit back to Karayan.|Kill Kelsanor in the ruins east past the lone tree on the hill. At low health he warps attackers away.|Take the essence back to Karayan.

rows.Name: Prelude to War
rows.Description: Take this note to [Lieutenant] Kuebler in Castle Sauvage.
rows.TargetName: Lieutenant Kuebler;1|boggart;1|Sage Lissa;1|Lieutenant Kuebler;1|Albion Scout;1|ellyll villager;1|ellyll villager;1|ellyll villager;1|Albion Scout;1|Saffron;1|Lieutenant Kuebler;1
rows.SourceText: Take the note to Lieutenant Kuebler in Castle Sauvage.||||||||||
rows.StepText: Take the note to Lieutenant Kuebler in Castle Sauvage.|Kill boggarts southwest of Caer Erasleigh to learn what they carry.|Take the runed metal bars to Sage Lissa in the tower southeast of Ludlow.|Return to Lieutenant Kuebler.|See the Albion scout in the Pennine Mountains.|Destroy the small Ellyll village over the next hill (not the main Ellyll camp). (1/3)|Destroy the small Ellyll village over the next hill (not the main Ellyll camp). (2/3)|Destroy the small Ellyll village over the next hill (not the main Ellyll camp). (3/3)|Return to the scout.|Kill Saffron, a small named cockatrice in the trees in the valley southeast of Caer Sursbrooke.|Return to Lieutenant Kuebler.

rows.Name: Free the Rogue!
rows.Description: My friend Mercal is hiding near Krondon, the ogre [citadel]. Rescue him.
rows.SourceText: Go to the three barrels just left of the main Krondon entrance (a shadowy corner) and say Mercal's name. (whisper: Mercal)|||Choose your reward: [Ogre Bracer], [Shadow Cap], [Ogre's Prayer Stone], [Shadow Clasp], [Ogre's Pious Belt], [Ogre's Magical Belt].
rows.StepText: Go to the three barrels just left of the main Krondon entrance (a shadowy corner) and say Mercal's name. (whisper: Mercal)|Mercal thanks you and heads for Caer Diogel; talk to him there.|Give Mercal's documents to Arden, the instrument merchant in Caer Diogel.|Choose your reward: whisper Arden the name of the item you want (Ogre Bracer, Shadow Cap, Ogre's Prayer Stone, Shadow Clasp, Ogre's Pious Belt, Ogre's Magical Belt).

rows.Name: Lost Treasure
rows.Description: [Retrieve] three items for me so I can recover a magical statue.
rows.SourceText: Get an archiator hide from a Drakoran archiator just over the bridge southwest of Fort Gwyntell.||||||||Choose your reward: [Bracer of Health], [Bracer of the Strong], [Bracer of the Magical], [Bracer of Shielding], [Bracer of the Stealthy], [Pious Bracer], [Roguish Bracer], [Charismatic Bracer].
rows.StepText: Get an archiator hide from a Drakoran archiator just over the bridge southwest of Fort Gwyntell.|Get blue slime from a blue-green algae on the coast west of Caer Diogel.|Get apple tree sap from the lamia Larionne at the northern end of Clifton (talk if lamias are neutral, else kill her).|Use the slime.|Use the tree sap.|Use the knife with the archiator hide; an apple tree spirit appears. Talk to it.|Free the soul of the young sorceress Eralyne, a zombie at the graveyard near Caer Sidi.|Bring the statue to Ariette in the woods behind Fort Gwyntell and choose two different bracers.|Choose your reward: whisper Ariette the name of the item you want (Bracer of Health, Bracer of the Strong, Bracer of the Magical, Bracer of Shielding, Bracer of the Stealthy, Pious Bracer, Roguish Bracer, Charismatic Bracer).

rows.Name: Ogre's Might
rows.Description: Good day, though any day you're alive these days is a good day, eh? How do you get on with those of the [Ogre Citadel]?
rows.SourceText: This item, now, it's in the Ogre Citadel, deep within, a chamber open to the stars. I don't know how to get in it, but I know the ogre there, his name is Scurceol Hydre, and he calls himself a star channeler! He is said to be channeling power from the heavens! Heresy, some say, but there is one who claims to have seen this powerful channeler! Speak to Arden in Caer Diogel about the star channeler. Tell him you're crazy enough to seek out the powerful talisman he's created.|||||
rows.TargetText: Greetings friend. What brings you to old Arden? Ah. The star channeler. The ogre that calls himself that. Rory, my good, and often absent, friend, knows a bit about this ogre and his [power]. Rory says the ogres don't have magic, and that this one Ogre, he was talking about natural powers that had more to do with a science of application rather than spells and incantations! How absurd, I say! Let the ogres believe what they will, but I know magic, and what this self-claimed star channeler does is not [science] but magic. Science. Call it what you will. Here is what Rory says happens. There is a room inthe citadel under the stars. There are four golden rings. Rory said the star channeler, named Scurceol Hyrde, calls them nodes. The nodes are powerful. The seem to protect the star channeler. His name is Scurceol Hyrde. I don't pretend to konw how it all works. I can't even tell you how to defeat Scurceol Hyrde, but I know the room is very [dangerous]. Rory only said the room meant death for anyone not meant to enter. The nodes, he says, semms to be collecting power from the stars! He said storms often brew in the room. He says the ogre that calls himself the star channeler wields lightening! Now, it won't be easy getting in to this chamber, but if you want, I know who has a [map] to the chamber! The ogre Malefact. He holds a map. I know this because Rory has tried to obtain this map. Normally, I would get Rory to sneak in, but Rory is missing, lost somewhere in the ogre fortress! Ah, but kill Malefact, and you will have your map. The map will guide you to the star channeler's chamber.|||||
rows.StepText: Talk to Arden about the [star channeler].|Kill Malefact near the entrance in the Outerworld of Krondon to obtain the map to the star channeler's chamber.|Use the map to read it.|Follow Malefact's directions through the citadel (veer left after entering; straight, right, first left; straight, left; straight to worked stone; to the end, left, right), receiving a key piece at each point.|Defeat Scurceol Hyrde, the star channeler. Deal with the nodes first; the room is very dangerous.|Return the strange orb to Master Xavier in Caer Diogel.
rows.FinishText: Ah! Well, to be honest, I have no idea what this is! But I will find out. I'm sure it is something that can be used to counter the magic of the Midgard shamans! Thank you my friend, thank you! Oh here, let me take that map as well. You don't need it!

rows.Name: Orcs with Spellbooks
rows.Description: The orcs have stolen [Avalonian] tomes. Help me take them back.
rows.SourceText: Kill orc soothsayers at the orc camp northwest across the lake until you get the Avalonian tome.|||||

rows.Name: Restoring the Magic
rows.Description: I feared for your safety, <Player>! When Adelon sent word that you were going to take on Meical, I became worried. I have heard rumors about him that scared even me! Were you able to obtain [anything] from him?
rows.SourceText: Why, this box is locked. Do you have the key for it?|||||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Adelon on the hill outside Fort Gwyntell, right of the gate, near a small tree.|In Meical's house below the tower, get Meical's key.|On the second floor, get a metal sphere.|In the tower, give the orb to the lifeless creation and attempt to bring it to life.|Kill the Cabalist Meical when he comes to defend his creation.|Use the key to open Meical's box, and read his note.|Stand in the middle of the broken orb in the tower and use the pendant to cleanse it.|Return to Lady Lurlei in Caer Gothwaite with the box.

rows.Name: Basilisk Feather -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Hello there, what a fine day. I only wish I had more time to spend outdoors. I've taken up a new hobby, I'm [learning to track]. It's fascinating to be able to read the signs of a person or creature's passage.
rows.SourceText: Kill western basilisk, western basilisk youth and bring Brach Leof the Basilisk Feather.
rows.StepText: Kill western basilisk, western basilisk youth and bring Brach Leof the Basilisk Feather.

rows.Name: Strange Bedfellows
rows.Description: Oh my friend, you have finally returned. I have been looking everywhere for you. So much has happened since I saw you last. Where do I [begin].
rows.SourceText: Now you may be asking yourself why I called upon you again. It seems you were asked for [directly] <Player>.|||||
rows.TargetText: Eh? What do you think you are [looking] at, ugly (your characters race)? What? Are you as stupid as you look? Maybe not, eh. You come down here with big ideas and try to do good deeds. I say the faster you go get yourself killed, the better. Wait a [second]! You are that idiot who killed Malroch. Hehe, that was pretty foolish of you. Everyone in Darkness Falls has heard of you and is looking to cash in on the [bounty] for your head. What? Do you think mortals are the only ones who use bounties? Any demon that slays you is supposed to be rewarded by the Master, but I have seen how he rewards his followers. I used to be one of the strongest demons in the Master's army and now look at me. The Master changed me into an imp as [punishment] for something I had nothing to do with. How was I supposed to know the Master already had a plan? Anyway now I am really upset and I need your help to get some revenge on a few demons. If you help me I will tell you things that may just keep you alive a tad longer in the future. Let's say I know something about an ambassador that has been helping the lands of Albion to an early [demise]. I thought that might get your attention, but before I start telling what I know, I want some proof that you can handle yourself in battle. After all, you might have just been lucky when you beat the poor old Malroch. I want you to sneak into the area where the dragon of your land sleeps and return with something for me. You do this for me and I will tell you something of what I [know]. Let's see. What should I have you get, eh? I know! I want a granite gem from a granite giant stonebreaker living in southwestern [Dartmoor]. They dig up some very interesting gems in those mountains. If you are wondering if you can trust me, don't worry your mind any longer. You can trust me, and I can't trust you. That keeps things simple in our future dealings. Now bring me what I want and stop wasting my time. [Step 3] Journey to southwestern Dartmoor and retrieve Granite Gem from a granite giant stonebreaker. Killed Granite Giant Stonebreaker at Dartmoor loc=11k 43k, got gem. Back to Mystemas in DF. Oh, you are back. I suppose you have what I asked for? Well maybe you are not as weak as I thought, but certainly as smart as I thought. So lets talk shall we? I know a few things that would turn you pale with fear. What do I [know], you ask? Well I am glad that you asked. My Master has sent forth an ambassador to your lands to convince your king that the main threat to Albion from the other realms is far greater than the [threat] darkness falls presents. This was done to increase the casualties on both sides of your stupid war. Each time a mortal falls in combat, we take a small portion of that creature's spirit and create one of the soultorn that roam deeper in Darkness Falls. The soultorn are then trained to fight in my Master's armies. See the brilliance of this [plan]? The more you fight, the more you die. The more you die, the stronger we get. Hehe, very nice eh? Master also has a method to get the freshest and strongest of your [spirits]. He watches which of your three realms is strongest on the field of battle and then allows only that realm to directly enter Darkness Falls. We can make far stronger soultorn from those that die here. In fact, once in a while we get very lucky and trap an entire creature's spirit here. There has been an especially strong [soultorn] captured recently. She was a foolish healer named Caisha who came here looking for her lost friend. Now our Princess is torturing her spirit so we can make it into a succubi. Prince Ba'alorian wants to use her in his army as a high priestess or something. Wait, I have an [idea]. You might be able to help both of us at the same time. The Ambassador normally stays at the Princess's side. You will need proof to take to your king that he is being lied to and the Ambassador should be carrying plans from the Prince that will help convince your king. You can help me by taking [Caisha's spirit]. If the Prince has her for a high priestess, I doubt I will ever get a chance to gain my Master's favor again. I would surely like to see the Prince's plan fail miserably and you would provide me the means to do that. So let me make it clear what you [need to do]. First, slay the ambassador and get his pouch of documents to take back to your king or whatever. Second, slay the Princess and her followers. You mst then slay Caisha's soultorn to release her spirit from its torment. Take this Soulstone. It will capture Caisha's spirit when she is slain so that no other demon captures her. Oh, one other [thing]. If you get captured, I will do everything within my power to ensure the inquisitors shred every last piece of your spirit before you can tell anyone our little plan. Do you [Understand] me? Good. Now get going before someone sees us talking. Bring me Caisha like a good little (minstrel) Reward: Perfect Life Stone Free account required to post You must log in or create an account to post messages. Each time a mortal falls in combat, we take a small portion of that creature's spirit and create one of the soultorn that roam deeper in Darkness Falls. The soultorn are then trained to fight in my Master's armies. See the brilliance of this [plan]? The more you fight, the more you die. The more you die, the stronger we get. Hehe, very nice eh? Master also has a method to get the freshest and strongest of your [spirits]. He watches which of your three realms is strongest on the field of battle and then allows only that realm to directly enter Darkness Falls. We can make far stronger soultorn from those that die here. In fact, once in a while we get very lucky and trap an entire creature's spirit here. There has been an especially strong [soultorn] captured recently. She was a foolish healer named Caisha who came here looking for her lost friend. Now our Princess is torturing her spirit so we can make it into a succubi. Prince Ba'alorian wants to use her in his army as a high priestess or something. Wait, I have an [idea]. You might be able to help both of us at the same time. The Ambassador normally stays at the Princess's side. You will need proof to take to your king that he is being lied to and the Ambassador should be carrying plans from the Prince that will help convince your king. You can help me by taking [Caisha's spirit]. If the Prince has her for a high priestess, I doubt I will ever get a chance to gain my Master's favor again. I would surely like to see the Prince's plan fail miserably and you would provide me the means to do that. So let me make it clear what you [need to do]. First, slay the ambassador and get his pouch of documents to take back to your king or whatever. Second, slay the Princess and her followers. You mst then slay Caisha's soultorn to release her spirit from its torment. Take this Soulstone. It will capture Caisha's spirit when she is slain so that no other demon captures her. Oh, one other [thing]. If you get captured, I will do everything within my power to ensure the inquisitors shred every last piece of your spirit before you can tell anyone our little plan. Do you [Understand] me? Good. Now get going before someone sees us talking. Bring me Caisha like a good little (minstrel) Reward: Perfect Life Stone Free account required to post You must log in or create an account to post messages. rows.FinishText: The imp may simply be trying to lure you back into Darkness Falls so the foul creatures may have their revenge against you. In any case, you should be very careful and not trust a thing the imp says. I wish you luck, my friend, and a safe journey. rows.Name: Magic for Torrance
rows.Description: Blessings upon you this night, <Player>. Your progress has been not gone unobserved. Each day you walk the Path of Affinity brings you closer to being one with Nature. Yet there are many unnatural things that threaten both the world around and us. I have received word from one who strives beyond all others to remove the unnatural and restore the balance to this land. Her name is Ciarda and she is the trainer of Druids that walk the Path of Harmony. She desires that [all join together] and aid her in this fight.
rows.SourceText: The earth and the sky sing with happiness that you join in this endeavor. Go now to Ciarda, for she awaits you. She will tell you more of the work she and the Druid Torrance are doing.|||
rows.StepText: Go to Ciarda, the Druid trainer. (whisper: tap into the same magic)|Get a root from a tendril weed.|Get a hoof from a callow forest grazer.|Return to Ciarda with the root and the hoof.

rows.Name: Silver Run
rows.Description: <Player>, You're familiar with Crace by now, right? He's got a scheme, and he wants help. He's found a trader in silver who claims to have some [special] silver.
rows.SourceText: I'm sure Crace will reward you again. Talk to Crace, he'll tell you more.||||
rows.TargetText: Ah, you're here to help me, are you? <Player>, you know about the [enchanted silver] in the Silvermine Mountains, in Hibernia? Aye, <Player>, it's mainly controlled by those evil siabra local to the area, however, I've a friend who has managed to get a large amount of the silver. See, we've come up with a trade. The next boat leaves for Hibernia shortly, and I don't have the time to go and get everything to trade myself. See, there are many things here that may be valuable back in the mainland. I've arranged a trade. All I need right now, though, is two sporites. <Player>, <Player>, did you get the sporites? i understand that if you dry them out, they become quite useful. <Player>, that's what some of the Sylvan have told me! Oh, this is a good one! I need just one more from you. Do you have it? Great. Now, I just need one more thing. Now, have you seen the precocious cniogcrags? I would like one of them. I've a friend who wants it for display, why, I don't know. He wants to hang it on his wall. As an exotic type of beast. Oh, did you get the creature? Hand it over! Ah, great! Thank you! Now, you certainly should receive a [reward] for your efforts! Here, you surely do. I hope you find it useful, <Player>! Thanks again for your help! Hopefully, this enchanted silver my, ahh, friend, is sending will make a difference here!||||Ah, you're here to help me, are you? <Player>, you know about the [enchanted silver] in the Silvermine Mountains, in Hibernia? rows.Name: Slevin's Powder
rows.Description: Have you time to do a favor for me? I've [promised] Slevin some mist powder. It's very hard to get, and he's paid me quite some money in advance, but I can't travel with this fever I've got. There's some money for you, if you do.
rows.SourceText: Here, take the powder to Slevin at the guard tower on the road past the bridge. You can keep the portion of the money he pays you, for your effort.|
rows.TargetText: Hi. Brave aren't you, coming out here? What can I do for you? Ah, you've brought me the mist powder promised me! Thank you. This will bring me a nice fortune. Here, now, here's the portion I prmoised Bran. Now, have you heard of [Roane Maidens]?|Hi. Brave aren't you, coming out here? What can I do for you? Ah, you've brought me the mist powder promised me! Thank you. This will bring me a nice fortune. Here, now, here's the portion I prmoised Bran. Now, have you heard of [Roane Maidens]?
rows.StepText: Bring the mist powder to Slevin at the guard tower across the bridge from Connla.|Speak with Slevin about [Roane Maidens]. (whisper: Roane Maidens)

rows.Name: Tadhg's Lost Treasure
rows.Description: Greetings friend. I welcome you to Connla. I know this is somewhat abrupt, but I don't suppose you're looking for a little [adventure], are you?
rows.SourceText: Great! This is wonderful. I'd truly appreciate your assistance in this matter. My mother gave me a special locket with her picture inside. I have always kept it with me, until it was taken. I know one of the beach rats has it. Please find it for me.|||
rows.TargetText: |Ah, you've found the necklace, but... where is the locket? Hmmm... I wonder if one of the crabs got to it... Do you think you could [check] and see if the crabs have my locket?||
rows.StepText: Kill a beach rat for the golden necklace.|Return the necklace to Tadhg in Connla.|Kill crabs until one drops Tadhg's locket.|Return the locket to Tadhg.
rows.FinishText: Oh! My locket! How can I thank you, <Player>. I know, here are a few silver pieces for all the trouble you've gone through.

rows.Name: Way of Arms -- Learn the Paths
rows.Description: Go and talk to each master of the paths, then [return] to me.
rows.SourceText: Talk to a master of the Path of Essence (Hero).|||
rows.StepText: Talk to a master of the Path of Essence (Hero).|Talk to a master of the Path of Harmony (Blademaster).|Talk to a master of the Path of Focus (Champion).|Return to your trainer.

rows.Name: Way of Magic - Learn the Paths
rows.Description: Hail. You've come to learn about the Path of Essence. Those who follow the Path of Essence believe that magic is part of everything, and is all around us. Enchanters believe magic is a tool, and we use that tool in [everything] we do.
rows.SourceText: To learn about the Path of Harmony, speak with the Mentalist Aindreas in Ardagh, south of Mag Mell, or Ena, in Tir na Nog. They know more about that path than any other.||
rows.TargetText: |You've come to learn about the Path of Harmony. Mentalists follow this path because we draw strength from the understanding that everything works together, that the magical world and the non-magical world are really the same world. There is a balance between magic and non-magic, It's only when both are used together that there is harmony. Seek out Coman, in Ardagh, or Aodh, in the city of Tir na Nog, to learn about the Path of Focus.|So, you have come to learn about the Path of Focus? Those that follow this path believe in directing the energy that permeates us into perfecting their skills. As an eldritch, I concentrate this energy into the practice of magic. Now that you understand the different paths open to you, I hope when your time comes, you will choose wisely. Choose the one you believe in, and then you will choose correctly.
rows.StepText: Learn about the Path of Essence (Anwar in Tir na Nog, or Cadalind at the guard tower north of Howth).|Learn about the Path of Harmony (Ena in Tir na Nog, Aindreas in Ardagh, or Keriann in Howth).|Learn about the Path of Focus (Aodh in Tir na Nog, Coman in Ardagh, or Cadalind).

rows.Name: Way of Stealth - Learn the Paths
rows.Description: I can teach you the Way of Stealth. Beyond the way lie two paths that you must choose from. I suggest you speak with a Ranger and a [Nightshade] now, to give you more time to consider your path.
rows.SourceText: Well, there are two paths you may choose from: The [Path of Essence] and the [Path of Focus].|
rows.TargetText: Yes, Nightshades do follow the Path of Essence. Is that so odd? Those who follow the Path of Essence believe that magic is a part of everything and everyone. We use that essence to achieve our own means. What else would we do? Speak with a Ranger, either Mavelle in Tir na Nog, outside Magmell, or Teague, further south, in Ardagh. From Howth, head North to Ardagh, and Northwest past Tir na mBeo.|Hail. It should come as no surprise to you that Rangers follow the Path of Focus. We believe in directing the energy that permeates us into perfection of our skills. In our field, concentration is essential, and distraction can be deadly. Now that you understand the different paths open to you, I hope when your time comes, you will choose wisely. Choose the one you believe in, and then you will choose correctly.
rows.StepText: Learn about the Path of Essence from Blathnaid in Tir na Nog, or Leachlainn in Ardagh.|Speak with a ranger, Mavelle outside Mag Mell or Teague in Ardagh.
rows.FinishText: Speak with either Blathnaid in Tir na Nog, or Leachlainn, in Ardagh, south on the road outside of Ardee, North from Howth, to learn about the Path of Essence.

rows.Name: Wild Wilderness
rows.Description: There was once a time when all of Hy Brasil was tame. There was once a time when nature's beasts were tame. Now, though, the creatures we once had no reason to fear, have become aggressive. They kill not just for food, but for pleasure. They no longer only kill their normal prey. Now, the [hunt] us.
rows.SourceText: Great! While you are at it, bring one of the lunger tails to Resalg. He will pay you well for it. He is trying to create some potion. I told him I'd acquire a tail for him.||
rows.TargetText: |What can I do for you, fine Forester? Ah! You've brought me a lunger tail! Now, I'm not sure if this is going to work, but I think it just might, yes, it just might. You see, I'm working on a special [formula]. Aye. It will calm down the maddened animals, I think. I can't truly be sure, but I'm hoping so! Some of the animals have even been mutated, since the Fomorian's arrival, you know. I blame the foulness of that maleficent race! I would like to aid the Sylvan, I would like to see this ravaged land restored, and the peaceful balance that has taken generations upon generations to develop, once again restored. Aye, and I'll not lie, but I'm willing to bet I'd have a name, if I were to aid the process in some way! Maybe some prestige! Ah, but to work, yes, to work now. Here, I shall pay you for this tail! Good day, friend!|What can I do for you, fine Forester? Ah! You've brought me a lunger tail! Now, I'm not sure if this is going to work, but I think it just might, yes, it just might. You see, I'm working on a special [formula]. Aye. It will calm down the maddened animals, I think. I can't truly be sure, but I'm hoping so! Some of the animals have even been mutated, since the Fomorian's arrival, you know. I blame the foulness of that maleficent race! I would like to aid the Sylvan, I would like to see this ravaged land restored, and the peaceful balance that has taken generations upon generations to develop, once again restored. Aye, and I'll not lie, but I'm willing to bet I'd have a name, if I were to aid the process in some way! Maybe some prestige! Ah, but to work, yes, to work now. Here, I shall pay you for this tail! Good day, friend!
rows.StepText: Kill a lunger just outside the gates of the Grove of Domnann for its tail.|Bring the tail to Resalg in the Grove of Domnann.|Talk to Resalg about the [formula]. (whisper: formula)

rows.Name: Connla's Fever
rows.Description: Help cure the fever in town: bring me two bits of mud and a [skeletal] pawn's shin bone.
rows.SourceText: Collect two bits of mud from the mudmen in the hills beside Connla. (1/2)|||
rows.StepText: Collect two bits of mud from the mudmen in the hills beside Connla. (1/2)|Collect two bits of mud from the mudmen in the hills beside Connla. (2/2)|Kill a skeletal pawn for its shin bone (or a sandman for a dried sand cake).|Bring the ingredients to Keaghan.

rows.Name: Please Deliver!
rows.Description: Greetings. Do you [have time] to do me a favor?
rows.SourceText: I appreciate [the favor]. I would deliver it myself, but it would look a bit suspicious if it came from me. It involves some information I've acquired.
rows.TargetText: Are you interested in purchasing something? Or do you have [other business] with me? Ah you are here to deliver a letter? I am expecting one from Tir na mBeo. May I have the letter? Thank you. Wait a moment please. I hope you don't mind if I read this out loud: Cyana is training hard to be a Stalker. Please, if it's not too much trouble, help acquaint Cyana to the area by sharing some local tales. Well, I suppose no harm could come from telling you of the Lough Derg Lake monsters, eh? We call it Caoranoch. Not sure if there's more than one, but let me tell you, the creature is huge! A giant worm! The say they're all female. Say that the Caoranoch will devour a man whole! And keep it in its belly for weeks! Why, that fool Conan Mac Morna is now called Conan Muil! After being swallowed by that beast and suffering a lot of misfortune in her belly, he came out bald! Aye, I bet if you ever found him, he'd have a tale to tell, and a favor to ask, if that same demon still hunts the lake! Though I hear some tell the beast was throuwn in a lake in Lough Gur by an angry giant!
rows.StepText: Deliver the letter to Dirmyg at the merchant shops across from the guard tower south toward Tir na mBeo.
rows.FinishText: Deliver this letter to Dirmyg. He's usually found at the merchant shops across from the guard tower on the road south toward Tir na mBeo. If he's feeling talkative, he might even tell you about the Caoranoch.

rows.Name: Protecting the Groves
rows.Description: Welcome back. Mirari and I spoke recently. She complemented you on your skills in retrieving the lost pouch of seeds. She's taken those seeds and sprouted them. She showed me some of the seedlings and the ones [under her care] are doing well.
rows.SourceText: Mirari and I both had a feeling you would say yes. She asked that you come to her now, so that she may tell you more of what she needs. Go to her now, and show the Fomorian they destroy the precious spirit of the Sylvan!||
rows.TargetText: Blessings of the Grove upon you. It is good to see you again. Since you retrieved the seed pouch for me I have not seen any creatures prowling around the chests again. I offer the thanks of the Grove for that. Those seeds have begun to sprout and I have planted some of the seedlings outside the walls of the Grove. But I fear [for their safety]. Shortly after I planted them, I noticed some tracks around the seedlings. Then yesterday morning, as the sun's rays touched the leaves and filled the world with warmth, I went to the grove of seedlings. I was saddened by what I saw. Many of the seedlings had been dug up! Their delicate roots had been ripped from the ground and their tender leaves eaten. Out of the corner of my eye, I [saw the creatures] I belieave are responsible for this horrible act! A pair of forest grazer calves slunk off into the trees. I am sure that they are the creatures that are tearing up my seedlings and feasting upon them. Before the Fomorian came, the calves never bothered the seedlings but ate the grass instead. I fear that the change in their habits has been caused by the evil of the Fomorian. Some of these seedlings are the last of their kind. You must [protect them]! Go now and seek out the forest grazer calves. I know you cannot stop all of them, but stopping two of them would help a great deal. I do not like to deal with creatures in this manner, but I must protect my trees at all costs! If they have any of my seedlings, bring them back to me and I shall try to save them. I wish you luck. Did the sun smile upon you? Were you able to rid the seedling grove of the horrible forest grazer calves? Did you retrieve any seedlings? Ah, this one is in poor condition, but that is not your fault. I shall do what I can to help bring it back. With warm sun and cool water it may grow yet. Did you find any more? This one is in much better condition! I shall replant this one soon. Only a few of the leaves are torn and the roots are not damaged. With a little care, this seedling will one day be a great tree that will withstand the evil of the Fomorian! I am in your debt! Twice now you have helped me save the trees. Please, take this in thanks and know that the trees shall soon whisper your name in praise. May the rain always be gentle upon your leaves!||Blessings of the Grove upon you. It is good to see you again. Some of these seedlings are the last of their kind. You must [protect them]! Go now and seek out the forest grazer calves. I know you cannot stop all of them, but stopping two of them would help a great deal. I do not like to deal with creatures in this manner, but I must protect my trees at all costs! If they have any of my seedlings, bring them back to me and I shall try to save them. I wish you luck. Did the sun smile upon you? I shall do what I can to help bring it back. With warm sun and cool water it may grow yet. Did you find any more? This one is in much better condition! I shall replant this one soon. Only a few of the leaves are torn and the roots are not damaged. With a little care, this seedling will one day be a great tree that will withstand the evil of the Fomorian! I am in your debt! Twice now you have helped me save the trees. Please, take this in thanks and know that the trees shall soon whisper your name in praise. May the rain always be gentle upon your leaves!
rows.StepText: Go speak with Miari in the Grove of Domnann.|Protect the seedlings: kill the forest grazer calves and recover the seedlings they took.|Return the seedlings to Miari.

rows.Name: Shade of a Grove
rows.Description: <Player>, I've spoken with Liisu. Do you know, she wants us to go after the [sylvanshades]!
rows.SourceText: Great! Talk with Liisu now.|||
rows.TargetText: Ah, <Player>, what would your name be? Ah. I did not expect anyone so soon. But I'm glad you are here. You are here to help me, right? I would like you to save a grove that the lesser sylvanshades are doing quite a destructive number on. These groves have been with us for so long, and we've lost so many already. Please, help us save this one! I need yo uto go find two of the lesser sylvanshades that are wrecking this grove! Rrturn them to me when you have them. Please find them before there is no chance for me to heal the grove! Bring me anything you find on them please! I've lost so many seeds! Oh, <Player>, have you found two of my seed pouches? I think there are more, but so many have offered to aid me that I've gottem most of them back, and haven't had time to count it! I'm going to plant these in the groves that were damages. Maybe the new growth will stimulate the groves! I am horrified that the sylvanshades even exist! It does make sense, though, with all the Fomorian evil corrupting the land. Well then, give it here! Oh great! This one is still full, too! The horrid beasts didn't eat many of the seeds from this pouch! You should have seen some of the ones I've gotten returned to me! Thank you, <Player>!|||Ah, <Player>, what would your name be? Ah. I did not expect anyone so soon. But I'm glad you are here. You are here to help me, right? I would like you to save a grove that the lesser sylvanshades are doing quite a destructive number on. These groves have been with us for so long, and we've lost so many already. Oh great! This one is still full, too! The horrid beasts didn't eat many of the seeds from this pouch! You should have seen some of the ones I've gotten returned to me! Thank you, <Player>!
rows.StepText: Speak with Liisu and tell her your name.|Help Liisu rid the area of lesser sylvanshades (right and down the hill from the Grove gate) and collect the two seed pouches she lost. (1/2)|Help Liisu rid the area of lesser sylvanshades (right and down the hill from the Grove gate) and collect the two seed pouches she lost. (2/2)|Return the seed pouches to Liisu.

rows.Name: Troya's Research
rows.Description: Welcome to Howth, <Player>, it's always nice to see a <Race> about. Do you [have time] to help me with a little project?
rows.SourceText: Wonderful! Here is what you must do. Out in the small grove on your way towards Ardagh live some water beetle larva. I need for you to get me the skin of one of these creatures. When you have it, return to me.|||
rows.TargetText: |Ah, the skin! Thank you so much. Here is a little something for your troubles. Now, for my second item. I need the [tibia] of a skeletal pawn. It is said the magical properties of the undead have yet to be fully understood.||
rows.StepText: Kill a water beetle larva for its skin.|Return the skin to Troya in Howth.|Kill a skeletal pawn for its tibia.|Return the tibia to Troya.
rows.FinishText: Oh, thank you, <Player> I know these will come in handy for my research. I hope this coin will serve you well in your coming days. Thank you again for your bravery and honesty.

rows.Name: Balance of Nature
rows.Description: Help a poor creature at the pond [southwest] of Tir na mBeo. Take this fish to appease him.
rows.SourceText: Give the fish to Sabha near the pond southwest of Tir na mBeo.
rows.StepText: Give the fish to Sabha near the pond southwest of Tir na mBeo.

rows.Name: Information is the Key
rows.Description: It is time you learned a bit about [Hibernia]. Speak with Merle. He is very old, and knows a lot about this land.
rows.SourceText: Speak with Merle about the Moonstone.|||||||||||
rows.TargetText: What brings one of Macigians out here? You don't think I [will speak] with you, do you? Aye, more visitors than I've had in years! More than I've wanted in years, or still want. Well, I might. Perhaps. If you bring me back the mud from four mudmen. It has its uses, you know. Yes, that will do. Then perhaps I will speak with you. Did you get me the mud? Ah this is good. I'll need three more. Yo udo know there's silver in these mountains? That's why all these siabra miners are crawling around here. Better. I'll want two more. Oh, you'll want to be careful in the mountains. I'd avoid them if I were you. Oooh, you've done well. I only need one more. Well then. You've kept your part. I'll speak of one thing with you. Which would you have me speak of, [the Unnamed One], [Lobais], or [Blaieseach]"? According to the journal you want to click on the Unnamed One. Ah yes, He seeks the Moonstone, rumored to be in Lough Derg. It's a powerful item of enchantment. If ye seek it, be careful, for many seek it. If you do find it, then beware, for Blaieseach will then seek you with his trackers.|||||||||||What brings one of Macigians out here? You don't think I [will speak] with you, do you? rows.Name: Information is the Key
rows.Description: What brings you out this far? Shouldn't you be training at your Master's knee child? Or do you think to connive [knowledge] out of me?
rows.TargetName: Maeve, the Crone;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|rat boy;200|Maeve, the Crone;200

rows.FinishText: Caithor is the Champion responsible for the enchantment placed on Edan. Duana, in retribution, placed her own enchantment on Caithor. For every hundred years that passes in the land of men, only a day passes for Caithor. He wanders the land, seeking out a child of Duana and Edan destined to retrieve the Moonstone. This will break the enchanetment Duana placed on him. Some say he seeks Fagan's death as well. *the Moonstone:

rows.Name: Magic in the Grove
rows.Description: Miari needs help again: the [Fomorian] evil makes her seeds grow wrong.
rows.SourceText: Speak with Miari.||||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Miari.|Kill three bantam shrouders behind the first guard tower for their tentacles. (1/3)|Kill three bantam shrouders behind the first guard tower for their tentacles. (2/3)|Kill three bantam shrouders behind the first guard tower for their tentacles. (3/3)|Give Miari the tentacles.|Take the amulet to Miari's grove, southwest of the city by a willow tree, and use it there.|Return to Miari.

rows.Name: Magical Disturbances
rows.Description: We could use your help again, with the young grove trees we are growing. We cultivate the grove trees, and grow them as our homes, naturally, without hurting them. It seems the growth is being [disturbed].
rows.SourceText: Great! Speak to Liisu then. She's very disturbed about this whole thing!||||||
rows.TargetText: Have you decided to help me? I figured I could count on you. You see, there is a natural balance we maintain with nature. We use our magic to form the grove trees. We were trying to grow a grove of young trees into a new residence. It was working fine. Now, though, something is [disturbing] this magic! Yes. The grove trees just aren't growing right! Some of them seem to be growing toward a malformed state! I'm not sure what it is! We don't think it's another form of magic interfering with it, since we can't detect any. We don't even know if it's intentional! But it's hurting the groves, and interfering with our magic! We've got to stop it! I've gone to [Aapo], for his help! Yes, Aapo is the Druid envoy, sent to help us from the Druid Court. He's worked on a way to help us locate the source of all the disruption. He said I should send you to him. He will tell you how you can help.|Ah, has [Liisu] sent you to me? Ah, is it wonderful to be here, <Player>, amongst the [Sylvan]? Right. The groves are being disturbed somehow, and nobody knows how. I've seen this sort of thing before, though, and may have an idea of what's going on. You see, a long time ago, nature in Hibernia got twisted. All things were affected; plantsm animals, and even us, the Celts! Sometimes, the land reacts to evil. It senses evil, and occasionally, the result is an [abomination] of what is normal. Nature became twisted. Creatures turned malevolent. The very trees turned horrific creatures of destruction. This was a very long time ago, and even still, some of these creatures remain! I believe the evil of the fomorian has done this to the creatures of Hy Brasil. I believe that one of these [twisted] creatures may be somehow disturbing the balance between the natural magic of the groves and the natural magic of the Sylvan. I've fashioned this item for you. Wear it, and seek out any of the creatures of the area. When the necklace starts glowing, you will know you are near. I would like to give you a greater idea of what you seek, but I can't. Wear the necklace. It will [guide] you. I do believe the tangleweeds may be disturbing the groves. Perhaps they are digging into the roots of the grove trees. If I am correct, I will need two of the tangle weeds, to study. Ah. Good to see you! Did you get the tangleweeds? They are strangling the roots of the new grove trees. It's a sad state Hy Brasil is in. Well, then, give me the first tangleweed. Great. Now, here. I need you to go to the grove trees that these tangleweeds fed off of, and spread this mixture of leaves and seeds. It will help heal some of the roots, and also plant new grove trees. If you don't know how to use the seeds, speak to Mirari. Tell her you need [instructions]. Ah. Well, I've learned that not only tangleweeds, but lost shrillers, have been affecting the groves! Well, others have helped me with the lost shrillers. Did you spread the [magical seeds]? Great! I heartily thank you. It's been a rough time, what with the tangleweeds spreading! Here, take this coin, it should aid you. Again, I thank you. Now the grove trees will have a better chance of growing!|||Ah, has [Liisu] sent you to me?
