Wear it, and seek out any of the creatures of the area. When the necklace starts glowing, you will know you are near. I would like to give you a greater idea of what you seek, but I can't. Wear the necklace. It will [guide] you. I do believe the tangleweeds may be disturbing the groves. Perhaps they are digging into the roots of the grove trees. If I am correct, I will need two of the tangle weeds, to study. Ah. Good to see you! Did you get the tangleweeds? They are strangling the roots of the new grove trees. It's a sad state Hy Brasil is in. Well, then, give me the first tangleweed. Great. Now, here. I need you to go to the grove trees that these tangleweeds fed off of, and spread this mixture of leaves and seeds. It will help heal some of the roots, and also plant new grove trees. If you don't know how to use the seeds, speak to Mirari. Tell her you need [instructions]. Ah. Well, I've learned that not only tangleweeds, but lost shrillers, have been affecting the groves! Well, others have helped me with the lost shrillers. Did you spread the [magical seeds]? Great! I heartily thank you. It's been a rough time, what with the tangleweeds spreading! Here, take this coin, it should aid you. Again, I thank you. Now the grove trees will have a better chance of growing!||Ah, has [Liisu] sent you to me? Ah, is it wonderful to be here, <Player>, amongst the [Sylvan]? Right. The groves are being disturbed somehow, and nobody knows how. I've seen this sort of thing before, though, and may have an idea of what's going on. You see, a long time ago, nature in Hibernia got twisted. All things were affected; plantsm animals, and even us, the Celts! Sometimes, the land reacts to evil. It senses evil, and occasionally, the result is an [abomination] of what is normal. Nature became twisted. Creatures turned malevolent. The very trees turned horrific creatures of destruction. This was a very long time ago, and even still, some of these creatures remain! I believe the evil of the fomorian has done this to the creatures of Hy Brasil. I believe that one of these [twisted] creatures may be somehow disturbing the balance between the natural magic of the groves and the natural magic of the Sylvan. I've fashioned this item for you. Wear it, and seek out any of the creatures of the area. When the necklace starts glowing, you will know you are near. I would like to give you a greater idea of what you seek, but I can't. Wear the necklace. It will [guide] you. I do believe the tangleweeds may be disturbing the groves. Perhaps they are digging into the roots of the grove trees. If I am correct, I will need two of the tangle weeds, to study. Ah. Good to see you! Did you get the tangleweeds? They are strangling the roots of the new grove trees. It's a sad state Hy Brasil is in. Well, then, give me the first tangleweed. Great. Now, here. I need you to go to the grove trees that these tangleweeds fed off of, and spread this mixture of leaves and seeds. It will help heal some of the roots, and also plant new grove trees. If you don't know how to use the seeds, speak to Mirari. Tell her you need [instructions]. Ah. Well, I've learned that not only tangleweeds, but lost shrillers, have been affecting the groves! Well, others have helped me with the lost shrillers. Did you spread the [magical seeds]? Great! I heartily thank you. It's been a rough time, what with the tangleweeds spreading! Here, take this coin, it should aid you. Again, I thank you. Now the grove trees will have a better chance of growing!
rows.StepText: Talk with Liisu about the strange things in the grove.|Speak to Aapo.|Wear the necklace and kill the two tangleweeds eating the grove roots just outside the gates. (1/2)|Wear the necklace and kill the two tangleweeds eating the grove roots just outside the gates. (2/2)|Return the weeds to Aapo.|Spread the magical seeds in the grove.|Return to Aapo.

rows.Name: Mild Deception
rows.Description: The guards are hunting a certain stalker. Will you assist in a mildly [nefarious] deed? Trick the lurikeen tracker into giving you a note meant for someone else.
rows.SourceText: Speak with the tracker in red armour due west across the road and claim you are [here to aid]. (whisper: here to aid)|
rows.StepText: Speak with the tracker in red armour due west across the road and claim you are [here to aid]. (whisper: here to aid)|Give the note to Achaius, the wandering weapons merchant between Mag Mell and Ardee.

rows.Name: Enchanted Bandit Hunt
rows.Description: A sabhail named Seireadan stole an enchanted dagger from Anra's father and uses it to look like a lurikeen while waylaying [travellers].
rows.SourceText: Find the 'lurikeen' Seireadan in the valley west of Howth, past the ridge, a bit north. Speak to him, then do away with him.|
rows.StepText: Find the 'lurikeen' Seireadan in the valley west of Howth, past the ridge, a bit north. Speak to him, then do away with him.|Return the dagger to Anra, the lurikeen weapons merchant on the west side of Howth.

rows.Name: Learn the Paths
rows.Description: You near the time you must [choose] your path.
rows.SourceText: Speak with Serenda, the Hero trainer, in the first tree on the right in the Grove.|||
rows.StepText: Speak with Serenda, the Hero trainer, in the first tree on the right in the Grove.|Speak with Sean McCrean, the Champion trainer.|Speak with Aurnia, the Blademaster trainer, in the tree behind Searlait.|Return to Searlait.

rows.Name: Summoner Expulsion
rows.Description: A summoner has corrupted the stone obelisk [northwest] of Mag Mell and keeps pulling the dead from their graves. Stop him.
rows.SourceText: Kill the summoner at the stone obelisk northwest of Mag Mell.|
rows.StepText: Kill the summoner at the stone obelisk northwest of Mag Mell.|Return to your trainer.

rows.Name: Tale of Cad Goddeau
rows.Description: Do you know about Cad Goddeau? Ask the Druid [trainer] at the tower over the bridge.
rows.SourceText: Say [Cad Goddeau] to the Druid trainer at the tower over the bridge from Connla. (whisper: Cad Goddeau)|
rows.StepText: Say [Cad Goddeau] to the Druid trainer at the tower over the bridge from Connla. (whisper: Cad Goddeau)|Return to your trainer.

rows.Name: Track and Seek
rows.Description: Locate a certain tracker, follow her, and find out from whom she receives [information].
rows.SourceText: Find the elven tracker in blue armour who wanders the hills west of Howth and follow her to her informant.||
rows.StepText: Find the elven tracker in blue armour who wanders the hills west of Howth and follow her to her informant.|Return to Damhnait: the Unnamed One is close to finding the Moonstone.|Pass the information to Leachlainn, the Nightshade trainer in Ardagh. (whisper: the Unnamed One seeks the Moonstone)

rows.Name: Way of the Grove -- Learning the Paths
rows.Description: Soon will come the time when you must choose between life as an animist, and life as a valwalker. It is already your destiny to walk the [Path of Affinity].
rows.SourceText: Ah, then talk with Faolan, first, to learn about life as an Animist.|
rows.TargetText: Ah, I imagine you're here to learn about the Path of Affinity and life as an [Animist]. Animists have an affinity with plants. We can animate plants, and use the magic of nature and the plant life nature produces when needed. There was a time when most of the magic we used was for simply shaping our homes and becoming closer to nature. Now, though, it seems we use our magic and our affinity with plants to defend. I know that the Druids and Wardens and Bards feel a desire to protect nature. As animists, we believe we should be nature. It is a hard thing to achieve, but it is what we believe. Now, speak to Oriara. She can tell you about life as a valewalker.|Ah, you are here to learn about life as a [Valewalker] are you not?
rows.StepText: Talk to Faolan about the Path of Affinity and life as an Animist.|Speak to Oriana about life as a Valewalker.

rows.Name: Wolf Infestation
rows.Description: The wolves [wandering] near town are starving. Take this food and feed them.
rows.SourceText: Feed three of the lough wolves near Caoimhe's house.|
rows.StepText: Feed three of the lough wolves near Caoimhe's house.|Return to Caoimhe in Mag Mell.

rows.Name: Youth Gone Wrong
rows.Description: Oh, hello there. I don't have time to talk. I'm afraid something [bad] will happen to me.
rows.SourceText: Thank you! I will pay you whatever I can. Oh no! Here they come! Please protect me!||
rows.StepText: Two villainous youths come for Mandra behind the main building in Mag Mell. Defeat them. (1/2)|Two villainous youths come for Mandra behind the main building in Mag Mell. Defeat them. (2/2)|Talk to Mandra.
rows.FinishText: Oh, thank you for helping me. I think I should go somewhere else, until this blows over. Thank you again friend. Please, take this as a token of my appreciation. Goodbye!

rows.Name: Kylirean's New Armor
rows.Description: I need [materials] for new armour.
rows.SourceText: Kill a lough wolf cadger for its skin.|||
rows.StepText: Kill a lough wolf cadger for its skin.|Return the skin to Kylirean, the armour merchant in Mag Mell.|Kill a mudman for a rock chert.|Return the chert to Kylirean.

rows.Name: Spicket, Spackit and Spykit
rows.Description: Aye, friend. Have you traveled much yet? If so, you may have encountered those strange spraggon roaming around here as of late. They are very foul tempered, not to mention they have been destroying crops and fields all around the area. Typical spraggon behavior. Right alongside assaulting travelers and stealing their goods. These three, though, they've got some [magical stuff] on them, I'd bet anything on it.
rows.SourceText: Kill the spraggon you chose: Spicket (woods west of the bridge north of Ardee), Spackit (valley northeast of Mag Mell) or Spykit (just over the hill northeast of Mag Mell). They appear at night.||||Choose your reward: [Spicket's Belt], [Spackit's Bracer], [Spykit's Ring].
rows.TargetText: |Yes then, there are some that seem to posess (sic) this strange ability to grow in size, though I'm told not many can. I suppose it matters not. You're a brave (character class), to have defeated this infamous spraggon. Have you defeated [many more]? Have you their heads then? I will pay you for each head, friend, if you give them to me. Or have you [no more heads]? You have done a great thing in killing these spraggon. They are horrible. They run through the land, tearing up good fields, destroying. There is said to be an item of magical enchantment on the spraggon you killed, the large one. You didn't mention it. Perhaps you didn't find it? He may have hidden it somewhere. That's what they normally do. Could you please search for this enchanted item? I have a personal interest in it. I believe it would be hidden by the bridge on the road to Druim Ligen. Thank you, <Player>. The spraggon have been unusually villianous (sic), and I mean to find out why. This may help us. Good day to you, <Player>, and please, consider spraggon hunting a sport. You're quite good at it.||Yes then, there are some that seem to posess (sic) this strange ability to grow in size, though I'm told not many can. I suppose it matters not. You're a brave (character class), to have defeated this infamous spraggon. Have you defeated [many more]? Have you their heads then? I will pay you for each head, friend, if you give them to me. Or have you [no more heads]? You have done a great thing in killing these spraggon. They are horrible. They run through the land, tearing up good fields, destroying. There is said to be an item of magical enchantment on the spraggon you killed, the large one. You didn't mention it. Perhaps you didn't find it? He may have hidden it somewhere. That's what they normally do. Could you please search for this enchanted item? I have a personal interest in it. I believe it would be hidden by the bridge on the road to Druim Ligen. Thank you, <Player>. The spraggon have been unusually villianous (sic), and I mean to find out why. This may help us. Good day to you, <Player>, and please, consider spraggon hunting a sport. You're quite good at it.|
rows.StepText: Kill the spraggon you chose: Spicket (woods west of the bridge north of Ardee), Spackit (valley northeast of Mag Mell) or Spykit (just over the hill northeast of Mag Mell). They appear at night.|Bring proof of its death to Tethra in the middle house in Ardee.|Search under the bridge north of Ardee.|Hand Tethra the bag.|Choose your reward: whisper Tethra the name of the item you want (Spicket's Belt, Spackit's Bracer, Spykit's Ring).

rows.Name: The Bug Catcher's Studies
rows.Description: Greetings. I am Ignius, purveyor of magic and studier of magical creatures of Hibernia. I'm sure on your travels you have [seen] many of them, have you not?
rows.SourceText: Excellent! I knew you looked like the sort that could use a little coin. Here is what I need. I am currently working on a new magical item, but I am missing a few pieces. I need for you to [get the items] for me.||
rows.StepText: Kill an eirebug for a set of eyes.|Kill a water beetle collector for its carapace.|Return to Ignius outside the east entrance of Tir na Nog.
rows.FinishText: You can find the water beetle collectors near the shore by Mag Mell, to the east of here. Watch out for the water beetles, though. They may come to aid the collectors. When you have these items, return to me.

rows.Name: Evan's Notes
rows.Description: Greetings, there, <Player>. You look like you could use some cash. I'll tell you what. If you help me, I can help [you].
rows.SourceText: Ah, my sweet Meara. Thank you <Player> for everything. I know her love for me is strong. One day, we will be united, no matter what her parents say. Please take this for your troubles.|
rows.TargetText: Thank you so much for this letter. Oh, my beloved Evan, how I miss him. My parents have forbidden me from marrying him but I know he loves me so. Perhaps you can take a [letter] back to him for me? Here it is. Thank you so much. Please take this for your trouble. I do so appreciate your helping me with this.|
rows.StepText: Hand the letter to Meara, a firbolg guard in Mag Mell.|Return the letter to Evan in Ardee.

rows.Name: Cristin's Supplies
rows.Description: Blessings upon you this day, noble (character class). I have the finest wares in all of Connacht, and I humbly thank thee for taking a minute of your most valuable time to view my wares. Although I am not talented enough to [make the armor] , I do sell fine things.
rows.SourceText: I am most pleased to see you have returned safe and sound. I hope you were able to collect the items my cousin needs. Please give me the hill toad warts first.|||
rows.StepText: Kill a water beetle on the riverbank along the road south of Basar.|Kill a hill toad on the hill west of Ardee near Muire's Tomb.|Kill a spraggonite on the same hill.|Visit Cristin in Basar and hand over the items.
rows.FinishText: Well, I see you had no difficulty obtaining that either! My cousin will be overjoyed, and he will pay me well. I am not a selfish person, so please, take this. It is your share of what I will receive from him. I thank you most sincerely!

rows.Name: Straw's In Town
rows.Description: A [spraggon] named Straw is so fast the guards have never caught him. Talk to Rolney at the tower in Ardagh.
rows.SourceText: Find Rolney at the top of the tower in Ardagh.||||Choose your reward: [Straw's Gem], [Belt of Nimbleness], [Charming Necklace], [Choker of Empathetic Properties].
rows.StepText: Find Rolney at the top of the tower in Ardagh.|Odharnait in Ardagh can help you find Straw.|Straw appears at night with a band of spraggons by the dead tree and the boulder on the hill northwest of Ardagh.|Take Straw's head to Sentinel Eimile in Ardagh.|Choose your reward: whisper Sentinel Eimile the name of the item you want (Straw's Gem, Belt of Nimbleness, Charming Necklace, Choker of Empathetic Properties).

rows.Name: Clik's Raids
rows.Description: A thieving water beetle named Clik [snitched] my jewels. Help me get them back.
rows.SourceText: Kill water beetles up the coast to recover the stolen necklace.||||
rows.StepText: Kill water beetles up the coast to recover the stolen necklace.|And the earring.|And the ring.|Kill Clik in the small bay just southeast of Mag Mell (he calls for help).|Return all four items to Caitriona in Ardagh.

rows.Name: Gormghlaith's Tea
rows.Description: [Lucricaduanes] in the Silvermine Mountains stole my valuable teapot.
rows.SourceText: Kill lucricaduanes in the valley at the north edge of the Silvermine Mountains for the teapot.||||
rows.StepText: Kill lucricaduanes in the valley at the north edge of the Silvermine Mountains for the teapot.|Return the teapot to Gormghlaith outside Howth by the stable master.|Get a blackwood leaf from a lunantishee by the road south from Mag Mell.|Get wolf whiskers from a lough wolf.|Return to Gormghlaith with the tea ingredients.

rows.Name: Little Wind
rows.Description: Make a bottle to capture the wind ghoul Little Wind so we may learn of the lost [treasures] of the Tower.
rows.SourceText: Get a water beetle eye along the lake shore for the cork.||||
rows.StepText: Get a water beetle eye along the lake shore for the cork.|Get a spraggonoll leg bone for the bottle.|Return the eye and the bone to Reidie in the Tir na mBeo tavern.|Northwest of Ardee in the ruins where wind ghouls roam, kill wind ghouls until Little Wind appears (daytime) and defeat him.|Return the bottle to Reidie.

rows.Name: Cyllane's Cure
rows.Description: Read my note; it [tells] you what I need.
rows.TargetName: |sporite;181|botonid leaf;181|precocious cniogcrag;181|Niara, Priestess of the Grove;181|Cyllane;181|||Cyllane;181
rows.SourceText: Read Cyllane's note.||||||||
rows.StepText: Read Cyllane's note.|Kill a sporite for a spore pod.|Kill a botonid leaf for its sap.|Kill a precocious cniogcrag for its eye.|Take the items to Niara, Priestess of the Grove, in the Grove of Domnann.|Take the potion back to Cyllane in Bann-didein.|Go west-southwest to the prepared circle and activate the amulet.|Activate the cure.|Return to Cyllane.

rows.Name: Cyllane's Cure
rows.Description: Read my note; it [tells] you what I need.

rows.Name: Fagan's Wand
rows.Description: Retrieve the two broken halves of the [Blackthorn] Wand.
rows.SourceText: Kill the enchanted creature that carries the bottom half of the wand.||||Choose your reward: [Boots of the Wicked], [Boots of the Wicked Mage], [Boots of the Wicked Fighter], [Boots of the Wicked Soul].
rows.StepText: Kill the enchanted creature that carries the bottom half of the wand.|Give Nyderra in Ardee the bottom half of the wand.|Find the lunantishee Prunar in the wood northwest of Tir na mBeo.|Return the top half to Nyderra.|Choose your reward: whisper Nyderra the name of the item you want (Boots of the Wicked, Boots of the Wicked Mage, Boots of the Wicked Fighter, Boots of the Wicked Soul).

rows.Name: Lochlain's Curse
rows.Description: I was cursed to look like a [lurikeen]. I need three items to remove the curse.
rows.SourceText: Get a barca's spirit in Bri Leith.|||
rows.StepText: Get a barca's spirit in Bri Leith.|Get a broken mirror from a siabra enchanter on the siabra island east of Tir na mBeo.|Get a siabra knife from the siabra house south of the Bri Leith entrance.|Take the items back to Lochlain in Ardagh.

rows.Name: Rhian's Dyes
rows.Description: I am running low on dyes and need [components].
rows.SourceText: Get a badger scent gland along the road south from Mag Mell.|||
rows.StepText: Get a badger scent gland along the road south from Mag Mell.|Get hair from a wild lucradan.|Get the third component from a large eirebug.|Return to Rhian in Tir na mBeo.

rows.Name: Keara's Enchantment
rows.Description: A Celt turned me into a male Celt. Help me lift the [enchantment].
rows.SourceText: Get a veil from a veil wisp northeast of the guard tower on the way to Caille.|||
rows.StepText: Get a veil from a veil wisp northeast of the guard tower on the way to Caille.|Get a broken mirror from a siabra enchanter.|Get the skin of the changeling among the anger sprites northwest of Ardee.|Return to Keara on the second floor in Ardee.

rows.Name: Whatcha Gonna Do
rows.Description: I am being [stalked]!
rows.TargetName: Crace;181|Ailionora Parra;181|stalking sylvanshade;181|Ailionora Parra;181|stalking sylvanshade;181|Crace;181|Ailionora Parra;181
rows.SourceText: Tell Crace that Ailionora is being [stalked]. (whisper: stalked)||||||
rows.StepText: Tell Crace that Ailionora is being [stalked]. (whisper: stalked)|Go back to Ailionora.|Kill a stalking sylvanshade west of the city across the water, then north.|Return the hand to Ailionora.|Kill another one.|Return to Crace.|Tell Ailionora that it was [after Tiaga]. (whisper: after Tiaga)

(whisper: after Tiaga)

rows.Description: Talk to Reidie in Tir na mBeo about [Bristle].

rows.Name: Beautiful Music
rows.Description: My [wonderful] drum is missing! My twin sister Tira in Ardee stole it.
rows.SourceText: Go talk to Tira in Ardee.||||||||
rows.StepText: Go talk to Tira in Ardee.|Recover Tira's missing flute (from the anger spites).|Return the flute to Tira.|Get sinew from a curmudgeon trapper west of Ardagh.|Return the sinew to Tira.|Get a piece of driftwood from a roane maiden.|Get a seashell from Lelly, a named roane maiden on the shore northwest of the parthanan farm.|Return the driftwood to Tira.|Return to Tavie in Tir na mBeo with her drum, the lute and the seashell.

rows.Name: Lesser Of Two Evils
rows.Description: See [Fereinn] on the island in Lough Derg.
rows.SourceText: See Fereinn on the island in Lough Derg.|||||||||Choose your reward: [Vest of Enlightenment], [Bracer of the Bold], [Bracer of Understanding].
rows.StepText: See Fereinn on the island in Lough Derg.|Kill the curmudgeon trapper Tharl as proof of your sincerity.|Give Fereinn the ear.|Kill a courier and bring back the plans.|Assist the siabra force to defeat the curmudgeons at their battle at high noon. (1/3)|Assist the siabra force to defeat the curmudgeons at their battle at high noon. (2/3)|Assist the siabra force to defeat the curmudgeons at their battle at high noon. (3/3)|Report back to Fereinn.|Give the book to Aidaila in Tir na mBeo.|Choose your reward: whisper Aidaila the name of the item you want (Vest of Enlightenment, Bracer of the Bold, Bracer of Understanding).

rows.Name: Two Ales, Ailish!
rows.Description: Notice anything missing? My glasses! I've been to three places [recently].
rows.SourceText: Ask Vivienne, the scale armour merchant in Ceannai.|||
rows.StepText: Ask Vivienne, the scale armour merchant in Ceannai.|Ask Sentinel Casidhe in Tir Uphost.|Ask Brynn, the enchanter staff merchant in Caille, who found them in the grass.|Return the glasses to Iao in the Green Rose Pub.

rows.Name: Fearan
rows.Description: I am planting an [otherworld] garden and need the spores of a dew sheerie taken to Cait in Howth.
rows.SourceText: Get the spores of a dew sheerie on the eastern shore of the loch, east of Ardagh.|||||||
rows.StepText: Get the spores of a dew sheerie on the eastern shore of the loch, east of Ardagh.|Take the spores to Cait in Howth.|Get otherworld soil from a deamhan creig (or ask Merlo near Howth for [soil from the otherworld]).|Return to Cait.|Ainrebh the enchanter in Caille must seal the magic between the soil and the spores.|Get grass seeds from a grass sheerie west-northwest of Caille.|Return the seeds to Ainrebh.|Find and slay Fearan, who runs the hill crest with a companion.

rows.Name: Lysagh's Problem
rows.Description: Check on my brother Lysagh in Caille and take him this armour shipment; fury sprites keep [attacking] him.
rows.SourceText: Deliver the armour shipment to Lysagh in Caille.|||||
rows.StepText: Deliver the armour shipment to Lysagh in Caille.|Kill a grass sheerie past the lone guard tower for a green crystal.|Give the crystal to Lysagh; fury sprites come to mug him.|Kill Glare and the other fury sprite.|Give Lysagh the corpse of Glare and offer to take a letter to Gemma.|Take the letter to Gemma in Tir na Nog.

rows.Name: Regional Distinctions
rows.Description: Hello. I imagine by now you've run into several dergans while exploring the area. They can be dangerous, so be careful with your dealings with them. They are of the unseelie court, you know. They are part of the siabra, and they are everywhere. why, I don't think there's one place not touched by these malevolent dark [elven beings].
rows.SourceText: You've made a wise choice. No matter what your dealings with the siabra may be, they are as much of an enemy as the Midgard barbarians and Albion invaders. Talk to Lavena, in town, she has had some recent experience with the unseelie court.|||||||||
rows.TargetText: Dergans? You want to know about dergans? They are part of the unseelie court. They are defined by their region. Here, in Lough Derg, they go by the name dergans. They have a reason for being here. They all have a unified mission. I'm sure of that. Why, it's common knowledge that when the Lurikeens and Elves decided to come through the Veil to help the land of Hibernia, the [unseelie court] came rushing out as well. It seemed, to some, they had found their own way out, but I know little of that. Well, I may know why they occupy some of Lough Derg. But I won't be sharing that knowledge with those that aren't willing to take up the fight against the unseelie court. I know they're powerful, I know some feel it pays more to stay on their good side. But I'll not talk with those not willing to fight the evil of the unseelie court. If you wish this knowledge, you must return to me with some of the uncut stones the dergan furys occasionally pick up. You can find dergan furys in the woods northeast of the farm building by the parthanan field. You are back. Have you retrieved an uncut stone for me? Ah. Yes, this is what I meant. You see, the dergans [occupy] our land for a reason. Most of Lough Derg was once Tir na mBeo. There are the ruins of a tower here in Lough Derg, they are the ruins of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. I won't tell the story of that tower, for it is common in Hibernia. When the unseelie court flooded Hibernia, some of them overran Lough Derg and began to occupy some areas. They have been here so long, that even though they are members of the unseelie court, the natives of Hibernia began to call them dergans. It's a way to [distinguish] the unseelie court. The dergans sole interest seems to bein retrieving the lost treasures of the Tower of Tir na mBeo. You could imagine the unseelie court's surprise when they reached the Tower of Tir na mBeo, to find that the once great Elven construct had fallen, and worse, that most of the treasures of the Tower were gone! So they stay here, to seek the treasures, and to search for clues that could lead them to the whereabouts of the treasures. Understand, now, that some of these treasures are items of magic more powerful than anything the unseelie court or the elves now have! As for the rest of the unseelie court, well, they spread our throughout the land. If you travel to Howth, I'm sure you can learn about the unseelie court that has settled in that area. Just talk to the locals.||Dergans? You want to know about dergans? They are part of the unseelie court. They are defined by their region. Here, in Lough Derg, they go by the name dergans. rows.StepText: Speak to Lavena in the first hut on the left of Tir na mBeo about the [dergans]. (whisper: dergans)|Kill a dergan fury for an uncut stone (the island behind Ardagh or the woods by the parthanan farm).|Return the stone to Lavena and learn why the dergans [occupy] Lough Derg.|Talk to Bevin by the dye merchants in Howth about the [unseelie court]. (whisper: unseelie court)|Kill the sheevra chieftain in the valley behind the mushroom ring across the stepping-stone bridge south of Howth.|Bevin sends you to Kyli on the dock in Connla.|Kill an eriu kedger in the valley on the road to Innis Carthaig.|Kyli sends you to Mosby in Tir Uphost.|Kill a moheran distorter behind the gales off the road from Tir na Nog to Tir Uphost (night).|Mosby sends you back to Raine in Tir na mBeo.

rows.Name: Alastriona's Chest
rows.Description: I broke my leg, and my chest of exotic furs was broken into. I tagged them [magically]; help me get them back.
rows.SourceText: Get the white boar skin from a bantam spectre in the Cliffs of Moher (night).||||||||Choose your reward: [Skinner's Gloves], [Skinner's Gloves (Leather)], [Skinner's Gloves (Reinforced)], [Skinner's Gloves (Scale)].
rows.StepText: Get the white boar skin from a bantam spectre in the Cliffs of Moher (night).|Return it to Alastriona outside the east gate of Tir na Nog.|Get the cave bear pelt from a sheevra skirmisher in the woods before the parthanan farm.|Return the pelt.|Get a blood otter skin from an eiru fiscere north along the river from Connla.|Return the skin.|Get the cruiach daemon skin from Hughar, the named curmudgeon poacher southeast of the parthanan farm.|Take the last skin back to Alastriona.|Choose your reward: whisper Alastriona the name of the item you want (Skinner's Gloves, Skinner's Gloves (Leather), Skinner's Gloves (Reinforced), Skinner's Gloves (Scale)).

rows.Name: Rest in Peace
rows.Description: My family is cursed. Get rid of the curse before I go mad. Take my [journal].
rows.TargetName: Beare Muire;221|Alsandair Muire;221|Conaire Muire;221|Shyene Muire;221|Kacey Muire;221||Kacey Muire;221|Quillan Muire;221|Gogarty Muire;200|Gogarty Muire;200
rows.SourceText: Kill Beare Muire in Muire Tomb.|||||||||Choose your reward: [Beare's Seashell Belt], [Shyena's Gossamer Veil], [Alsandair's Wading Boots], [Kacey's Soft Down Sleeves], [Quillan's Chest Armor], [Conaire's Dueling Gloves].
rows.StepText: Kill Beare Muire in Muire Tomb.|Kill Alsandair and keep his dueling sword.|Kill Conaire using the dueling sword.|Kill Shyene (her guards spawn when she is attacked).|Take Kacey's charm from her.|Destroy the charm at the foot of her resting place.|Kill Kacey again now that the charm is gone.|Kill Quillan.|Return to Gogarty Muire and give him the journal.|Choose your reward: whisper Gogarty Muire the name of the item you want (Beare's Seashell Belt, Shyena's Gossamer Veil, Alsandair's Wading Boots, Kacey's Soft Down Sleeves, Quillan's Chest Armor, Conaire's Dueling Gloves).

rows.Name: Riona's Revenge
rows.Description: The siabra [captured] me. I want revenge!
rows.SourceText: Kill Dergal at the siabra camp across the lake from Howth and retrieve the vest with magical runes.|||||Choose your reward: [Dergal's Runed Hauberk], [Dergal's Runed Hauberk (scale)].
rows.StepText: Kill Dergal at the siabra camp across the lake from Howth and retrieve the vest with magical runes.|Kill an eiru fiscere along the shore south of the stepping-stone bridge (or an empyrean wisp near Caille).|Get a fire agate from a spectre that wanders west of the main city past the guard tower at night.|Kill a ghastly siabra for its essence.|Return to Riona at the Mardagh tower.|Choose your reward: whisper Riona the name of the item you want (Dergal's Runed Hauberk, Dergal's Runed Hauberk (scale)).

rows.Name: Sad Fomorie
rows.Description: A fomorie named Glom sits moping in the hills south of the [village]. Check on him.
rows.SourceText: Check on Glom on the hill south of Ardagh.|||
rows.StepText: Check on Glom on the hill south of Ardagh.|Track down the badger Stinky, who stole Glom's toy.|Return the toy to Glom.|Return to Reeni.

rows.Name: Scuttle
rows.Description: A fishing bear cub named [Scuttle] stole my lucky rock.
rows.SourceText: Kill Scuttle on the small island east of the guard tower between Ardagh and Howth (around midnight).|||
rows.StepText: Kill Scuttle on the small island east of the guard tower between Ardagh and Howth (around midnight).|Bring back the stone and Scuttle's tooth.|Get a glowing worm from the belly of a roane companion near the siabra island.|Return to Seana in Ardagh.

rows.Name: Spinner's Cloak
rows.Description: Bring me four [spraggoncle] cloaks and I will spin you a cloak.
rows.SourceText: Kill spraggoncles on the hill northeast of the spraggon den by a burnt-out house for four cloaks. (1/4)||||||
rows.StepText: Kill spraggoncles on the hill northeast of the spraggon den by a burnt-out house for four cloaks. (1/4)|Kill spraggoncles on the hill northeast of the spraggon den by a burnt-out house for four cloaks. (2/4)|Kill spraggoncles on the hill northeast of the spraggon den by a burnt-out house for four cloaks. (3/4)|Kill spraggoncles on the hill northeast of the spraggon den by a burnt-out house for four cloaks. (4/4)|Return the cloaks to Banba in Howth.|Take the note to Reidie and choose a dye colour.|Give the dye to Banba.

rows.Name: Eoghan's Spell
rows.Description: I am working on a spell and need help collecting [components].
rows.SourceText: Get a shaft of wheat from Satefe, the named parthanan in the parthanan farm.||||
rows.StepText: Get a shaft of wheat from Satefe, the named parthanan in the parthanan farm.|Get a red candle from an empyrean watcher in the hills southeast of Caille.|Get a bowl of morning dew from a dew sheerie near the tower on the road to Caille.|Get a sprig of vervain from a gale in the Cliffs of Moher.|Return to Eoghan in Ardee.

rows.Name: Seeking Glory
rows.Description: Learn of Glory, the bow. A [sentinel] in Bri Leith knows of it.
rows.SourceText: Go into Bri Leith and talk to a sentinel about Glory.||||
rows.StepText: Go into Bri Leith and talk to a sentinel about Glory.|Get an arrow from a siabran archer.|Seek Muadhnait, the elven weapon merchant at the shops between Mag Mell and Tir na mBeo.|Find Tangua, a rare spawn in the huts on the hill behind the parthanan farm.|Take the bow back to Tir na Nog.

rows.Name: Seeking Glory
rows.Description: Learn of Glory, the bow. A [sentinel] in Bri Leith knows of it.
rows.SourceText: Go into Bri Leith and talk to a sentinel about Glory.||||
rows.StepText: Go into Bri Leith and talk to a sentinel about Glory.|Get an arrow from a siabran archer.|Seek Muadhnait, the elven weapon merchant at the shops between Mag Mell and Tir na mBeo.|Find Tangua, a rare spawn in the huts on the hill behind the parthanan farm.|Take the bow back to Tir na Nog.

rows.Name: Setting Sail
rows.Description: Speak with Keagan in [Connla].
rows.SourceText: Speak with Keagan in Connla and follow the conversation.||||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Keagan in Connla and follow the conversation.|Kill Ualtar in the woods with the dergans north of the parthanan farm.|Swim around the stepping stones near Howth until you find rock lichen.|Give Keagan the wood bowl and the rock lichen.|Speak with Evie.|Give the sailor the potion and talk to him until he recovers.|Speak with Evie.

rows.Name: The Feud
rows.Description: Help [settle] a feud.
rows.SourceText: Kill a faerie beetle in Connacht for a crystal eye.|||||
rows.StepText: Kill a faerie beetle in Connacht for a crystal eye.|Give the eye to Kean in Tir na mBeo and say it came from Tadhg.|Kill a large luch just east of Innis Carthaig for its ear.|Give the ear to Tadhg in Connla.|Kill the named deamhan creig Crag southwest of the spraggonoll camp (kill deamhan creigs until he appears).|Return to Lasrina in Howth with the two items.

rows.Name: Treasure Hunt
rows.Description: A supply courier is missing. Ask the [sentinel] at the Howth bridge.
rows.SourceText: Speak to the named sentinel at the Howth bridge about the missing courier.|||||||||Choose your reward: [Mayhem], [Chaos], [Havoc], [Destruction], [Confusion], [Devastation], [Bracer of Obstruction].
rows.StepText: Speak to the named sentinel at the Howth bridge about the missing courier.|Return to Gaenor and tell him what you learned.|Visit the enchantress Cadalind at the tower north of Howth.|Kill a walking rock (a small one works too).|Return to the enchantress, then speak to Glom the fomorie.|Kill a deamhan creig.|Wearing the necklace of finding, search beneath the stones by the deamhan creigs for the gem.|Take the gem to Cadalind and choose a weapon.|Give the sparkly gem to Glom for a brooch.|Choose your reward: whisper Glom the name of the item you want (Mayhem, Chaos, Havoc, Destruction, Confusion, Devastation, Bracer of Obstruction).

rows.Name: Sheerie Mischief
rows.Description: Talk to the gurite [tempriar] in Lough Gur.
rows.SourceText: Find the gurite tempriar near Innis Carthaig (at night).||||
rows.StepText: Find the gurite tempriar near Innis Carthaig (at night).|Return to Anice in Mag Mell.|Talk to Sentinel Giolladhe at the tower in Bri Leith; he buys the pearl and names Driss.|Kill mist sheeries at the pond west of the tower until Driss appears, and kill him.|Return the scrap of mist cloth to Anice.

rows.Name: A Piece of Gormghlaith's Mind
rows.Description: I'm making tea and need a few [ingredients].
rows.TargetName: river beetle drone;200|river beetle drone;200|Gormghlaith;200|Sentinel Beacan;200|Chief Proinnsias;200|spraggonale;200|spraggonale;200|Boss;200||Chief Proinnsias;200|Gormghlaith;200|Gormghlaith;200
rows.SourceText: Get two river beetle drone carapaces on the shore just south of Ardagh. (1/2)|||||||||||Choose your reward: [Musical Ring], [Jewel of Absorption], [Gloves of Night], [Badger Strength Choker].
rows.StepText: Get two river beetle drone carapaces on the shore just south of Ardagh. (1/2)|Get two river beetle drone carapaces on the shore just south of Ardagh. (2/2)|Return them to Gormghlaith south of the Howth entrance.|Tell Sentinel Beacan, left of the Howth gate, about the spraggons. (whisper: spraggons)|Tell Chief Proinnsias in the central building about the [spraggons]. (whisper: spraggons)|Clear spraggons at the spraggon den. (1/2)|Clear spraggons at the spraggon den. (2/2)|Kill the spraggonoll named Boss in the roofless barn.|Walk around inside the barn to collect four blackthorn leaves.|Return the corpse to the chief.|Give Gormghlaith the leaves and say [that's all there was].|Choose your reward: whisper Gormghlaith the name of the item you want (Musical Ring, Jewel of Absorption, Gloves of Night, Badger Strength Choker).

rows.Name: Bria's Savior
rows.Description: Take this letter to my sister Bria and help her with a [troublesome] curmudgeon.
rows.SourceText: Take the letter to Bria on the farm north of the bridge near Ardee (follow the river).|||||
rows.StepText: Take the letter to Bria on the farm north of the bridge near Ardee (follow the river).|Kill the wandering curmudgeon in the field and bring its head.|Give Bria the head.|Return to Kaenia with Bria's letter.|Take the letter to Ailidh southeast of Caille by the stone circle.|Kill the faerie drake Tric on the ridge north of the log west of Caille; do not hurt the empyreans.

rows.Name: Essence of Hostility
rows.Description: An evil warrior of the old war was slain, but his bracer remains, carried by a [rolling] stone.
rows.TargetName: Rolling Stone;200|Guardian Andraste;200|Fallen One;200|hill hound;200|Fallen One;200
rows.SourceText: Retrieve the cursed bracer from the rolling stone on the east side of the lake.||||
rows.StepText: Retrieve the cursed bracer from the rolling stone on the east side of the lake.|Take it back to Andraste by the Tir na mBeo well and choose to [cleanse] it.|Find the Fallen One at night by the standing stone where ghastly siabra spawn, between the parthanan farm and the buildings south of it, and give him the bracer.|Kill the hill hounds.|The Fallen One attacks: kill him.

rows.Name: Occupation of Lough Gur
rows.Description: Yes. My [particular] interest right now is the gurites. They are in Lough Gur, but to my knowledge, there's not really much value in that area. Why would they stay there? What keeps them? They don't attack Innis Carthaig, which is unlike them. I'm just curious as to why they stay there. Perhaps you could figure it out for me?
rows.SourceText: Oh great! I appreciate your [willingness] to help me!|||||||||
rows.StepText: Talk to Chief Bran Llyr in Culraid.|See Kern, the enchanter in Innis Carthaig.|Get two swords from empyrean keepers in northeast Bri Leith. (1/2)|Get two swords from empyrean keepers in northeast Bri Leith. (2/2)|Give the swords to Barra, the weapon merchant near the Innis Carthaig stable keeper.|Speak with Sarena, the poison vendor in Innis Carthaig.|Seek out the cluricaun Smidget on the north side of the island in Lough Gur.|Return the gem to Aziliz.|Fight the curmudgeon Curmie outside Innis Carthaig.|Return to Aziliz and say [tower of Tir na mBeo]. (whisper: tower of Tir na mBeo)
rows.FinishText: Great. Go talk to Chief Bran Llyr. I think he knows quite a bit about the gurites and siabra. He lives in Culraid, in Lough Gur, with Kimba. He may know why the gurites stick around that area.

rows.Name: The Broken Seal
rows.Description: The [koalinth] would be better locked away, and I have found the magical means - but I need your help.
rows.TargetName: Koalinth Castellan;223|Koalinth Elder;223|Druid Tobryn;200||Druid Tobryn;200|Druid Tobryn;200
rows.SourceText: Go deep into the koalinth caves and fetch a carved piece of aventurine from the koalinth castellan.|||||Choose your reward: [Waterspun Belt of Fortitude], [Waterspun Belt of the Hidden], [Waterspun Belt of Intellect], [Waterspun Belt of the Thicket], [Waterspun Belt].
rows.StepText: Go deep into the koalinth caves and fetch a carved piece of aventurine from the koalinth castellan.|Get the glowing fungus from the koalinth elder.|Return to Druid Tobryn by the tree southwest of Tir Urphost.|Use the medallion at the mouth of the cave.|Return to Druid Tobryn.|Choose your reward: whisper Druid Tobryn the name of the item you want (Waterspun Belt of Fortitude, Waterspun Belt of the Hidden, Waterspun Belt of Intellect, Waterspun Belt of the Thicket, Waterspun Belt).

rows.Name: Sea Shell Sleeves
rows.Description: I can have sea shell sleeves made for you if you gather the [materials].
rows.SourceText: Kill a bird-eating frog in Cruachan Gorge.||||||
rows.StepText: Kill a bird-eating frog in Cruachan Gorge.|Give the hide to Greagoir in Mag Mell.|Get bark from an irewood sapling near the outpost between Connla and Innis Carthaig.|Give the unfinished sleeves and bark to Gavina in Connla.|Find Seary on the spit of island directly southwest of Connla.|Return to Gavina to finish the sleeves.|Take the note to Kennocha.

rows.Name: Sraoi's Heart
rows.Description: I need four [things].
rows.SourceText: Get an essence of strength from a walking rock in the Silvermine Mountains.|||||||
rows.StepText: Get an essence of strength from a walking rock in the Silvermine Mountains.|Return to Labhaoise.|Get a vial of cloudy liquid from a fog phantom in the Cliffs of Moher.|Return to Labhaoise.|Get a vial of clear liquid from a rock clipper.|Return to Labhaoise.|Find and kill Sraoi, a named streaming wisp north of the Basar bridge, at night.|Return to Labhaoise for your reward.

rows.Name: The Piper's Price
rows.Description: Rats plague Innis [Carthaig]. Help me make rat traps.
rows.TargetName: irewood sapling;200|giant ant;200|Amynda;200||Glennard;200|Chieftess Niamh;200|Rat-catcher;200|Chieftess Niamh;200|Ghearic Chauclon;200|Chieftess Niamh;200|Rat-catcher;200|Chieftess Niamh;200|Chieftess Niamh;200|Chieftess Niamh;200
rows.SourceText: Get wood from an irewood sapling.||||||||||||Choose your reward: [Rescuer's Scale Hauberk], [Rescuer's Reinforced Vest], [Rescuer's Silk Robe].|Choose your reward: [Glennard's Short Sword], [Glennard's Club], [Glennard's Stiletto], [Glennard's Scythe], [Glennard's Staff of Mana], [Glennard's Carved Bow], [Glennard's Light Crafted Staff].
rows.StepText: Get wood from an irewood sapling.|Get mandibles from a giant ant.|Return to Amynda with the parts.|Glennard's staff for the chieftess was stolen by the rats; search their den on the hillside southwest of town.|Return the staff to Glennard and choose a weapon.|Chieftess Niamh asks you to watch the rat-catcher do his job at dusk.|Take the bag of money to the rat-catcher near the rat lair.|Return to the chieftess.|Visit the vaultkeeper at the tower by the portal to Hy Brasil near Connla.|Return to the chieftess: the rat-catcher has taken the children.|Rescue the children from the cottage on the farm with the black horses.|Return to the chieftess and choose your chest armour.|Choose your reward: whisper Chieftess Niamh the name of the item you want (Rescuer's Scale Hauberk, Rescuer's Reinforced Vest, Rescuer's Silk Robe).|Choose your reward: whisper Chieftess Niamh the name of the item you want (Glennard's Short Sword, Glennard's Club, Glennard's Stiletto, Glennard's Scythe, Glennard's Staff of Mana, Glennard's Carved Bow, Glennard's Light Crafted Staff).

rows.Name: Larylle's Necklace
rows.Description: Bring me a golden chain and three claws and I will make a [necklace].
rows.SourceText: Get a golden chain from the luch catchers in Lough Gur.|||||
rows.StepText: Get a golden chain from the luch catchers in Lough Gur.|Give the chain to Larylle upstairs in the main building in Ardee.|Get a bronze claw from a water badger in the river by Connla.|Get a silver claw from a Silvermine badger across the lake from Ardagh.|Kill Scar-nose, who appears after the local rocks, spraggonolls and badgers are cleared.|Return to Larylle for her necklace.

rows.Name: Search for Nasco's Spear
rows.Description: Greetings, I am Aziliz, Prophetess to the people of Hibernia. I specialize in many things, but my main focus is the Siabra. For you see, they [threaten] our very way of life.
rows.SourceText: Excellent. I am glad to know you are with me. Here is what we must do. There is a Siabra chief by the name of Nasco. He wanders around Shannon Estuary, and is guarded by his Ambushers and Waylayers. He is sneaky and crafty. You will need all the help you can get. Hurry to Howth and speak with my sister, <Player>. She will be able to assist you further in this endeavor for Hibernia.||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Keriann in the main hut in Howth and tell her Aziliz sent you. (whisper: Aziliz)|Speak with Kyli on the pontoon in Connla.|Find and kill Nasco at night in the curves of the road to Ceannai.|Show Kyli the spear.|Bring the spear to Aziliz.

rows.Description: I have a treasure project, but I am no judge of [character]. Run up to Sile; she will tell me if you are worthy.

rows.StepText: Talk to Sile, who is blind, in the depression beside the water due east of the round wooden building in Ardagh.|Tell Oran that Sile says you have a [pure heart]. rows.Name: Storyteller's Tale
rows.Description: A siabra family that [befriended] the Celts was murdered by their own kind. Their ghosts walk at night.
rows.SourceText: Go down the beach south, up into the hills, to the camp where the ghosts walk at night, and talk to Chief Gaeth.|||
rows.StepText: Go down the beach south, up into the hills, to the camp where the ghosts walk at night, and talk to Chief Gaeth.|Talk to Marus inside the stone building in Connla.|Swim across to Kaylee by the tower with her husband and get the potion of respite.|Give the potion to Chief Gaeth to release his family.

rows.Name: Poison for Ivy
rows.Description: Would you like a staff for an [Eldritch], an [Enchanter], a [Mentalist],an [Animist], or a [Bainshee]? Twisted Vine Staff -- Animist Ivy Woven Staff -- Enchanter Braided Ivy and Vine Staff -- Mentalist A lvl 33 received 36,330,877 experience and 1 gold and some silver. A lvl 31 received 22,887,018 experience. A lvl 50 received 96,000,000 experience. rows.Name: Returning for More
rows.Description: I can make you a new and [improved] cloak, but I need various items.
rows.SourceText: Get spider's silk from an arachnid in Treibh Caillte.||||||||
rows.StepText: Get spider's silk from an arachnid in Treibh Caillte.|Return the silk to Banba; she now wants [Elven Gossamer].|Talk to Tressa Gorrym'jiarg and complete Traces of the Mad Changlings for the elven gossamer.|Take the gossamer to Banba; her sewing basket is missing.|Talk to Guard Dooley under the spiral staircase of the tower to the Cliffs of Moher.|Find the ghostly Aengus Osrithe in the stone circle near Tir Urphost at night; tell him Banba is a [firbolg]. (whisper: firbolg)|Return the basket to Banba; she wants cloth dye from Reeni.|Help Reeni in Ardagh (Returning to the Source) for the cloth dye.|Give Banba the dye.

rows.Name: Returning to the Source
rows.Description: Take this sealed scroll to Sarena in Innis [Carthaig].
rows.SourceText: Take the sealed scroll to Sarena, the poison merchant in Innis Carthaig.||||
rows.StepText: Take the sealed scroll to Sarena, the poison merchant in Innis Carthaig.|Give the scroll to Reeni.|Take the scroll to Jarlath beside the healer Waljan through the north gate of Tir na Nog.|Give the scroll to Tethra in Ardee.|Head back to Reeni for the cloth dye.

rows.Name: The Anxious Healer
rows.Description: A grey man haunts the area. I need [components] to deal with him.
rows.SourceText: Speak with Merucha.||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Merucha.|Kill the named irewolf Lashold in the faerie horse meadow by the guard tower southwest of Caille.|Get an irewood branch in Mount Collory outside Druim Cain.|Return to Cinead at the top of the guard tower near Tir Urphost.|Confront the Grey Man.

rows.Name: Traces of the Mad Changlings
rows.Description: Hmph, another noisy [creature]. And what is it you want?
rows.SourceText: Well, <Player>, I see you are here. Unfortunately I cannot trade this necklace I have for you belt. The necklace would do nothing for a strong <Player> like you. Run along now!||Choose your reward: [Lusmorebane's Jeweled Necklace], [Belt of Spryness].
rows.StepText: From Caille head southeast across Moon Lake to the tall standing stones; the mad changelings are at the foot of the hills behind them. Kill Lusmorebane.|Bring the head back to Tressa.|Choose your reward: whisper Tressa Gorrym'jiarg the name of the item you want (Lusmorebane's Jeweled Necklace, Belt of Spryness).
rows.FinishText: Make good use of this cloth Celt, I shall not be so generous in the future.

rows.Name: Freeing Osier
rows.Description: Forgive me if my crying bothered you. It's hard to be anything but sad after what i saw the other day. Such [horrible thing] I've seen lately.
rows.SourceText: It is good to see you have returned, <Player>. I was worried that the task I asked of you was too great. Were you able to free my beloved Osier? I shall need some proof from you.|||||
rows.TargetText: |Hrmph, you expect me, a noble Lurikeen, to talk to the likes of you? I can't believe a Firbolg like you would even think of trying. If you're in such a desperate need for an enchanter, go see that Firbolg Kiana in Ardee in Connacht. Now, be off!|So, Uistean wouldn't help you? He's a terrible snob. I shall enchant it nicely for you. I will also tell you where to get the magical water you will need. There is your enchanted bladder. Now to fill it and quench the fires that consume Osier, you must seek out the dew sheeries. The best place to find them is Lough Derg, although I have seen some in Lough Gur. When you kill the dew sheerie, the enchanted bladder will draw the water out of the sheerie and into itself. Once it is filled, wait until nightfall then seek out Osier in Shannon Estuary. Give him the bladder and it should quench the flames. Be warned, he will most likely attack you, for he has no knowledge of good any more. He may also call for the other spectral wickermen to help him in this mission. When you have freed him, return to Odharnait.||Free me...please...free me from the flames! Oh they burn! They burn...please... Oh thank you...aahh...I shall be free now...thank you...take this to my sweet Odharnait...please...|
rows.StepText: Get a wolfhound bladder from a large red wolfhound.|Find Uisetan in Connla.|Give the bladder to Kiana in Ardee.|Kill a dew sheerie; the bladder fills with its water.|Seek out Osier at night at the four standing stones south of Connla over the river and give him the bladder (do not fight him).|Return to Odharnait in Ardagh with the satchel.
rows.FinishText: This was the ring he was going to give me that night. I shall treasure it always, knowing he was going to ask me to marry him. I had forgotten about this necklace until just now. The silly man was so handsome, but he didn't think it. He bought this 'spectral' necklace, as he called it, to make himself more attractive to me. I'd like you to have it with my gratitude for freeing Osier from that torture. I hope it serves you well.

rows.Name: Viraniel's Plague
rows.Description: I am sick. Get me the potion from [Dwerrania] in the druid grove.
rows.SourceText: Ask Dwerrania in the druid grove for the [potion for Viraniel]. (whisper: potion for Viraniel)|||||||||Choose your reward: [Cloak of Plague Resistance], [Frosted Silver Band], [Diamond Skull], [Bracer of Jade], [Necklace of the Elements].
rows.StepText: Ask Dwerrania in the druid grove for the [potion for Viraniel]. (whisper: potion for Viraniel)|Give Viraniel the potion; she turns into a skeleton warrior and flies off.|Return to Dwerrania.|Find the alchemist Eraliwyr hidden deep in the Spraggon Den (talk to him; he attacks) and kill him.|Kill a sand worm on the Bog of Cullen beach for its tongue.|Kill a greater zephyr east of Tir Urphost up the hill.|Kill a luch catcher south-southwest of Treibh Caillte.|Return the items to Dwerrania.|Check on Viraniel.|Choose your reward: whisper Viraniel the name of the item you want (Cloak of Plague Resistance, Frosted Silver Band, Diamond Skull, Bracer of Jade, Necklace of the Elements).

rows.Name: Black Plague
rows.Description: A plague [affects] people in Tir na Nog. Go to Eavann.
rows.SourceText: Go to Eavann, downstairs in the building opposite the Nightshade/Ranger guild.|||||||||
rows.StepText: Go to Eavann, downstairs in the building opposite the Nightshade/Ranger guild.|Speak to Tiarnan upstairs; he gives you a letter for his sister.|Take Tiarnan's letter to Keriann in the Chief's hut in Howth and keep talking to her.|Return Keriann's note to Tiarnan.|Talk with Eavann about news from the druids.|Return to Waljan; you are sick too.|Travel to the Coruscating Mines and slay a glow worm just inside the entrance.|Take the worm fungus back to Waljan for a cure.|Journey to Darkness Falls and slay Archivist Borath.|Return to Waljan with the stoppered wondrous potion.

rows.Name: Search For The Missing Smith
rows.Description: The smith Ceard is [missing].
rows.SourceText: Talk to Sian in Mag Mell; tell him Ceard is missing. (whisper: Ceard is missing)|||||Choose your reward: [Otherworldly Ring], [Chin Fin Ring].
rows.StepText: Talk to Sian in Mag Mell; tell him Ceard is missing. (whisper: Ceard is missing)|Find the confused smith Ceard wandering the beach past the fogs in the Cliffs of Moher.|Ceard was robbed by a cliff dweller hunter; get his ring back.|Take the ring back to Ceard (it breaks Scaird's hold but the curse kills him).|Take the ring to Cleary the enchanter in Tir Urphost to remove the curse.|Choose your reward: whisper Cleary the name of the item you want (Otherworldly Ring, Chin Fin Ring).

rows.Name: The West Wind
rows.Description: Speak with Tiarnan; someone has gone [missing] on the west wind.
rows.SourceText: See Tiarnan upstairs near the rogue trainers.||||||||

rows.Name: Fylara's Armor
rows.Description: Hail, <Player>. I am Fylara MacKieran, armor-maker for Comor Mac Gwion and my father, Lughaidh MacKieran. I've been making armor since I was a child. My mother taught me how to sew and my uncle Monaghan taught me how to forge armor. When I was old enough, I learned old secrets to make armor that is better than what you can buy from the merchants. My father was most pleased with my skills and [intriduced me] to Conor Mac Gwion.
rows.SourceText: You want to help? That is wonderful! In exchange for helping me, I will give you this piece of armor I'm finishing up. But I need you to replace the items I'm using right nowso that Conor will not become angry at me for giving away a piece of his army's armor. [One of the pieces] is fairly easy to get, but the other is more difficult.|||Choose your reward: [Ixthiar Carapace Leggings], [Ixthiar Wing Pants], [Bugbear Pelt Leggings], [Ixthiar Eye Leggings], [Bugbear Bloody Pelt Leggings].
rows.StepText: Kill a gorge shriller north across the wooden bridge near Aalid Feie for its tongue.|Clear an entire ixthiar nest before it respawns to make the broodmother appear, and kill her.|Return the parts to Fylara.|Choose your reward: whisper Fylara MacKieran the name of the item you want (Ixthiar Carapace Leggings, Ixthiar Wing Pants, Bugbear Pelt Leggings, Ixthiar Eye Leggings, Bugbear Bloody Pelt Leggings).
rows.FinishText: Heed my words, <Player>! I would not try this alone! Ixthiar doomcallers and reapers guard the nests. Pick one nest and exterminate all the creatures close to it. When all are dead, the broodmother will sense this and will come to the surface. You must defeat her to obtain the carapace. It will not be easy, but with a few associates you should be able to win. Once you have the pelt and the carapace, come back to me and speak with me.

rows.Name: Corruptors, Botonids, and Trade
rows.Description: Help us gain an [alliance] with the mantids of Krrzck.
rows.TargetName: corrupt sylvanshade;181|corrupt sylvanshade;181|corrupt sylvanshade;181|corrupt sylvanshade;181|corrupt sylvanshade;181|corrupt sylvanshade;181|Krazckz;181|corruptor;181|corruptor;181|corruptor;181|botonid rencanraider;181|botonid rencanraider;181|Krazckz;181|Krazckz;181
rows.SourceText: Hunt corrupt sylvan in the sylvan valley southwest of Necht for four arms. (1/4)|||||||||||||Choose your reward: [Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Strength], [Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Nurturing Health], [Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Everlasting Fortitude], [Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Silent Resistance], [Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Stunning Regrowth], [Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Lost Knowledge], [Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Substitution].
rows.StepText: Hunt corrupt sylvan in the sylvan valley southwest of Necht for four arms. (1/4)|Hunt corrupt sylvan in the sylvan valley southwest of Necht for four arms. (2/4)|Hunt corrupt sylvan in the sylvan valley southwest of Necht for four arms. (3/4)|Hunt corrupt sylvan in the sylvan valley southwest of Necht for four arms. (4/4)|And two heads. (1/2)|And two heads. (2/2)|Turn in the parts to Krazckz in Krrzck, west-northwest of Necht (raise mantid faction by killing treecutters and barkstrippers if needed).|Kill three corruptors just over the rock bridge for their skin. (1/3)|Kill three corruptors just over the rock bridge for their skin. (2/3)|Kill three corruptors just over the rock bridge for their skin. (3/3)|Kill two botonid rencanraiders south of the octonid forest for their teeth. (1/2)|Kill two botonid rencanraiders south of the octonid forest for their teeth. (2/2)|Return the parts to Krazckz.|Choose your reward: whisper Krazckz the name of the item you want (Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Strength, Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Nurturing Health, Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Everlasting Fortitude, Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Silent Resistance, Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Stunning Regrowth, Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Lost Knowledge, Ixthiar Skin Bracer of Substitution).

rows.Name: The Sylvan's Pain
rows.Description: Tell me your name; a sylvan [suffers].
rows.SourceText: Talk to Iesia in Droighaid; tell her [Sandu sent] you. (whisper: Sandu sent)||||||||||||Choose your reward: [Holly Ring], [Willow Wood Ring], [Heather Ring], [Aspen Wood Ring], [Hawthorn Wood Ring], [Hazel Wood Ring], [Rowen Wood Ring], [Silver Fir Wood Ring].
rows.StepText: Talk to Iesia in Droighaid; tell her [Sandu sent] you. (whisper: Sandu sent)|Talk to Eersie in Necht; tell her [Iesia sent] you. (whisper: Iesia sent)|Kill what Eersie names (a soaring manta for its tail).|Give the part to Evyene on the beach behind Necht and tell her you [seek a cure].|Get a tentacle from a death shroud in World's End.|Get blood from a chalico near the death shrouds.|Seek out Xcrzrk outside Krrzck and tell her [Evyene sent] you (or kill her for the egg). (whisper: Evyene sent)|Give Evyene the tentacle, blood and egg.|Give Iesia the potion when she asks.|Drink some of the potion.|Give the potion to Cailbyn east outside Droighaid.|Give the note to Sandu and choose two rings.|Choose your reward: whisper Sandu the name of the item you want (Holly Ring, Willow Wood Ring, Heather Ring, Aspen Wood Ring, Hawthorn Wood Ring, Hazel Wood Ring, Rowen Wood Ring, Silver Fir Wood Ring).

rows.Name: The Tree Maidens
rows.Description: Take this ticket to Necht and kill a [stilter].
rows.SourceText: Kill a stilter northwest of the sanidon pond west of Necht.||||||||Choose your reward: [Song of the Bard], [Song of the Regrower], [Song of the Blades], [Song of Stealth], [Song of the Moon], [Song of the Vines], [Song of the Sun], [Song of Strength], [Song of the Scythe].
rows.StepText: Kill a stilter northwest of the sanidon pond west of Necht.|Give Anyro in Necht the tentacle and say [Tree Maidens].|Kill a corruptor near the stepping stones on the road to Krrzck.|Kill a tittering tree dervish in Cothrom Gorge.|Talk to Tieru in Aalid Feie; tell him you are [missing one]. (whisper: missing one)|Kill the guard in the gap in the zone wall east of Aalid Feie (he calls two friends).|Say [hello] at the tree and answer the maiden: [the maidens of the trees], [to free their voice], then sing [morwynol gan yr llais]. (either answer works here: the maidens of the trees) (whisper: hello)|Speak to Raiaya and choose a gem.|Choose your reward: whisper Raiaya the name of the item you want (Song of the Bard, Song of the Regrower, Song of the Blades, Song of Stealth, Song of the Moon, Song of the Vines, Song of the Sun, Song of Strength, Song of the Scythe).

rows.Name: Piaras and Lhia
rows.Description: I have a couple of [things] I need you to do.
rows.TargetName: cliff dweller spearman;200|bog crawler;200|tidal sheerie;200|breaker roane companion;200|Lhia;200|Piaras;200
rows.SourceText: Kill a cliff dweller spearman in the Cliffs of Moher and return.|||||
rows.StepText: Kill a cliff dweller spearman in the Cliffs of Moher and return.|Kill a bog crawler in the Bog of Cullen and return.|Kill a tidal sheerie for a clump of seaweed and return.|Kill the breaker roane companion in the water.|Kill Lhia in Lough Gur (night spawn).|Return to Piaras in Howth.

rows.Name: Rhoiwyn's Necklace
rows.Description: Now, this is not the only reward you shall receive. I have a variety of belts crafted by the finest Sylvan. You may choose one for your own. Shall I [tell you] about them?
rows.SourceText: Get a rock from a granidon in Cothrom Gorge, toward the waterfall.|||||Choose your reward: [Knotted Vine Belt], [Braided Vine Belt], [Tree Bark Belt], [Belt of Braided Ivy], [Braided Root Belt], [Twisted Root Belt], [Belt of Leaves], [Fern Leaf Belt], [Braided Willow Belt], [Twisted Root Precision Belt].
rows.StepText: Get a rock from a granidon in Cothrom Gorge, toward the waterfall.|Get a leg bone from a mad grazer in the Vale of Balor.|Give the items to Garyn in the Grove of Aalid Feie.|Venture into the depths of Tur Suil and seek out Abomos the Soultrapper.|Return to Carylina on the west rampart of Droighaid.|Choose your reward: whisper Carylina the name of the item you want (Knotted Vine Belt, Braided Vine Belt, Tree Bark Belt, Belt of Braided Ivy, Braided Root Belt, Twisted Root Belt, Belt of Leaves, Fern Leaf Belt, Braided Willow Belt, Twisted Root Precision Belt).

rows.Name: Writhing Death
rows.Description: The Outland [residents] are attacked by a writhing, swarming mass.
rows.SourceText: Speak to Fedail (or Hedierna) in the outlander town of Altan Garran in Cothrom Gorge.|||||||Choose your reward: [Skillfully Woven Belt], [Ring of Mattering Minds], [Dexterous Shadow Beads], [Collared Cloak of Battle], [Collared Cloak of Diversity], [Collared Cloak of Stealth], [Collared Cloak of Intellect].
rows.StepText: Speak to Fedail (or Hedierna) in the outlander town of Altan Garran in Cothrom Gorge.|Kill Cronwort northwest of town.|Kill Fuilwort.|Kill Tachtwort.|Return their remains to Fedail.|Kill Marfoirwort, the source of the worts.|Bring the root to Treal.|Choose your reward: whisper Treal the name of the item you want (Skillfully Woven Belt, Ring of Mattering Minds, Dexterous Shadow Beads, Collared Cloak of Battle, Collared Cloak of Diversity, Collared Cloak of Stealth, Collared Cloak of Intellect).

rows.Name: Strange Bedfellows
rows.Description: Speak with Mystemas again at the imp [merchants] in Darkness Falls.
rows.SourceText: Speak with Mystemas at the imp merchants in Darkness Falls.|||||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Mystemas at the imp merchants in Darkness Falls.|Kill a glimmer griever in Sheeroe Hills for a glimmer stone.|Return to Mystemas with the glimmer stone.|Kill Ambassador Mannam.|Kill the Princess; Caisha rises from the well in the princess room.|Kill Caisha to capture her spirit in the soul stone.|Deliver Caisha's soul stone to Mystemas.|Report back to Waljan with the diplomatic documents.

rows.Name: Breaking the Blade
rows.Description: Assist me in the fight against the Army of [Shadows].
rows.SourceText: Travel to Darkness Falls and speak with Mystemas.|||||Choose your reward: [Keelia's Spiritual Guardian], [Keelia's Protector of Music], [Keelia's Silent Guardian], [Keelia's Guardian], [Keelia's Mystical Protector].
rows.StepText: Travel to Darkness Falls and speak with Mystemas.|Kill Director Kobil.|Return to Mystemas.|Kill Prince Abdin.|Return to Mystemas for your reward.|Choose your reward: whisper Mystemas the name of the item you want (Keelia's Spiritual Guardian, Keelia's Protector of Music, Keelia's Silent Guardian, Keelia's Guardian, Keelia's Mystical Protector).

rows.Name: Gold Lined Drinking Horn -- Kill Task
rows.Description: [Drinking]
rows.SourceText: Kill cliff dweller, cliff dweller hunter and bring Pethos the Gold Lined Drinking Horn.
rows.StepText: Kill cliff dweller, cliff dweller hunter and bring Pethos the Gold Lined Drinking Horn.

rows.Name: Vigilant One Leaves -- Kill Task
rows.Description: [Vigilant]
rows.SourceText: Kill vigilant one and bring Mel the Vigilant One Leaves. Mel is a named tree dervish at 21.5k,13.5k; vigilant one kills cost faction.
rows.StepText: Kill vigilant one and bring Mel the Vigilant One Leaves. Mel is a named tree dervish at 21.5k,13.5k; vigilant one kills cost faction.

rows.Name: Cutthroat Vine Poison Sac -- Kill Task
rows.Description: [Cutthroat]
rows.SourceText: Kill cutthroat vines and bring Mitri the Cutthroat Vine Poison Sac.
rows.StepText: Kill cutthroat vines and bring Mitri the Cutthroat Vine Poison Sac.

rows.Name: Vial of Glowing Gasses -- Kill Task
rows.Description: [Glowing]
rows.SourceText: Kill spectral briton invader and bring Iola the Vial of Glowing Gases.
rows.StepText: Kill spectral briton invader and bring Iola the Vial of Glowing Gases.

rows.Name: Detrital Crab Meat -- Kill Task
rows.Description: [Detrital]
rows.SourceText: Kill detrital crab and bring Maire the Detrital Crab Meat. Maire at 9331,27200 in Connla.
rows.StepText: Kill detrital crab and bring Maire the Detrital Crab Meat. Maire at 9331,27200 in Connla.

rows.Name: Cervideth Antlers -- Kill Task
rows.Description: [Cervideth]
rows.SourceText: Kill cervideth and bring Miniine the Cervideth Antlers. Giver not recorded. Giver: the walkthrough says only 'a Vale of Balor merchant'; Miniine is the server's merchant there.
rows.StepText: Kill cervideth and bring Miniine the Cervideth Antlers. Giver not recorded. Giver: the walkthrough says only 'a Vale of Balor merchant'; Miniine is the server's merchant there.

rows.Name: Spiteful Sylvanshade Head -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Hello there. You'd best be on your toes around these parts. [Spiteful Sylvanshades] are all about.
rows.SourceText: Wow, you've actually done the deed and killed a sylvanshade eh? Well, good job! The bounty's still open, if you happen to get more heads.
rows.StepText: Kill spiteful sylvanshade and bring Jack the Spiteful Sylvanshade Head. Jack on the second floor of a tree at 31766,52539.

rows.Name: Traveler's Way
rows.Description: (your name here), it is time to send you out into the lands beyond ours. Explore these other lands and tell them of our house's good will and [aid those we can].
rows.SourceText: Well then, if you wish to journey these lands, I shall send you to Val. He can be found in the guard tower on the road to East Svealand. Do explore!|||||
rows.TargetText: Aye there. You've come a ways, haven't you now? Spare me [some time], could you? Just bring me a few of those ant parts; these little ant workers have been everywhere lately. You could rid us of a few, couldn't you now.||||You look a traveler from far off. What brings you to [Fort Atla]? Oh. Val must have sent you. I had requested his aid, but it is no longer necessary...but since you've come this way, speak with Ruk. She owes me one, tell her Lalida says hello.|Hello traveler. Can I help you? Well! I am glad. Here, now don't be telling all your friends I've give you this now.
rows.StepText: Find Val in the guard tower on the road to East Svealand. (whisper: some time)|Bring Val the legs of three army ant workers. (1/3)|Bring Val the legs of three army ant workers. (2/3)|Bring Val the legs of three army ant workers. (3/3)|Speak with Lalida in Fort Atla. (whisper: Fort Atla)|Tell Ruk that Lalida says hello. (whisper: Lalida says hello)

rows.Name: Dark Essence
rows.Description: <Player>, it is good to see you again. I have recovered a bit from the last time we spoke. Remember the vessel you got for me? I was able to get it to Meregrota and she has enchanted it properly. It will be perfect for holding the essences that [Elizabeth so wants].
rows.SourceText: So, you have lost the vessel, after I warned you not to! Do not fret, <Player>, I knew that Pyserlian might cause trouble. While he may not be the strongest pyslings, he is cunning and fearless, and the other pyslings fear him. I am afraid that [without a special charm] to weaken Pyserlian, you will not be able to get the vessel back and trap his essence.|||||||
rows.TargetText: |||||Dalea Gronholm said that you may be coming to me for a way to weaken Pyserlian. Give me the morvalt finger bone and I shall enchant it. There, the bone is enchanted. Do not look surprised that it took so little time. The spell is quick and fairly simple, but it will cancel the spell that Pyserlian has cast around the vessel. You must wear the bone around your neck to cancel Pyserlian's spell. If you do not wear the bone, Pyserlian will not give you back the vessel and Dalea and Elizabeth will both be disappointed. Go now and seek out Pyserlian and obtain the vessel for Dalea! When you have defeated Pyserlian, the charm will disappear for its magic will be used up.||
rows.StepText: Capture the essences of three pyslings in the vessel. (1/3)|Capture the essences of three pyslings in the vessel. (2/3)|Capture the essences of three pyslings in the vessel. (3/3)|Return to Dalea empty-handed. (whisper: without a special charm)|Collect a finger bone from a morvalt ungdom.|Have Meregrota Solvor enchant the bone.|Wearing the charm, defeat Pyserlian and recover the vessel.|Return the vessel to Dalea.
rows.FinishText: Elizabeth will be most pleased to finally receive this. There is a Berserker going over to Mularn soon and I shall send this with her. I sent word to Elizabeth that a Berserker was helping me and she sent this over in thanks. Please take it, knowing that you have helped to protect Midgard!

rows.Description: I am pleased that you have returned to me. I have need of your services again. I have had more visions while studying this map. I believe [the visions] will help us learn about the elves Fressen spoke of, and this mysterious Gahsir.
rows.SourceText: You have returned. Did you find the woman I saw in my visions? What did she tell you of the elves?||||||
rows.TargetText: Greetings. Please do not look surprised that I knew your name. I had a vision of you coming to me. Inaksha isn't the only one who has visions. You seek [knowledge], do you not? My visions did not reveal what you want to know, only that you would come seeking me. Tell me what you wish to learn about. Gashir? I have not heard that name since I was a child, and those that dared to speak it did so only in a whisper. If you seek knowledge of Gashir, you must also desire knowledge of the elves. You did well to come to me, for I know of both. Come closer and hear a story of my [childhood]. My grandparents died when I was very young, but before they died, they told me of their raiding days. They were in a raiding party that ventured into Hibernia. One night after they had made a camp for the night, they told stories of the magic of the gods. My grandmother told the tale of the Rod of Mimir. A group of elves, which had gained the ability to understand our language, overheard the story as they prepared to [ambush the camp]. During the ambush, they killed everyone except my grandparents. They took my grandmother captive as my grandfather escapted into the woods. The elves forced my grandmother to tell them all she knew of the Rod of Mimir. It was many days later that she managed to escape, and she and my grandfather fled back to the safety of Midgard. The [elves pursued] because they did not want anyone to know they sought the Rod. Once here, they began their search, and captured passing travlers until they learned fro the proper ritual to summon Mimir. With the Rod, they can summon Mimir and force him to do their bidding. Unfortunately, their tongues are not well adapted to our language, and Mimir comes out as Gashir. After reading many ancient texts, I have discovered that there is another creature named Gashir, an evil demon who delights in destruction and chaos. If Gashir is released in this world, we will be doomed! That is all I can tell you of Gashir and the elves. I beg you, if you have the ability to stop the elves, please do so.|I figured she would say that. Any who have the Rod of Mimir must be stopped, and the dark one seemed to think that of the elves. And did she speak of Gashir? Who or what is he?|||A demon! We must stop them from summoning up Gashir and retrieve the Rod of Mimir from these evil creatures. These elves must be creatures of magic, for mortals such as you and I cannot hope to weild the Rod ourselves. If that foolish dark one had tried as he wished, he would have frozen to death, for the rod is filled with the snow and cold of the North. I shall help you to protect yourself from the Rod. I shall [weave a bag] to carry the rod in, so it will not harm you.||
rows.StepText: Seek out the Norsewoman surrounded by red and crowned in gold, in the town in the shadow of a city. (whisper: Gashir)|Tell Inaksha the elves must be stopped and that Gashir is a demon. (whisper: must be stopped)|Bring the fur of a firecat.|Bring the fur of a noxious hound.|Give Inaksha the furs.|Find the elves trying to summon Gashir; slay the demon.|Return to Inaksha.
rows.FinishText: Travel into the fires of Muspelheim and bring me the fur of a firecat and a noxious hound. The warmth of their fur will protect you from the cold of the Rod. Return to me when you have both and I shall weave them into a bag for you.
