rows.Name: Grenlock Clan
rows.Description: Hail Spiritmaster! Many great adventures await you, but you must first become aware of our past. [Anrid], a powerful Spiritmaster has decided to lead you along this path. Perhaps with her teaching and your adventurous spirit, the Grenlock clan can once again be united!
rows.SourceText: I am glad to see you follow the path of the House of Hel! Anrid can be found at a tavern near the north gate of this city. Good hourney to you Spiritmaster!||||
rows.TargetText: Sit down my friend and let me tell you [a tale], a tale that you must understand to someday break the spirit bond in the northland. Many hundreds of years ago there was a great clan of Norsemen in the northland of Midgard. They were known as the Grenlock clan, and of them was a great chieftain who strove for peace and kinship among the people. the great man, chieftain Svan Alfevsin lived and worked among his people and was greatly respected. It seems that [history] is never kind to the good hearted, like Svan Alfevson. A great tragedy befell the northlands and their king. An unnatural winter befell the land of the north, known as Urfenlong, freezing the land and water tributaries solid. Being that the Grenlock clan had always lived in a harsh climate they prepared each year with grains and livestock for a harsh winter. However, nothing could have prepared them for the [Urfenlong]. In the third year of the Urfenlong, the land and the seasons were locked in a frozen icy grip. Svan Alfevson called upon his four sons and told them to begin gathering the northland armies and supplies still left. The old king wished for his sons to move the armies and peoples of the Grenlock southward to safety, away from the impending doom of the ice. Great ice sheets moved like living things in the far north, devouring everything in their path and the farthest points of civilization had already succumbed to [the ice]. As the ice moved closer and closer to Svergren Keep, the old king met with his sons one last time. Svan removed his own armor and divided it among his sons keeping only his helmet. Next the king took the Grenlock Crest, the family seal from upon the Keep's wall and with the blade of his battleaxe broke the seal into five pieces. Once again Svan divided the pieces of the crest, just as he did his own armor, and gave a piece to each of his four sons and [kept a piece] for himself. Svan's intention was that one-day, after the terrible unyielding winter that he and his sons would once again reunite and bring the Grenlock clan back together. Several says after Svan's sons left the northland, Svergird's Keep and its ancient stone walls were swept away by the white tide of ice and snow. The terrible storm took the old king with it, and all which remained of the northland. Svan's four sons, <Player>, <Player>, <Player>, and Div marched southward, tearing through [unknown territory]. They passed through Odin's Gate and into the untamed lands continuing to push southward, where they hoped the storm could not reach. The brothers hoped that the mountains of Odin's Gate would hold back the sheets of traveling ice, yet they knew it was not safe to stay that far north. The people of the northland continued to push forward for two years, never settling, always living in fear of what could come over the mountains and sweep them away. A year later due to starvation and exhaustion, the brothers stopped the clan and settled near the sea, [nestled safely] in the mountains near what is now Vasudheim. They hoped that the mountains would stop any invading force, including the elements. It just so happens that the brothers settled in the area that is known today as Jordheim. After several more years the clan had settled in their new home. The brothers once again gathered armies from the north. The intention was for the four of them to split up in the four directions, north, east, south, and west, and explore the new territory they would call home. [Siv was the first] of the brothers to push out of their new home and travel westward. Siv, the youngest of the brothers, put together a small following of an army and led them westward to that shore. Siv and his men settled in the area that is now known as East Svealand. It was here that his followers settled a small township and continued to explore the area in which they perceived to call home. Siv continued to live in East Svealand to the [end of his days] in peace. It is rumored that his [spirit still walks] the lands which he inhabited. You would be wise to seek Siv out and prove this rumor true! Hail! Are you [ready to continue] along the path to unification? As you know Siv had three more brothers. The second brother <Player> decided since Siv was making new settlements outside of their new home that he would patrol the land. <Player>'s goal was to protect all those who survived the journey from the northland. <Player> made friends with many of the creatures that lived in the surrounding areas. It was his goal to make pacts with these creatures so that the land would stay [safe] for all those that lived there, both human and creature. <Player> was very successful in this attempt and many aggressions were worked through. Therefore many lived in peace during his lifetime. He lived a very long time, just as his brother Siv. His spirit resides on this plane in the forests of Myrkwood among his companions, the creatures of those forests. He may have information that will help you upon this journey. He can be found among the creatures of [Myrkwood]. Seek out <Player>'s Spirit! Return to me when you have finished. I cannot believe I hold all but the last piece of the crest! You have done wonders my friend! We have only to merge the five piece into one and [fulfill the wish] of a fallen king, now kept for hundreds of years. The crest pieces can only be merged in the fires of a [forge within Muspelheim]. It is our hopes that should be this accomplished, Svan Alfevson will hear our calling and deliver unto us the final piece. Take these four pieces and seek out the dverge fire-eaters within Muspelheim. They may distrust you at first, but I am told they hate the fire giants that also walk within the fire realm. If you are able to make into the forge of five anvils, deliver all four piece to one named Sinyr. He will do his best to fashion the Grenlock [crest pieces] into one. If the last of the five piece are delivered unto you, Sinyr will make the crest while once more. I look forward to your return! You champion our cause, and we are honored you have taken on this task. Fare thee well! We have heard of your deeds! Let us see the finished crest! The Grenlock clan us whole once more! you have performed a deed unlike any other within Midgard. Whenever anyone speaks of the Grenlock, may they utter your honored named as well! We bestow upon you this simple item, as nothing we could provide would be a just reward! An unnatural winter befell the land of the north, known as Urfenlong, freezing the land and water tributaries solid. Being that the Grenlock clan had always lived in a harsh climate they prepared each year with grains and livestock for a harsh winter. However, nothing could have prepared them for the [Urfenlong]. In the third year of the Urfenlong, the land and the seasons were locked in a frozen icy grip. Svan Alfevson called upon his four sons and told them to begin gathering the northland armies and supplies still left. The old king wished for his sons to move the armies and peoples of the Grenlock southward to safety, away from the impending doom of the ice. Great ice sheets moved like living things in the far north, devouring everything in their path and the farthest points of civilization had already succumbed to [the ice]. As the ice moved closer and closer to Svergren Keep, the old king met with his sons one last time. Svan removed his own armor and divided it among his sons keeping only his helmet. Next the king took the Grenlock Crest, the family seal from upon the Keep's wall and with the blade of his battleaxe broke the seal into five pieces. Once again Svan divided the pieces of the crest, just as he did his own armor, and gave a piece to each of his four sons and [kept a piece] for himself. Svan's intention was that one-day, after the terrible unyielding winter that he and his sons would once again reunite and bring the Grenlock clan back together. They passed through Odin's Gate and into the untamed lands continuing to push southward, where they hoped the storm could not reach. The brothers hoped that the mountains of Odin's Gate would hold back the sheets of traveling ice, yet they knew it was not safe to stay that far north. The people of the northland continued to push forward for two years, never settling, always living in fear of what could come over the mountains and sweep them away. A year later due to starvation and exhaustion, the brothers stopped the clan and settled near the sea, [nestled safely] in the mountains near what is now Vasudheim. They hoped that the mountains would stop any invading force, including the elements. It just so happens that the brothers settled in the area that is known today as Jordheim. After several more years the clan had settled in their new home. The brothers once again gathered armies from the north. The intention was for the four of them to split up in the four directions, north, east, south, and west, and explore the new territory they would call home. [Siv was the first] of the brothers to push out of their new home and travel westward. Siv, the youngest of the brothers, put together a small following of an army and led them westward to that shore. Siv and his men settled in the area that is now known as East Svealand. It was here that his followers settled a small township and continued to explore the area in which they perceived to call home. You have done wonders my friend! We have only to merge the five piece into one and [fulfill the wish] of a fallen king, now kept for hundreds of years. The crest pieces can only be merged in the fires of a [forge within Muspelheim]. It is our hopes that should be this accomplished, Svan Alfevson will hear our calling and deliver unto us the final piece. rows.Name: Grenlock Clan
rows.Description: Hail Spiritmaster! Many great adventures await you, but you must first become aware of our past. [Anrid], a powerful Spiritmaster has decided to lead you along this path. Perhaps with her teaching and your adventurous spirit, the Grenlock clan can once again be united!
rows.SourceText: I am glad to see you follow the path of the House of Hel! Anrid can be found at a tavern near the north gate of this city. Good hourney to you Spiritmaster!||||

Siv continued to live in East Svealand to the [end of his days] in peace. It is rumored that his [spirit still walks] the lands which he inhabited. You would be wise to seek Siv out and prove this rumor true! Hail! Are you [ready to continue] along the path to unification? As you know Siv had three more brothers. The second brother <Player> decided since Siv was making new settlements outside of their new home that he would patrol the land. <Player>'s goal was to protect all those who survived the journey from the northland. <Player> made friends with many of the creatures that lived in the surrounding areas. It was his goal to make pacts with these creatures so that the land would stay [safe] for all those that lived there, both human and creature. <Player> was very successful in this attempt and many aggressions were worked through. Therefore many lived in peace during his lifetime. He lived a very long time, just as his brother Siv. His spirit resides on this plane in the forests of Myrkwood among his companions, the creatures of those forests. He may have information that will help you upon this journey. He can be found among the creatures of [Myrkwood]. Seek out <Player>'s Spirit! Return to me when you have finished. I cannot believe I hold all but the last piece of the crest! You have done wonders my friend! We have only to merge the five piece into one and [fulfill the wish] of a fallen king, now kept for hundreds of years. The crest pieces can only be merged in the fires of a [forge within Muspelheim]. It is our hopes that should be this accomplished, Svan Alfevson will hear our calling and deliver unto us the final piece. Take these four pieces and seek out the dverge fire-eaters within Muspelheim. They may distrust you at first, but I am told they hate the fire giants that also walk within the fire realm. If you are able to make into the forge of five anvils, deliver all four piece to one named Sinyr. He will do his best to fashion the Grenlock [crest pieces] into one. If the last of the five piece are delivered unto you, Sinyr will make the crest while once more. I look forward to your return! You champion our cause, and we are honored you have taken on this task. Fare thee well! We have heard of your deeds! Let us see the finished crest! The Grenlock clan us whole once more! you have performed a deed unlike any other within Midgard. Whenever anyone speaks of the Grenlock, may they utter your honored named as well! We bestow upon you this simple item, as nothing we could provide would be a just reward! Thank you!
rows.StepText: Hear Anrid's tale of the Grenlock Crest. (whisper: a tale)|Recover the four pieces of the crest from Svan's sons (levels 15, 20, 25, 30).|Learn from Anrid how to make the crest whole. (whisper: fulfill the wish)|Take the four pieces to Sinyr at the Dverge forge in Muspelheim.|Present the finished crest to Anrid.

rows.TargetText: Thank you for answering my summons, <Player>. I have been ill lately and am too weak to venture far. I have been working with my cousin Elizabeth in Mular. She is an enchantress and has been working on new enchantments for weapons ans armor. When she found out I was coming here, she asked me to gather potential enchantment components and send them to her. I agreed, but then I took ill. Since then I have been [unable to gather] anything. Apparently there have been some problems over on the mainland, for Elizabeth recently sent me a very urgent message begging for the new components. Since I cannot get them, I am asking you to get them for me. Elizabeth needs the essences of some of the creatures that roam the lands. But before you can gather those essences, I must make the vessel to hold them. You must [get me the parts] I need to make the vessel. There are two parts to the vessel. The first is a gilded fang from a scimitar kit. When it is cleaned out and enchanted properly, it will hold the essences Elizabeth needs. rows.Name: Hill Cat Hunt
rows.Description: I have given you a task! Prove [yourself] worthy or bother me no more.
rows.SourceText: I assume you have more?||||||||
rows.TargetText: |||||Ah, are you the one Thordia has sent me? Are you [on the hunt]? ?There is one vile beast that has feasted on many of my men. Thordia has promised me a great warrior. Kill Hrrgyf, the hill cat that roams the mountains here. Bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. My thanks. Take this small reward my men have collected in hopes you would succeed. Thordia will be pleased. I am sure she will reward you when she sees you again.||Ah, are you the one Thordia has sent me? Are you [on the hunt]? ?There is one vile beast that has feasted on many of my men. Thordia has promised me a great warrior. Kill Hrrgyf, the hill cat that roams the mountains here. Bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. My thanks. Take this small reward my men have collected in hopes you would succeed. Thordia will be pleased. I am sure she will reward you when she sees you again.|
rows.StepText: Bring Thordia five hill cat teeth. (1/5)|Bring Thordia five hill cat teeth. (2/5)|Bring Thordia five hill cat teeth. (3/5)|Bring Thordia five hill cat teeth. (4/5)|Bring Thordia five hill cat teeth. (5/5)|Seek out Viking Karl at the guard tower in the mountains. (whisper: on the hunt)|Kill the hill cat Hrrgyf and bring her tooth.|Bring the tooth to Viking Karl.|Tell Thordia of your great deed.
rows.FinishText: I have heard of your great deed! You have killed Hrrgyf! For that, I shall honor you! Take this gift, granted only to the greatest warriors! I shall speak your name to Tyr!

rows.Name: New Crest
rows.Description: Ah, [Bonedancer]. You've aided Karle before, haven't you? Well, guess what! He's got a new idea. He wants to create a new clan crest!
rows.TargetName: Karle Alfevson;151|Karle Alfevson;151|Karle Alfevson;151|Karle Alfevson;151|Karle Alfevson;151
rows.SourceText: Tell Karle Alfevson you are curious about his new clan crest. (whisper: Crest)||||
rows.TargetText: Ah, <Player>. So as it turns out, making a new Clan [Crest] won't solve the problems of my clan. However, I would still like to make one. I want a crest to represent our achievements here, in this new land! Aye. I think that using the talisman and the primitive icons of this land would be appropriate. So, what do you [think]? Morvalt ungdom often carry primitive tokens of luck. Find two morvalt ungdom and bring me their tokens! Great. Now, I also heard that morvalt fast-walkers carry magical stones that give them speed. I would like to place the stones somewhere in the cest. Could you get me two? Oh. Well, this is great. I appreciate your helping Grenlock Clan. I don't know how the search for the crest pieces is going back in the old lands, but I'm sure this new clan crest will gain power of its own!||||

rows.Name: Prove Kobold Helen's Innocence
rows.Description: Hail! I have a small problem. A niece of mine, a pleasant child, is accused of [attacking travelers] on the road at night!
rows.TargetName: Sentry Litenberg;100|Kobold Helen;100|Kobold Dirge;100|Escort Sentry;100|Kobold Helen;100
rows.SourceText: They won't let you speak to her for long, though, so speak with Sentry Litenberg.||||
rows.TargetText: Sarry send you? Kobold Helen to die in morning. You [wish her to live]? Fine. You prove she not kill travelers at night, she go free. Have 'til morning, or she die here in tower. Speak with her, if you haven't already. If she not here, she on road to here.||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Sentry Litenberg at Dvalin. (whisper: wish her to live)|Talk to Kobold Helen.|Find Helen's twin south of the guard tower and prove her innocence.|Give the tattered flesh to an escort sentry.|Let Kobold Helen thank you.

rows.Name: Prove Kobold Helen's Innocence
rows.Description: Hail! I have a small problem. A niece of mine, a pleasant child, is accused of [attacking travelers] on the road at night!
rows.TargetName: Sentry Litenberg;100|Kobold Helen;100|Kobold Dirge;100|Escort Sentry;100|Kobold Helen;100
rows.SourceText: They won't let you speak to her for long, though, so speak with Sentry Litenberg.||||
rows.TargetText: Sarry send you? Kobold Helen to die in morning. You [wish her to live]? Fine. You prove she not kill travelers at night, she go free. Have 'til morning, or she die here in tower. Speak with her, if you haven't already. If she not here, she on road to here.||||
rows.StepText: Speak with Sentry Litenberg at Dvalin. (whisper: wish her to live)|Talk to Kobold Helen.|Find Helen's twin south of the guard tower and prove her innocence.|Give the tattered flesh to an escort sentry.|Let Kobold Helen thank you.

rows.Name: Rasczel's Nose
rows.Description: [Rasczel's]
rows.SourceText: Bring back the nose of the hobyah Rasczel.|
rows.StepText: Bring back the nose of the hobyah Rasczel.|Bring the nose to your trainer.

rows.Name: Runes of Darkness
rows.Description: [Darkness]
rows.SourceText: Ask Sentry Litenberg where the Lone Weeping Willow grows. (whisper: a branch)||
rows.TargetText: Ah, do you search these woods for the Lone Weeping Willow? Several seek this tree for it's branches. Do you seek [a branch] from this willow? Well then, I know where you need to search. Go to the western shore of the big lake in West Svealand. The lone willow you seek can be found there, just south of Vindsaul Faste. You must take the branch to Eirik of Audliten. Only he can work that wood.||Give me the branch, I can work it into a staff. This is a fine branch. Here, I have fashioned you a staff.
rows.StepText: Ask Sentry Litenberg where the Lone Weeping Willow grows. (whisper: a branch)|Cut a branch from the Lone Weeping Willow.|Bring the branch to Eirik in Audliten.

rows.Name: Saving the Clan
rows.Description: What? You haven't heard? There is trouble in the Grenlock Clan. Shortly after you brought the sword back to me, a dark cloud settled around both the crest and the sword. I thought it was part of the protection spell but then Arnfinn started sending me messages that things were happening to people of the Clan. Harmless creatures attacking people, strange illnesses overtaking others. All signs point to [a problem] with the crest and the sword, but alas, I do not know what it may be.
rows.SourceText: Thank you. I knew the Grenlock Clan could trust in your abilities and your dedication. Now, as I've said, I do not know exactly what has befallen the crest and sword, but I know of one who might. She is ancient, and has learned all the legends and tales of the Grenlock Clan for as far back as they go. You must go and [see her].||||
rows.TargetText: Well hello there, child. Oh, do not look at me so for calling you that. When you have lived as long as I have, everyone is a child. Now usually children don't come to me unless they were sent to me. Who sent you here to me? So Anrid sent you? I am not surprised. She came to me recently to tell her the legends of the Grenlock Clan. Now, I know many stories and legends, and perhaps one day I will be able to share them with you and others, but for now we must focus on the task that Anrid has sent you on. She told me that trouble has befallen the Grenlock Clan, and she was going to send one who would [solve the mystery]. Since Anrid came to me, I have been going through all the stories I know related to the Clan but I've reference to visitors from a far off land that resulted in the death of a girl of the clan named Freyana. Freyana was the most beloved daughter of the clan at the time these visitors came to Midgard. It was said she was so beautiful when she was born that she was named after the goddess of beauty, <Player>. But [something happened] to her while she was still young. Unfortunately I do not know what caused it, but somehow Freyana died saving her childhood friend; a troll named Ljagnid. Healers of the Clan worked desperately to save Freyana's life, but their magics failed and her spirit was held here instead of travelling on to Valhalla. Legends say that Freyana's spirit grew bitter and ugly with her resentment towards the clan but especially to Ljagnid. She haunted him, sending horrible things [to torment him] day and night. The torment became too much for him and he died from a mixture of fear and grief. Freyana watched this with joy, for she felt she was avenged. But her joy quickly turned to anger when she saw that Ljagnid was being taken to Valhalla, a place she had long been denied. She shrieked a curse at Ljagnid, and bound him to her, keeping him trapped here in the same tortured existance she suffers. It is rumored that Freyana and [Ljagnid] now roam around Vanern Swamp together, for that is where both their bodies where laid to rest, with the great kings and queens of Midgard. In the stories I have found, it was speculated that Ljagnid wrote down his story and what brought about Freyana's death. If we only had that book! Some say it was lost forever while others say Ljagnid took the book with him when he died. Only you can [discover the truth] now, child. You must travel to the sweltering depths of Vanern Swamp and seek out Freyana and Ljagnid at night and see if Ljagnid has this book. Freyana is evil, and cannot stand having Ljagnid around but she cannot let him go, they say. So she forces him into hiding most of the time, but when something tries to harm her, and try things do, for she is a most evil creature now, Ljagnid springs from hiding to help her. I fear you will not be able to face Freyana and Ljagnid alone, for they have both grown very strong. Gather your forces and take them with you for protection. Remember, Freyana only roams at night. If you are able to obtain the book, bring it back to me here. Visitors have come to the encampment today. They are from anotherland, I think, for they look different then the Grenlock Clan. Freyana was all excited about the visitors coming, but then she dreams of going to far off places. Me, I'm happier here with the Clan. Freyana was worried about me, because she thinks the visitors have never seen a troll before and would be scared of me. I went off into the woods for a while and talked with the other trolls in the area. Freyana came to me after sunset and told me about the visitors. They don't know our language, but drew pictures in the dirt to make themselves understood. Freyana says they are nice, but she wants me to stay away a while longer. He [continues] the story a week later. The visitors have begun to learn the language of the clan, and we theirs. Freyana continues to hide me and the other trolls from Kelic, the leader of the magic users. She is too protective of me. I told her I wish to learn their language too, and she promised me she would teach me. I think tomorrow I will sneak close to their encampment and see them for myself. I am curious to see if they look like the Clan or like me. Freyana has come back to my hidings place to bring me food. I must go eat now and finish this later. Ljagnid stops writing there and did not finish on that day. [His next entry] is about Freyana's death. Perhaps this will help us. 'Ingvarr and his friends have been searching for a week now, but have not found the visitors. Everyone thought they had made it to their own lands until <Player> showed up. He said that the deserters of the Clan had taken in the visitors and were making a deal with them. <Player> feared the deal and left them, returning to the Clan. He begged to be accepted back into the Clan, but no one trusts him. The Alfevsons took him back in, but they secretly set someone to watch him at all times. I think <Player> is [up to no good].' A few days later Ljagnid writes, 'I was right. <Player> left us again today, but he said he wasn't returning to the deserters. He still feared the visitors. He told us he was going north, because he thought the visitors were going to do something bad to the Clan and to the deserters. Some people went with him, but we never saw any of them again. When he left, I saw him carrying a bunch of scrolls. I checked with everyone, but no one was missing any, so they must have belonged to <Player> after all. Something strange is happening to me. I have started seeing strange creatures no one else sees. I am scared.' That is where the book ends. [Interesting], is it not? Now, before you start wondering, I know of these rengades Ljagnid wrote of in his journal. They were once Clansmen and women. When the Clan moved into the area, they had two choices - live in peace with the trolls, kobolds, and dwarves, or conquer them. The Alfvesons, chose to live in peace, and this made some of the Clan members [angry]. These members did not like the non-human races. They felt that co-existing with them rather than ruling them showed weakness. Rather than live in that situation, they packed up and left, following the loudest of them, <Player>. I guess you could say they are the forerunners to the Blodfelags that roam the lands now. He led them out into the wilderness, where they roamed for a short time until they mysteriously died out. They had no name for themselves, but in the Clan they were referred to as the deserters. I also know of this man, [<Player>]. I have a few notes about him in different books. He and his followers moved around quite a bit, but finally settled in Raumarik. It is said his spirit still haunts the land, although now he fears everyone, thinking they have been sent by either the deserters or the visitors. I believe the scrolls he took will contain the answer to what the visitors planned to do to the Clan. I need you to travel now to Raumarik and find <Player>. His followers are always with him, hoping for his protection, so take many with you to defeat them. When you reach Raumarik, head to the river. Cross the river and head north until you find <Player>. Return to me when you have the scrolls of <Player>. So you have returned from Raumarik, child. What do you bring me from the deserter, <Player>? Ah, I am glad you were able to get these. They will [solve the mystery] of the Clan's problems, I am sure. I shall need a minute or two to scan over <Player>'s scrolls to see if I can learn anything [about the visitors]. rows.FinishText: Her name is Danica, and she lives in Mularn. Go to her now, and tell her that Anrid sent you. I wish you luck in your endeavor.

rows.StepText: Tell Danica in Mularn that Anrid sent you. (whisper: Anrid sent me)|Seek out Freyana and Ljagnid in Vanern Swamp at night and recover the book.|Bring Danica Ljagnid's journal.|Find Runil in Raumarik and take his scrolls.|Give Danica the scrolls of Runil.
rows.FinishText: Her name is Danica, and she lives in Mularn. Go to her now, and tell her that Anrid sent you. I wish you luck in your endeavor.

rows.Name: Saving the Clan
rows.Description: What? You haven't heard? There is trouble in the Grenlock Clan. Shortly after you brought the sword back to me, a dark cloud settled around both the crest and the sword. I thought it was part of the protection spell but then Arnfinn started sending me messages that things were happening to people of the Clan. Harmless creatures attacking people, strange illnesses overtaking others. All signs point to [a problem] with the crest and the sword, but alas, I do not know what it may be.
rows.SourceText: Thank you. I knew the Grenlock Clan could trust in your abilities and your dedication. Now, as I've said, I do not know exactly what has befallen the crest and sword, but I know of one who might. She is ancient, and has learned all the legends and tales of the Grenlock Clan for as far back as they go. You must go and [see her].||||

rows.StepText: Tell Danica in Mularn that Anrid sent you. (whisper: Anrid sent me)|Seek out Freyana and Ljagnid in Vanern Swamp at night and recover the book.|Bring Danica Ljagnid's journal.|Find Runil in Raumarik and take his scrolls.|Give Danica the scrolls of Runil.
rows.FinishText: Her name is Danica, and she lives in Mularn. Go to her now, and tell her that Anrid sent you. I wish you luck in your endeavor.

rows.Name: Saving the Clan
rows.Description: What? You haven't heard? There is trouble in the Grenlock Clan. Shortly after you brought the sword back to me, a dark cloud settled around both the crest and the sword. I thought it was part of the protection spell but then Arnfinn started sending me messages that things were happening to people of the Clan. Harmless creatures attacking people, strange illnesses overtaking others. All signs point to [a problem] with the crest and the sword, but alas, I do not know what it may be.
rows.SourceText: Thank you. I knew the Grenlock Clan could trust in your abilities and your dedication. Now, as I've said, I do not know exactly what has befallen the crest and sword, but I know of one who might. She is ancient, and has learned all the legends and tales of the Grenlock Clan for as far back as they go. You must go and [see her].||||

But her joy quickly turned to anger when she saw that Ljagnid was being taken to Valhalla, a place she had long been denied. She shrieked a curse at Ljagnid, and bound him to her, keeping him trapped here in the same tortured existance she suffers. It is rumored that Freyana and [Ljagnid] now roam around Vanern Swamp together, for that is where both their bodies where laid to rest, with the great kings and queens of Midgard. In the stories I have found, it was speculated that Ljagnid wrote down his story and what brought about Freyana's death. If we only had that book! Some say it was lost forever while others say Ljagnid took the book with him when he died. Only you can [discover the truth] now, child. You must travel to the sweltering depths of Vanern Swamp and seek out Freyana and Ljagnid at night and see if Ljagnid has this book. Freyana is evil, and cannot stand having Ljagnid around but she cannot let him go, they say. So she forces him into hiding most of the time, but when something tries to harm her, and try things do, for she is a most evil creature now, Ljagnid springs from hiding to help her. I fear you will not be able to face Freyana and Ljagnid alone, for they have both grown very strong. Gather your forces and take them with you for protection. Remember, Freyana only roams at night. If you are able to obtain the book, bring it back to me here. Visitors have come to the encampment today. They are from anotherland, I think, for they look different then the Grenlock Clan. Freyana was all excited about the visitors coming, but then she dreams of going to far off places. Me, I'm happier here with the Clan. Freyana was worried about me, because she thinks the visitors have never seen a troll before and would be scared of me. I went off into the woods for a while and talked with the other trolls in the area. Freyana came to me after sunset and told me about the visitors. They don't know our language, but drew pictures in the dirt to make themselves understood. Freyana says they are nice, but she wants me to stay away a while longer. He [continues] the story a week later. The visitors have begun to learn the language of the clan, and we theirs. Freyana continues to hide me and the other trolls from Kelic, the leader of the magic users. She is too protective of me. I told her I wish to learn their language too, and she promised me she would teach me. I think tomorrow I will sneak close to their encampment and see them for myself. I am curious to see if they look like the Clan or like me. Freyana has come back to my hidings place to bring me food. I must go eat now and finish this later. Ljagnid stops writing there and did not finish on that day. [His next entry] is about Freyana's death. Perhaps this will help us. 'Ingvarr and his friends have been searching for a week now, but have not found the visitors. Everyone thought they had made it to their own lands until <Player> showed up. He said that the deserters of the Clan had taken in the visitors and were making a deal with them. <Player> feared the deal and left them, returning to the Clan. He begged to be accepted back into the Clan, but no one trusts him. The Alfevsons took him back in, but they secretly set someone to watch him at all times. I think <Player> is [up to no good].' A few days later Ljagnid writes, 'I was right. <Player> left us again today, but he said he wasn't returning to the deserters. He still feared the visitors. He told us he was going north, because he thought the visitors were going to do something bad to the Clan and to the deserters. Some people went with him, but we never saw any of them again. When he left, I saw him carrying a bunch of scrolls. I checked with everyone, but no one was missing any, so they must have belonged to <Player> after all. Something strange is happening to me. I have started seeing strange creatures no one else sees. I am scared.' That is where the book ends. [Interesting], is it not? Now, before you start wondering, I know of these rengades Ljagnid wrote of in his journal. They were once Clansmen and women. When the Clan moved into the area, they had two choices - live in peace with the trolls, kobolds, and dwarves, or conquer them. The Alfvesons, chose to live in peace, and this made some of the Clan members [angry]. These members did not like the non-human races. They felt that co-existing with them rather than ruling them showed weakness. Rather than live in that situation, they packed up and left, following the loudest of them, <Player>. I guess you could say they are the forerunners to the Blodfelags that roam the lands now. He led them out into the wilderness, where they roamed for a short time until they mysteriously died out. They had no name for themselves, but in the Clan they were referred to as the deserters. I also know of this man, [<Player>]. I have a few notes about him in different books. He and his followers moved around quite a bit, but finally settled in Raumarik. It is said his spirit still haunts the land, although now he fears everyone, thinking they have been sent by either the deserters or the visitors. I believe the scrolls he took will contain the answer to what the visitors planned to do to the Clan. I need you to travel now to Raumarik and find <Player>. His followers are always with him, hoping for his protection, so take many with you to defeat them. When you reach Raumarik, head to the river. Cross the river and head north until you find <Player>. Return to me when you have the scrolls of <Player>. So you have returned from Raumarik, child. What do you bring me from the deserter, <Player>? Ah, I am glad you were able to get these. They will [solve the mystery] of the Clan's problems, I am sure. I shall need a minute or two to scan over <Player>'s scrolls to see if I can learn anything [about the visitors]. While I do that, why don't you take a look at what Anrid sent over for you.

rows.Name: The War Continues
rows.Description: Ah my friend. You got word I needed you. I've received word from Masrim again. There have been more sightings of [the Albion undead] recently.
rows.SourceText: So you return. Gunnolf sent word he has you go to Masrim. That was good , for she knows more of this than anyone. What did you learn from her?|||||||||Choose your reward: [Mischief Maker's Axe], [Mischief Maker's Great Axe], [Winter's Spear], [Winter's Blade], [Sword of Ice], [Bow of the North].
rows.TargetText: Hail. I recognize you from Masrim's description. She was sure that once Morlin spoke to you of the evil invading our land, you would once again rise to the task. I was afraid to include too many details of what I've seen in my note. I did not want to spread panic across my beloved homeland. Let me tell you [what I've seen]. I was out on patrol recently in Yggdra Forest. As I was returning, I happened to catch a glimpse of a person dressed in black meeting with another in the same attire. I didn't think too much of it, for both seemed harmless enough. I saw something pass from one hand to another - something round and white, kind of like a bone or a skull. They both [headed off] in opposite directions after the item changed hands. It was a few days after that the reports started coming in from travelers about a group of undead roaming the Forest. They have been seen in [many places]. They seem to avoid the guards and patrols, but the travelers speak of them near the water at night. Since they avoid the patrols, I believe you will be able to find them, If you see them, do not hesitate to attack. Masrim has said she cannot solve the riddle of who controls the undead without knowing how they are controlled. You have returned! I am most pleased to see you survived. Did those vile creatures have anything that might give us a clue as to who is controlling them? Why, this is the skull I saw the two cloaked figures exchanging! I was out on patrol recently in Yggdra Forest. As I was returning, I happened to catch a glimpse of a person dressed in black meeting with another in the same attire. I didn't think too much of it, for both seemed harmless enough. I saw something pass from one hand to another - something round and white, kind of like a bone or a skull. They both [headed off] in opposite directions after the item changed hands. It was a few days after that the reports started coming in from travelers about a group of undead roaming the Forest. They have been seen in [many places]. They seem to avoid the guards and patrols, but the travelers speak of them near the water at night. rows.SourceText: Attend to Elizabeth the enchanter in Mularn. (whisper: the secrets)|||||||||||Choose your reward: [Blessed Northern Sword], [Blessed Northern Great Sword], [Blessed Northern Axe], [Blessed Northern Great Axe], [Blessed Northern Hammer], [Blessed Northern Great Hammer], [Midnight Defender], [Beryl Bulwark], [Barbed Claws], [Bedlam Bladestopper], [Blessed Bladed Claw Greave], [Sword of the Ice], [Snowborn Spear].
rows.TargetText: You will not regret the decision to help me, although at times the way will be hard. The tome I spoke of is in two pieces. I only know the location of the first half of the tome. A shaman named Tyia holds the first half. She has sent word to me that she will give me the half she possesses if I will brind her something [she desires]. She desires the heart of a battle-scarred mauler. It is the final component Tyria needs for a charm she wished to make. Travel to Skona Ravine and get the heart. Take it to Tyria in Vindsaul Faste. She will then give you what I seek, along with the location of the second half. This is the entire tome! This is beyond my expectations! Now, let me see what is involved in enchanting weapons. Someone in Tyria's family must have been an enchanter in ancient times, or else they copied this book from another. It is written in ancient Kobold, which I happen to know. Part of my training to become an enchanter was to learn all the ancient languages, for many enchantments are in ancient tongues. I bet Tyia did not think I could do so much with this, for that very reason, or else she wouldn't have let it go for such a low price. With this tome, I can enchant many weapons for the brave inhabitants of this land, such as those of the House of Bragi. Now, in the tome, it says there are [three basic things] needed for the enchantment. It's almost humorous, to think that three simple things, when combined in the right amounts, will create such a powerful enchantment. The gods do have a sense of humor after all, it appears. When you hear what the three things are, you would never think to put them together. Well, let me send you out for [one thing] first. According to the book, it will take the longest to prepare. Then I shall have you get the other two. You must travel into Varulvhamn in Skona Ravine. Seek out a werewolf noble and acquire its pelt. Once you have it, return to me. Good, you have returned. I must take the pelt and burn it. Give me the pelt please. The ashes contain the magical property that allows a werewolf to transform himself into a beast or a man. It is that property that will help transform everyday weapons into magical ones. Now, are you ready for the [other items]? You must travel to Uppland. There hunt for the wyvern and the taiga cat. From the wyvern, get a scale. The scale contains many magical properties of the gods and is essential to the enchantment. From the taiga cat, bring me a claw. The claw will add sharpness to the weapons I enchant. Return to me when you have both. Ah, the legendary scale of the wyvern. This is perfect. Now, the taiga claw please. I cannot use the new enchantments without it. Thank you for the claw. The enchantment is complete. Now you must pick your reward. Which do you desire - [one handed] or [two handed] or a [shield]. Choose carefully, for once your choice is made; you cannot change your mind. After turning in both items to Elizabeth, gain 62,914,560 experience as well Two Handed Conclusion: An axe, eh? Give me but a minute and I shall have it.||So, you've come to me from Elizabeth, have you? I told her what I wanted in exchange for the tome. Do you have the mauler heart? Ah, this is a wonderful mauler heart. I will finally be able to complete that charm I was asked to make. I've been asked to make another charm and I do not have all the things I need for it. Get me [the item] I need, and I will give you both halves of the tome Elizabeth wants. It is but a trifle really, a small token from [a creature] of the ice and snow. There are creatures in Yggdra's Forest known simply as blocks of ice. You must seek out one and retrieve its icy heart. Once you have it, return to me and I shall give you the tome. Ah, you have returned. My patrons have been waiting for their protection charms to take with them into the frontier. Please, give me that icy heart. Here is your tome; although I do not know what good it will do Elizabeth. It is written in ancient Kobold and worth nothing to me anymore, since I cannot read that language. rows.Name: Hill Cat Hunt -- Savage Version
rows.Description: Hail Mavador! Kelgor grants skill in battle to those who train as hard as you. Now it's time to put that skill to another use. Kelgor wishes you to go [on the hunt] for some exclusive creature.
rows.SourceText: I have given you a task! Prove yourself worthy or be gone from the house of Kelgor! Go get five hill cat teeth!||||||||
rows.TargetText: |||||You are from Jaakko, are you not? He said he would send one to help me [with hunting] an evil creature. The vile beast Hrrgyf has feasted on many of my men. Jaakko claims that this hill cat will not feast upon a Savage. Kill Hrrgyf and bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. She roams the mountains near here. Take this small reward with my thanks. I must now see to training my men better and you must return to Jaakko. He wishes to speak to you.||You are from Jaakko, are you not? He said he would send one to help me [with hunting] an evil creature. The vile beast Hrrgyf has feasted on many of my men. Jaakko claims that this hill cat will not feast upon a Savage. Kill Hrrgyf and bring me her tooth, as proof of your deed. She roams the mountains near here. Take this small reward with my thanks. rows.Name: Siv's Spirit
rows.Description: [Spirit]
rows.SourceText: You have returned. Did you obtain that which was required of you?||
rows.TargetText: Life is never to be taken for [granted] for one always reaps what they sow. I traveled many years, running in fear from the terrible consuming northern storm. After may years my brothers and I settled our armies and clan and built shelter and a new civilization after the terrible storm that wiped away our homeland. Our father stayed behind, leaving us with only pieces of his armor and pieces of our great clan crest of Grenlock. I too stay behind to watch over what is left of [our clan] here in these parts. There is little of the Grenlock Clan left, only our people and the shards of the crest my father entrusted me to us, both now scattered to the wind. You must make sure to gather the crest piece from my long dead wife, [Ulga}. This must be done at all costs! Search for her soul and ask for the Grenlock Crest shard. Should you succeed, the House of Hel shall make us whole! I can assist you no more Spiritmaster. May the gods guard you on the rest of your journey, just as they have done with me.|How may I help you young one? The only way you could know about the Grenlock Crest is if my husband [Siv] had spoken to you or you are an agent of evil! It is doubtful that he has sent you! If you wish the crest, you must take it by force! I have failed you my love!|
rows.StepText: Seek out the spirit of Siv in East Svealand. (whisper: granted)|Find Siv's wife Ulga and acquire the crest piece. (whisper: crest)|Return to Anrid.
rows.FinishText: I see you have met Siv. He was very kind to his people, always wishing them the best and his family. Perhaps someday the Grenlock Clan name will be restored. Safe journey Spiritmaster.

rows.Name: Amora's Aid
rows.Description: The lady Amora here in Fort Atla has been here for several weeks because she is [unable] to travel.
rows.TargetName: Amora;100|water snake;100|water snake;100|water snake;100|water snake;100|water snake;100|Kari;100
rows.SourceText: Seek out Amora upstairs in the second building on the left inside Fort Atla.||||||
rows.TargetText: Be still Magnild, all will be alright soon and you will be well once again. Hello stranger, may I ask your <Player>? It is a pleasure to meet you. I am so glad you have come to aid me and [Magnild]. Yes, my poor darling Magnild was bitten by a [water snake] while traveling into town. Unfortunately, the bite has not healed and she is not feeling very well at all. Oh, it seems the venom of the snake was very powerful. I have sent word to t he healer and she has told me she needs five vials of [snake venom] to cure the child. I do not feel right leaving Magnild [here alone] this ill, so I fear I can't hunt the snakes myself. Please go outside the city and [collect] the five vials of venom and take them to Kari, the healer. I am indebted to you always if you do the for me.||||||Ahh, you look as if you have been having a rough time. Have you brought me the vials of snake venom? I shall begin [work] at once in making the potion to cure the sick girl, hopefully all my training will not fail me. You have aided in this situation beyond what is expected. I thnk you.
rows.StepText: Seek out Amora upstairs in the second building on the left inside Fort Atla.|Collect five vials of venom from the water snakes along the road and toward the lake outside Fort Atla. (1/5)|Collect five vials of venom from the water snakes along the road and toward the lake outside Fort Atla. (2/5)|Collect five vials of venom from the water snakes along the road and toward the lake outside Fort Atla. (3/5)|Collect five vials of venom from the water snakes along the road and toward the lake outside Fort Atla. (4/5)|Collect five vials of venom from the water snakes along the road and toward the lake outside Fort Atla. (5/5)|Give the vials to Kari the healer in the long house in Fort Atla.

rows.Name: Bad Food
rows.Description: Oh, I am not feeling very well at all. I don't think there's one member of this town that hasn't felt a little queasy at least (once?) from all the bad fish we've [eaten].
rows.SourceText: Oh good! Talk to Kedra about [bad fish]. She'll tell you what needs to be done.||
rows.TargetText: Fish! The entire town has eaten bad fish! It is crazy! I told them not to! I told them the moon's position in the sky indicated a bad harvest of fish, but did anyone listen? And now, everyone is [sick]. Yes. Sick. Why are you here? Are you sick? You don't look sick to me. You can help me. I am running out of my cure! I don't have time to go get the [marine fungus] I need! Aye. I mash it up and add herbs to it. It's a great cure! I need more though! Go get me a marine fungus. I will pay you for it! And the whole town will thank you, when they are through wretching up the illness, that is. Oh thank you! The stench of the ill is getting to me! I can make a few more batches of my cure after this, and then be done with it all! This will teach everyone to ignore me! Let's see if they eat the fish the next time I say the moon isn't right! Here, I hope this is enough. Thank you for your aid!||Fish! The entire town has eaten bad fish! It is crazy! I told them not to! I can make a few more batches of my cure after this, and then be done with it all! This will teach everyone to ignore me! Let's see if they eat the fish the next time I say the moon isn't right! Here, I hope this is enough. Thank you for your aid!
rows.StepText: Talk to Kedra, the healer, about the illness in the town.|Kill a marine fungus south across the bridge.|Return to Kedra with the marine fungus.

rows.Name: Learn the Hunt
rows.Description: Greetings, are you [worthy of the hunt]?
rows.TargetName: black mauler cub;100|black mauler cub;100|black mauler cub;100|black mauler cub;100|black mauler cub;100|Aegan;100
rows.SourceText: You are doing well! Continue to pass me the bear claws!|||||
rows.StepText: Hunt black mauler cubs for five claws. (1/5)|Hunt black mauler cubs for five claws. (2/5)|Hunt black mauler cubs for five claws. (3/5)|Hunt black mauler cubs for five claws. (4/5)|Hunt black mauler cubs for five claws. (5/5)|Return to Aegan with all five bear claws.
rows.FinishText: You have proven yourself well youngster! I hope the coin serves you well.

rows.Name: Rinda's Lost Keys
rows.Description: Greetings, and welcome to the dwarf town of Haggerfel. I wish I could stay and talk with you for a moment, but I am in a hurry to find my [lost keys].
rows.TargetName: hobgoblin snake-finder;100|black mauler cub;100|Dwarven Guard Rinda;100
rows.SourceText: Thank you! Thank you! I know there are some hobgoblins around that like to play jokes on people, viscious and mean ones. Why don't you check there while I check the merchant huts again?||
rows.StepText: Search for a hobgoblin snake-finder around Haggerfel and see if it has Rinda's keys.|Slay the black mauler cub that ate Rinda's key.|Return the keys and keychain to Rinda in Haggerfel.
rows.FinishText: Ah! This is great! My key! You have done a fabulous job in helping me. Please accept this coin in return for your time and effort. Thank you so much! Now, I can safely lock up the town's money. Thank you!

rows.Name: Sveabone Hilt Sword
rows.Description: Hail young one! I have noticed that you do not carry one of my fine [bone hilt swords].
rows.SourceText: Oh great then! Run along and buy me a bronze short sword. I should be ready once you return.||
rows.TargetText: Good work! I cannot seem to find anymore sveawolf teeth to fashion your weapon. Find one and return it to me.||
rows.StepText: Buy a bronze short sword from Gyda, southwest of the Jordheim bridge, and give it to Gridash.|Kill a sveawolf and return with its tooth.|Return to Gridash in Vasudheim with the tooth.
rows.FinishText: Here is your completed work. I hope it serves you well!

rows.Name: Trapper's Pride
rows.Description: Do you know that the famous trapper [Wariel] is here in town from Fort Atla?
rows.TargetName: Wariel;100|tawny lynx cub;100|tawny lynx cub;100|tawny lynx cub;100|tawny lynx cub;100|tawny lynx cub;100|Wariel;100
rows.SourceText: Find Wariel and see if she would be willing to teach you a few secrets of trapping.||||||
rows.TargetText: Well hello young one. What is your <Player>? Well, it is a pleasure to meet you. I enjoy meeting all the young Vikings throughoout our [realm]. Did you know that the [art] of trapping is very important here in Midgard, for everyone? Yes, [trapping] is an art, the skinning of an animal, preserving the pelt and tanning it for use. Trapping and doing these things correctly can [fetch] you a good deal of popularity to traders and bring in a nice profit. Go in to woods and see if yo ucan capture fice tawny lynx cubs and bring their pelts to me so that I may prepare them. You have done a wonderful [job] and these pelts will work quite nicely. I shall begin preserving and tanning these skins shortly. Once they are finished tanning I may have another job for you.||||||Well hello young one. What is your <Player>? Well, it is a pleasure to meet you. I enjoy meeting all the young Vikings throughoout our [realm]. Did you know that the [art] of trapping is very important here in Midgard, for everyone? Yes, [trapping] is an art, the skinning of an animal, preserving the pelt and tanning it for use. Trapping and doing these things correctly can [fetch] you a good deal of popularity to traders and bring in a nice profit. Go in to woods and see if yo ucan capture fice tawny lynx cubs and bring their pelts to me so that I may prepare them. You have done a wonderful [job] and these pelts will work quite nicely. I shall begin preserving and tanning these skins shortly. Once they are finished tanning I may have another job for you.
rows.StepText: Find Wariel near the left bone crossing out of Galplen.|Capture five tawny lynx cubs in the woods and bring their pelts. (1/5)|Capture five tawny lynx cubs in the woods and bring their pelts. (2/5)|Capture five tawny lynx cubs in the woods and bring their pelts. (3/5)|Capture five tawny lynx cubs in the woods and bring their pelts. (4/5)|Capture five tawny lynx cubs in the woods and bring their pelts. (5/5)|Bring the pelts to Wariel.

rows.Name: Trial of Strength
rows.Description: Hail. I am Torold, and I shall be your trainer in this wild land. King Goran Stonefist and his brother Stonelock have charged me with training all young Vikings to prepare them to join the ranks of King Goran's army to aid in the exploration of Aegir. Aegir is a wild, untamed place, and it's made even more dangerous for a your Viking like you by the presence of [Morvaltar].
rows.SourceText: Seek out Jorund Bruttstein in Aegirhamn and tell him your name.||
rows.TargetText: Lo, I see a young Viking before me. What is your name? Speak up! You are here to prove that you have the strength in you to endure in this land. The trial is simple in nature, but unless you are strong, may prove difficult to execute. You must venture out and face [one of the creatures] that roam this land. You must seek out a marine fungus. They may be found in the waters south and southwest of here. Find one and defeat it. Once you have, obtain proof that you have accomplished this test. Return to me here. So, you managed to survive, but anyone can run away. Show me the proof you defeated the marine fungus. Well done. I do not like to be so rough with young Vikings, but I must be. I do not want to see anyone die because I failed to do my job. But you have proven that you have the potential for great strength. I shall let your trainer know of your success.||Lo, I see a young Viking before me. What is your name? Speak up! You are here to prove that you have the strength in you to endure in this land. The trial is simple in nature, but unless you are strong, may prove difficult to execute. You must venture out and face [one of the creatures] that roam this land. You must seek out a marine fungus. They may be found in the waters south and southwest of here. Find one and defeat it. Once you have, obtain proof that you have accomplished this test. Return to me here. So, you managed to survive, but anyone can run away. Show me the proof you defeated the marine fungus. Well done. I do not like to be so rough with young Vikings, but I must be. I do not want to see anyone die because I failed to do my job. But you have proven that you have the potential for great strength. I shall let your trainer know of your success.
rows.StepText: Seek out Jorund Bruttstein in Aegirhamn and tell him your name.|Obtain proof that you have defeated a marine fungus in the waters south of Aegirhamn.|Give Jorund the marine fungus root.

rows.Name: Magnild's Cure
rows.Description: The girl Magnild is still very ill. Hopefully the healer [Kari] has had time to turn the snake venom onto a usable remedy.
rows.SourceText: Speak to Kari and see if she has finished Magnild's remedy.|
rows.TargetText: Hello again. You have come at exactly the [right time]. I have been working with the snake venom now for several days, it was not easy to [brew] down. However, I think I have finished the [remedy] for Magnild's bite. Take it and deliver it to the girl quickly. The longer we wait the worse her condition becomes I'm afraid.|Oh I have not been so [grateful] for a potion in all my days! I have not felt myslef in so long time. Oh I hope this [asists me]. I must say that I am feeling a tad better already. I do not know how I can thank you, but I shall never forget your aid to me.
rows.StepText: Speak to Kari and see if she has finished Magnild's remedy.|Give the potion to Magnild before her illness gets worse.

rows.Name: Newfound Group
rows.Description: Have you met [Kran] yet?
rows.SourceText: Seek out Kran, for he is a good source of information in these parts, and a wonderful teacher.|||
rows.TargetText: Good day my friend, can I help you? I see you have been sent here to [learn] my young friend. Knowledge is the key that will unlock many doors for you. Understanding and knowing your surroundings is your ally and [teamwork] your backbone. These are difficult times for our people and therefore you must understand that [camaraderie] between your fellows is very important. Reach out to others. Form a grouping with one or more fellows and return to me once you have accomplished this. Welcome back, I see you have accomplished the [task] of forming a group. Take your new found group into the countryside and look for the hobgoblin fish catchers and return to me with a token of the task set before you. You and your partner have done well and hopefully learned an important lesson. You must always remember that it is a party of like minds and goals that will accomplish much. Teamwork is our peoples best guarantee to a victory!|||Good day my friend, can I help you? I see you have been sent here to [learn] my young friend. Knowledge is the key that will unlock many doors for you. Understanding and knowing your surroundings is your ally and [teamwork] your backbone. These are difficult times for our people and therefore you must understand that [camaraderie] between your fellows is very important. Reach out to others. Form a grouping with one or more fellows and return to me once you have accomplished this. Welcome back, I see you have accomplished the [task] of forming a group. Take your new found group into the countryside and look for the hobgoblin fish catchers and return to me with a token of the task set before you. You and your partner have done well and hopefully learned an important lesson. You must always remember that it is a party of like minds and goals that will accomplish much. Teamwork is our peoples best guarantee to a victory!
rows.StepText: Seek out Kran in Haggerfel.|Form a group with another member of Midgard and return to Kran.|Take your group into the countryside and bring back a token from a hobgoblin fish-catcher.|Return to Kran with your battle party and token.

rows.Name: Wealthy Prospects
rows.Description: <Player>, good to see you. Are you looking for something to pass your time with? Perhaps you would be [interested] in aiding a friend of mine, then?
rows.SourceText: Great! Go speak to Bernt. He'll set you up.||
rows.TargetText: Mystic, here to do some [exploring]? Aye, I could use your aid, if you don't mind a bit of danger. You see, there's some minerals embedded in some rocks not too far from here. Now it's not a whole mine or anything, but I want to know what sort of mineral it is. There's one [problem]. Aye, there's some creatures about that make it hard to get to. Now, I'd go and fight off the creatures myself, but you know, I've got some work to do here, and really can't be bothered. That's why I'm [willing to pay] you. Ha! Of course I'm going to pay! I've been here long enough to know nobody's here for the pleasure of being here! Everyone wants something! Land! Treasure! Fame! Whatever it is. Well, are you [satisfied] I'll pay you? There are some stray scimitar cubs near the mineral deposit. Remove the cubs to find the deposit. Many cuvs are found bsouthwest, just past the bridge. Ah, then did you find the thing I was looking for? Any of those rocks with those mineral bits on 'em? Great! I'm sure we can sort out what this is, and where we might find some more, if it proves to be any use! I've got a whole bunch of dwarven clans just eeking for a reason to come out here! If I can sell them on this area, I'll get a nice fee! Ah, but I promised you a fee as well, didn't I? Well then, I'll keep my word friend. Here you are! Good working with your Mystic.||Mystic, here to do some [exploring]? Aye, I could use your aid, if you don't mind a bit of danger.
