If I can sell them on this area, I'll get a nice fee! Ah, but I promised you a fee as well, didn't I? Well then, I'll keep my word friend. Here you are! Good working with your Mystic.
rows.StepText: Talk to Bernt.|Remove the stray scimitar cubs southwest past the bridge to find the mineral deposit.|Bring the mineralized rock to Bernt.

rows.Name: Aegan's Letter to Helen
rows.Description: Deliver this letter to my daughter Helen in [Haggerfel].
rows.SourceText: Deliver Aegan's letter to his daughter Helen in Haggerfel.
rows.StepText: Deliver Aegan's letter to his daughter Helen in Haggerfel.

rows.Name: Bolli's Leather Supplies
rows.Description: Greetings to you. I'm sure I've seen you before, but my memory isn't as great as it used to be, so you'll have to forgive me. Hehe [Mularn] sure is a nice place isn't it?
rows.SourceText: Oh wonder of wonders! I shall indeed make it worth your time and effort. Now, the first item I am missing is my [skinning knife].|||
rows.TargetText: |My knife! Oh thank you! Now, I am in need of just one more thing, if you are [willing to get it].||
rows.StepText: Search the hills west of Mularn for a huldu lurker with Bolli's skinning knife.|Return Bolli's skinning knife to him in Mularn.|Get the shinbone of a rattling skeleton for smoothing skins.|Bring the shinbone to Bolli.
rows.FinishText: Ah! This will do nicely! I just hope its former owner doesn't come looking for it. hehe Anyhow, I thank you for your help in this matter, and maybe, in the future, I can show you some of my wares. Good luck in your travels!

rows.Name: Mother Dearest
rows.Description: Have you met [Nibalk] yet>
rows.SourceText: Ah a brave Mystic you are! Great! Go speak to Nibalk. He will tell you more.||||
rows.TargetText: Oh. I have been greatly disturbed by the problems of the Valkyn. Now mind you, none of the recent explorers or adventures have suffered like the older Valkyn, but still. It has been rough. I have had to [meditate] for days. Aye. It is not my nature to do so, but it had to be done. I finally had to beg for help from the [gods]. Well, I certainly can't defeat a deity. Gazsi himself can't, though he is just as afflicted as the rest! He can't do the simplest tasks. The nightmares of the Mother has inflicted upon them all has made them [weak]. Yes. Weak. But I have appealed to the gods, and as you are here, I can only think I have been answered. They have promised me their aid in defeating the Mother. But they have asked a small [price]. They fell it is weakness that has allowed the Mother to enter the minds of the followers of the Norse gods, so we must prove our strength. If we prove our strength, than they will lend us theirs. So, I've a [challenge] for you. This is not about brains, but strength. I need you defeat three naive sjoras. Bring me their ears, as proof. This will prove some strength, I think, to the gods that have answered me. Remember, return with three ears! Well then, did you get the ears? Ah good deal then. Hand them in. One at a time. Ah good. Two more then. Well, one more, friend. Great! The gods should be pleased! Now, if you'll excuse me, I must place these in an area blessed by the gods. Tonight, well, tonight all should get a good night's rest! Ah, but here, let me give you some coin for your troubles.||||Oh. I have been greatly disturbed by the problems of the Valkyn. Now mind you, none of the recent explorers or adventures have suffered like the older Valkyn, but still. It has been rough. I have had to [meditate] for days. Aye. It is not my nature to do so, but it had to be done. I finally had to beg for help from the [gods]. Well, I certainly can't defeat a deity. Gazsi himself can't, though he is just as afflicted as the rest! He can't do the simplest tasks. The nightmares of the Mother has inflicted upon them all has made them [weak]. Yes. Weak. But I have appealed to the gods, and as you are here, I can only think I have been answered. They have promised me their aid in defeating the Mother. But they have asked a small [price]. They fell it is weakness that has allowed the Mother to enter the minds of the followers of the Norse gods, so we must prove our strength. If we prove our strength, than they will lend us theirs. So, I've a [challenge] for you. This is not about brains, but strength. I need you defeat three naive sjoras. Bring me their ears, as proof. This will prove some strength, I think, to the gods that have answered me. Remember, return with three ears! Well then, did you get the ears? Ah good deal then. Hand them in. One at a time. Ah good. Two more then. Well, one more, friend. Great! The gods should be pleased! Now, if you'll excuse me, I must place these in an area blessed by the gods. Tonight, well, tonight all should get a good night's rest! Ah, but here, let me give you some coin for your troubles.
rows.StepText: Talk to Nibalk.|Kill three naive sjoras south across the bridge and bring their ears. (1/3)|Kill three naive sjoras south across the bridge and bring their ears. (2/3)|Kill three naive sjoras south across the bridge and bring their ears. (3/3)|Return all three sjora ears to Nibalk, one at a time.

rows.Name: Trial of Bravery
rows.Description: Well, you have done well. You passed the trial of strength without difficulty, and Idena spoke of your intelligence in dealing with those riddles. I myself have solved them, so I know what they are like. I'm glad you did well, for now it is time to face the [third and final trial].
rows.SourceText: Then you must go speak to Rania. She is one of the Valkyn that has been involved in training many young Vikings since she came to Aegirhamn. She is expecting you.||||
rows.StepText: Go to Rania in Aegirhamn.|Defeat a naive sjora and get the shell necklace it carries, along the coast south of the bridge.|Defeat a naive sjora to learn the words Rania wants.|Give Rania the sjora shell necklace.|Say the words [til sjoen] to Rania. (whisper: til sjoen)

rows.Name: Knowledge of the Gods
rows.Description: Inquire of each of your future [guildmasters] about the gods; at level 5 you will choose which god to follow.
rows.SourceText: Ask a future guildmaster about the gods.||
rows.StepText: Ask a future guildmaster about the gods.|Ask another future guildmaster about the gods.|Return to your trainer.

rows.Name: Knowledge of the Gods
rows.Description: Inquire of each of your future [guildmasters] about the gods; at level 5 you will choose which god to follow.
rows.SourceText: Ask a future guildmaster about the gods.||
rows.StepText: Ask a future guildmaster about the gods.|Ask another future guildmaster about the gods.|Return to your trainer.

rows.Name: Knowledge of the Gods
rows.Description: Inquire of each of your future [guildmasters] about the gods; at level 5 you will choose which god to follow.
rows.SourceText: Ask a future guildmaster about the gods.||
rows.StepText: Ask a future guildmaster about the gods.|Ask another future guildmaster about the gods.|Return to your trainer.

rows.Name: Rogue Trainer
rows.Description: As a Rogue there are [two houses] from which you can choose on your path, the gods to choose from are Loki and Skadi.
rows.SourceText: The gods to [choose] from are Loki and Skadi and the Great House of the Jotun.|
rows.TargetText: Greetings, I see Jucla has sent you to me to learn of [Loki]. You can join the House of Loki. He is the giant of fire and the great trickster. If you choose to follow Loki you will become a shadowblade. You will follow his example and become a member of the [Great House of Jotun]. The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. If ever you wre to go to Jotunheim, you would find [Skadi] dwelling there. To learn more about Skadi seek out Budo here in Fort Atla.|Greetings, I see Jucla has sent you to me to learn of [Skadi]. Skadi is the giantess of the hunt. She was greatly beloved by both Aesir and Jotun. She is of the [Great House of the Jotun]. The Great House of Jotun is made up of the gods living in Jotunheim, home of the Giants. Once you have grown stronger, and a bit wiser, return to your trainer. You must then choose which of the gods to follow.
rows.StepText: Find Boidoc in Fort Atla and learn of Loki and the Great House of the Jotun.|Find Budo in Fort Atla and learn of Skadi.
rows.FinishText: If you wish to learn of Loki seek out Boidoc here in Fort Atla.

rows.Name: Tric's Lost List
rows.Description: You look the friendly sort. Perhaps you [can help] me?
rows.SourceText: Keep your eyes west of the road to ensure reinforcements do not flank you.|
rows.StepText: Locate and slay Gib and his followers on the hill by the left fork of the main road, past the thrall keeper.|Return the book to Tric in Vasudheim.
rows.FinishText: You are truly well trained! Fare-thee-well in your future travels.

rows.Name: Venture to Gotar
rows.Description: Go to Fort Atla in Gotar and speak with [Hyndia].
rows.SourceText: Speak with Hyndia, the Seer trainer, in the first building on the left in Fort Atla.
rows.StepText: Speak with Hyndia, the Seer trainer, in the first building on the left in Fort Atla.

rows.Name: Tomte Jerkin
rows.Description: Do you have [a moment]?
rows.SourceText: Get three tomte bracers from the tomte thugs in the camp in East Svealand. (1/3)|||
rows.StepText: Get three tomte bracers from the tomte thugs in the camp in East Svealand. (1/3)|Get three tomte bracers from the tomte thugs in the camp in East Svealand. (2/3)|Get three tomte bracers from the tomte thugs in the camp in East Svealand. (3/3)|Return the bracers to Gwaell in Audliten.

rows.Name: Hole of the Dead
rows.Description: Your assistance [is needed]!
rows.SourceText: Aye, the evil lay not far from the main road. Look in the mountains to the west soon after day turns to night. Wield your house gift now and go seek the skeletons, or [tell me] if you need a new one.|
rows.StepText: Slay a dwarf bone skeleton while wielding your House gift, in the depression west of the crossroads to Mularn and Audliten after nightfall.|Bring the dust to Frimeth in Vasudheim.
rows.FinishText: You have done well. Here is the reward I have promised you! Fare-thee-well in the rest of your travels.

rows.Name: Simple Misgivings
rows.Description: My [ex-apprentice] Quirk, a huldu, stole my plans for a new forge and headed back to the huldu camp.
rows.SourceText: You see, Quirk was a huldu. He is smarter than most of those silly creatures outside the village, but still a huldu. He helped me in [quite a few tasks], but others didn't like him around because he like to cause a little trouble.|
rows.StepText: Find Quirk in the huldu camp west of Mularn (right at the fork) and get the forge plans back.|Bring the forge plans back to Hilde in Haggerfel.
rows.FinishText: Wonderful! Now I can begin work on my newly designed forge. You have done a great job my friend.

rows.Name: Svartmoln's Appetite
rows.Description: You help [Kyba and village]?
rows.SourceText: You waste much time. Svartmoln eat many crabs, many more fishermen. Leave. No come back until have Svartmoln's hide.|
rows.StepText: Kill Svartmoln, the bear that roams near the bridge.|Bring the hide back to Kyba in Vasudheim, next to the healer.
rows.FinishText: You kill Svartmoln. Village honor you. Kyba honor you. Here, take this gift that Kristen, the Norse woman, fashion for you.

rows.Name: Troubled Wild
rows.Description: The wildling scouts lurk at the edges of [civilization]. Bring me three wildling ears as proof of your deeds.
rows.SourceText: Kill three wildling scouts on the road west out of Vasudheim for their ears. (1/3)|||
rows.StepText: Kill three wildling scouts on the road west out of Vasudheim for their ears. (1/3)|Kill three wildling scouts on the road west out of Vasudheim for their ears. (2/3)|Kill three wildling scouts on the road west out of Vasudheim for their ears. (3/3)|Return to Erekith in Vasudheim.

rows.Name: Brutal Chains
rows.Description: The thralls [revolted] and escaped on our way to Mularn. I would not ask you to return them alive, but bring me their chains.
rows.TargetName: escaped thrall;100|escaped thrall;100|escaped thrall;100|Thrall keeper;100|Thrall keeper;100
rows.SourceText: Kill three escaped thralls for their chains. (1/3)||||Choose your reward: [Old Svarskodd Legs], [Old Cloth Pants], [Old Starklaedar Leggings].
rows.StepText: Kill three escaped thralls for their chains. (1/3)|Kill three escaped thralls for their chains. (2/3)|Kill three escaped thralls for their chains. (3/3)|Return the chains to the Thrall Keeper.|Choose your reward: whisper Thrall keeper the name of the item you want (Old Svarskodd Legs, Old Cloth Pants, Old Starklaedar Leggings).

rows.Name: Defeat the Hobgoblin Anklebiter
rows.Description: I leave hobgoblins. Me no like [hobgoblins]! Carr stay here in Mularn now!
rows.SourceText: Smyga and Anklebiter [terrible mean] hobgoblin, always on raids. I don't like what they do anymore so I stay here.|
rows.StepText: Kill hobgoblins in the camp between Mularn and Haggerfel until Anklebiter appears, and take Smyga's orders.|Take the orders back to Carr.
rows.FinishText: Yes! Kill Anklebiter and bring the orders to me.

rows.Name: Mucking Through the Ick
rows.Description: Ah, you have never heard of us? We are rather small, I admit, but our work is very serious, I assure you! In fact, I am in the process of studying a specific spider as we speak! Have you ever heard of the [Ickerius] spider?
rows.TargetName: Garon;100|Yver Tiu;100|plague rat;100|plague rat;100|plague rat;100|plague rat;100|Yver Tiu;100|Ick;100|Yver Tiu;100
rows.SourceText: Ah so kind of you. I was bitten the other day by a female juvenile red-back, and while I was able to treat myself with an antivenom I made, I'm not still feeling all that well. Could you run to Audliten and retrieve the silk for me from [Garon]?||||||||
rows.TargetText: Greetings friend! Welcome to Audliten, though you seem to be a more seasoned traveler, I'm sure no introduction is needed for our fair town. What brings you to Audliten today? Ah, from Yver! Excellent. I see he's been bitten by a female red-back. Terrible lot that. It's good that's he's been able to treat the wound though, they can be deadly. One moment please. Here you are friend. I've managed to pull the strands apart for easier inspection of the individual strands. I'm sure Yver will appreciate that. Make sure to keep it flat, or they will bunch. Here is some of my research. Please give it to Yver.|Welcome back friend! I'm glad to see you in one piece. I hope you don't mind, but I have one more task for you to do for me. I hope you're [up for it]!|||||Ah ha! You're back! Excellent! Do you have the specimen for me? You hand Yver Tiu the Ickerius spider body. Yver does a cursory exam of the ickerius body before putting it in a large bag he has at his side.||
rows.StepText: Travel to Audliten and give Garon the note.|Give the silk and the scroll to Yver in Haggerfel.|Slay the plague rats that prey on the baby spiders on the wooded isle near Audliten. (1/4)|Slay the plague rats that prey on the baby spiders on the wooded isle near Audliten. (2/4)|Slay the plague rats that prey on the baby spiders on the wooded isle near Audliten. (3/4)|Slay the plague rats that prey on the baby spiders on the wooded isle near Audliten. (4/4)|Return to Yver and tell him you have [completed the task]. (whisper: completed the task)|Travel to Gotar and seek out the ickerius spider the locals call Ick.|Return to Yver Tiu.
rows.FinishText: Here you are friend. I had my compatriot, <Player>, look over the silk. He said it had properties that would benefit someone like you. I hope you can use it for some time to come. Again, I think you for all your hard work!

rows.Name: Sveawolf Guardian
rows.Description: Do not be afraid; I speak [directly] into your mind. One of my kind has been wounded. Take up my scent and take these herbs.
rows.SourceText: Find the wounded sveawolf behind a tree across the road from the Svartalf camp; let her smell your scent, then give her the herbs.|
rows.StepText: Find the wounded sveawolf behind a tree across the road from the Svartalf camp; let her smell your scent, then give her the herbs.|Return to the Elder Sveawolf on the hill southeast of Huginfell.

rows.Name: Bluebell's Disappearance
rows.Description: A good hardy welcome to you. I am Eske, one of the local guards here in Audilten. It's good to see some sturdy fold come through here. Hehe. I don't suppose you've come here for a little [adventure], have you?
rows.TargetName: smiera-gatto;100|Dwarven Guard Eske;100|Trapper Jora;100|Dwarven Guard Eske;100
rows.SourceText: Well! Just my luck, and yours too, then. I am missing something very important to me. Perhaps you can [find her].|||
rows.TargetText: |Oh, my beautiful Bluebell. How I will miss her! At least now I know what has happened to her. Thank you. Can you do me one last [favor]?|Greetings, what can I do for you? I see. This is terribly sad news. I know Eske was very attached to the bird. Ah, such is the way of nature. Here, take this box back to him so he may give Bluebell the burial she deserves.|
rows.StepText: Slay the smiera-gatto near the trees east of Audliten and see if it killed Bluebell.|Return Bluebell's remains to Guard Eske in Audliten.|Take Eske's note to Trapper Jora in Audliten.|Give the ornamental box to Eske.
rows.FinishText: My thanks to you, for helping me with this. I am glad to know what has happened to my Bluebell. I will bury her behind Audliten this eve. Please take this coin as a token of my gratitude to you. Good luck in your future journeys.

rows.Name: A Deed of Old
rows.Description: A great beast, the wolf Morra, [prowls] the coast. Kill it and bring me proof.
rows.SourceText: Kill the wolf Morra up the coast near the shipwreck past the tomte camp; he runs with sveawolf mothers.||Choose your reward: [Studded Hide of Morra], [Skullbone Brooch of Morra], [Paw of Morra], [Tail of Morra], [Boneclaw Ring of Morra].
rows.StepText: Kill the wolf Morra up the coast near the shipwreck past the tomte camp; he runs with sveawolf mothers.|Bring the hide to Aleaniver in front of the building southwest of the Audliten bridge.|Choose your reward: whisper Aleaniver the name of the item you want (Studded Hide of Morra, Skullbone Brooch of Morra, Paw of Morra, Tail of Morra, Boneclaw Ring of Morra).

rows.Name: Copious Striders
rows.Description: Hail to thee. I seem to be in a [bit of a snitch].
rows.SourceText: If you could bring back to me on of these legs I would be forever in your debt!|
rows.StepText: Seek out and slay a water strider on the west edge of Striders' Isle.|Return the strider leg to Alomali under the tree by the water in Vasudheim.
rows.FinishText: Ah! Thank you so much! I hope this small amount of coin is enough to compensate you. I may have other tasks in which you could help. Return to me later when you have gained more experience and I will tell you of them.

rows.Name: Letter to Sveck
rows.Description: Will you bring my letter to the old warrior Sveck in the fort across from [Audliten]?
rows.SourceText: Deliver the letter to Sveck in the fort across from Audliten.
rows.StepText: Deliver the letter to Sveck in the fort across from Audliten.

rows.Name: Minx Wiley
rows.Description: Hey! I got [a problem].
rows.SourceText: Thanks for your help! That little guy was getting on my nerves!|
rows.StepText: Find and kill Wiley around Huginfell.|Return to Hurg for your reward.

rows.Name: Monstrous Beast
rows.Description: The blasted cart has broken, I knew something would go wrong on my [way to Fort Veldon].
rows.SourceText: Fetch it for me and I shall reward ye handsomely. [Step #2]Find Hrrgyf and the book, The Yellow Canary.||
rows.TargetText: |I must tell ya I'm glad I lefy me money purse behind in Dvalin. Go see [my man Brok] there.|Well well, what is this?
rows.StepText: Find the hill cat Hrrgyf, who wanders near Darkness Falls, the Vendo caverns and Svadsad Faste, and recover the book.|Return the book to Vik by his broken cart near Mularn.|Seek out Brok in Dvalin and deliver Vik's letter.
rows.FinishText: Take this note with ya so ya don't have to explain wha' happened here.

rows.Name: Smyga's Raid
rows.Description: Carr stay here in [Mularn] now!
rows.SourceText: Carr has read Smyga's orders. Very bad news friend, very, very bad.|
rows.StepText: Kill Smyga in the hobgoblin camp where you found Anklebiter.|Return to Carr.
rows.FinishText: Hurry! Hurry and find Smyga, so he can't take Jordheim. If he is defeated, hobgoblins have no leader and will not attack. Is only way to save city.

rows.Name: Solving the Argument
rows.Description: I give up! These two are [driving me crazy]!
rows.SourceText: I hope for both my sanity and their health that you have found Alisa's and Olvaerr's missing items, <Player>. Do I see [a cloak] in your pack there?||||||
rows.TargetText: Come in, come in, <Player>. If I'm not mistaken, Skorri sent you to me. I could hear Ailsa and Olvaerr all the way over here. They have been fighting for days and poor Skorri has been close to tears, which is saying something, him being a troll. They have surely tested his patience. I am just glad that I saw both objects before those two addle-brains [lost them]. Yes, they lost them. A few days ago Ailsa went out with the totem tied to her belt and didn't come back with it. I'm sure she lost it when she was out studying the Morvaltar for <Player>. As for Olvaerr, Ailsa might be right in hat he lost it in a drinking game [with the dwarves]. He took a horse to Aegirhamn on the same say that Ailsa went out and he returned the next morning, reeking for ale and groaning about his head. I didn't see the cloak anywhere. It was the same day they both started accusing the other of stealing. I'm just glad I saw both items before they lost them Poor Skorri only has a certain amount of time [to meet Stonelock] up in Gripklosa mountains and if he can't get those two groups moving, Stonelock will be furious. Stonelock is going to be leading an expedition into the wilds of Gripklosa to track down the truth of yet another rumor about the Troll Fathers. I told Skorri to just go himself and leave both groups here and let <Player> and Longbeard get in trouble for not being able to control their people, but Skorri said Stonelock wouldn't look at it that was. I'd hate for Skorri to [get in trouble] since he's been so kind to check on me while I've been sick. Well, if we want to keep Skorri out of trouble, we better get you going! Olvaerr's cloak is rather easy to reproduce. From what he was telling anyone who would listen, he killed a mammoth bull himself and sewed it with he sinew from a morvalt bagskytt. But I saw the cloak and know the pelt actually came from a mammoth calf. And I heard Alisa say she saw Olvaerr killing a morvalt ungdom shortly before he started wearing the cloak. I think you can handle getting the pelt and the sinew. Now for [Ailsa's totem]. This will be a bit more difficult. She took the eye of a biting insect and imbued it with the essence of a pyslings. I believe I can reproduce the process she used if you bring me those two things. I know it is a lot to get, but I know that Skorri will reward you well for saving him from those two. Do you [need directions] to the creatures or do you [know the way]? Which do you need directions to? the [mammoth] calves, the [morvalt] ungdom, the [pyslings], the biting [insects], or [all of them]? The mammoth calves do have a tendency to roam, but you can almost always find some just west of here, in the open area by the rocks. Take care, for the calves usually travel in pairs. Watch out for the young mammoths, they are more than you can handle at this point! For the morvalt ungdom, follow the road southwest as if you are going to Aegirhamn and cross the large stone bridge. Not far over the bridge you will find morvalt ungdom on both sides of the road. The pyslings and found in many places, but I like one particular spot. From the guard tower near the large stone bridge, head due south. You'll cross over the road and enter a small valley between the hills. You should find some in there. Some are only there at night, but others are there all the time. As for the biting insects, head south from the guard tower near the large stone bridge. Cross over the road and into a small valley between the hills. Once in the valley, follow it west until you reach the beach. The biting insects live along the coastline. Oh, <Player>, you should be thankful you were not here recently! Ails and Olvaerr got into another yelling match and Skorri was ready to drag them back to Muspelheim and drop them into the lava! I managed to get over there and calm them down. Poor Skorri! He's looking so tired from all this. Let us get these things made quickly, shall we? I need the pelt from the mammoth calf first. Now give me the morvalt sinew an I shall quickly sew a cloak. There, that is done and it looks exactly the same as the one he had before. Good job <Player>! Now give me the essence from the pyslings. Please give me the eye from the biting insect. That is done too. I was a little unsure of this one, but from what I overheard Ailsa saying, this is the same process she used. We'll see if it's acceptable to her or not. Here, take the cloak and the totem and go speak with Skorri. Hopefully he hasn't hurt Ailsa and Olvaerr yet!|||||Come in, come in, <Player>. I believe I can reproduce the process she used if you bring me those two things. I know it is a lot to get, but I know that Skorri will reward you well for saving him from those two. The mammoth calves do have a tendency to roam, but you can almost always find some just west of here, in the open area by the rocks. Take care, for the calves usually travel in pairs. Now give me the morvalt sinew an I shall quickly sew a cloak. There, that is done and it looks exactly the same as the one he had before. Good job <Player>! Now give me the essence from the pyslings. Please give me the eye from the biting insect. That is done too. I was a little unsure of this one, but from what I overheard Ailsa saying, this is the same process she used. We'll see if it's acceptable to her or not. Here, take the cloak and the totem and go speak with Skorri. Hopefully he hasn't hurt Ailsa and Olvaerr yet!|
rows.StepText: Speak with Kaisa in the small hut near Tjasse Vindrson in Dyrfjell.|Get a pelt from a mammoth calf.|Get a morvalt sinew from a morvalt ungdom.|Get some essence from a pysling.|Get an eye from a biting insect.|Return to Kaisa in Dyrfjell.|Go and see Skorri again.
rows.FinishText: According to Stonelock, this was made by the finest Troll craftspeople around. I hope you will use it as you explore this land. Perhaps one day we shall speak again and you can join in an expedition I am leading! May the house of Skadi watch over you, <Player>!

rows.Name: Spat the Wild Cat
rows.Description: Spat! [Spat], that crazy mean old cat. You know he's given me troubles before comin' this way.
rows.SourceText: If you bring me Vasa's tail from Spat it would make this whole shoddy trip worth it and I can make it worth your while too ya see.|
rows.StepText: Spat is a rare spawn among the cats in the Vale of Mularn hills.|Bring Vasa's tail to Vik.
rows.FinishText: At least my trip into Mularn is now worth it. I've been tryin' to get that cat for ages.

rows.Name: Tomte Problems
rows.Description: Tomtes, tomtes, tomtes! I'll be so glad if I never see another [tomte] in my life!
rows.SourceText: You seemed to have fared better with the tomtes than I have. Were you able to get the key from hem? My wife came by while you were gone and wanted to get something out of the chest, but I was able to distract her. Please, give me the key now.|||
rows.TargetText: Thank you. Now, this key will do me no good unless you were able to locate the chest of jewels in my house. Please give me the chest now.|||
rows.StepText: Hear Thorgil's story.|Get the key from the tomte scavengers outside Thorgil's house, east over the bridge and to the south.|Search Thorgil's house for the hidden chest of jewels.|Return the chest to Thorgil in Audliten.
rows.FinishText: This is a nice ring I have for you. I received it from a shadowblade that grew too old to use it anymore. She traded for a crop of turnips! Anyway, use it well, and come back and see me soon!

rows.Name: Klippa's Claw
rows.Description: Hail! I have [news] for you.
rows.SourceText: There is a smith to the west that I know well. I have asked him if he could make a special item for you. He says he is [willing].||
rows.StepText: Speak to Lilib in the fort before Dvalin. Tell him Alomali sent you. (whisper: Alomali sent me)|Locate Klippa just east of the ant camp (kill the two crabs there until she appears) and bring Lilib the claw while fresh.|Return Klippa's claw to Lilib.
rows.FinishText: Aye, he goes by the name of Lilib. Seek him out and tell him I sent you.

rows.Name: Hunting Party
rows.Description: Yes? Are you [looking for something]?
rows.SourceText: Well let's see here. I think I may have something that you can do for me. Let me check my [scrolls].|
rows.StepText: Hunt the dangerous creature Bork names (a savage lynx west of the healer hut, a ribbon toad, a grass viper or a grass cat) and slay it.|Return to Bork.
rows.FinishText: Great job! Here are a few coins as a reward. Return a bit later and I may have more work for you. I have to update my scrolls now.

rows.Name: Ibicus
rows.Description: You are looking well. Have you been out [exploring]?
rows.SourceText: It's known as <Player>. When you kill it, bring me it's carcass, and you will be well rewarded.|
rows.StepText: Kill Ibicus near the stone bridge north of Aegirhamn, behind the boobrie hatchlings.|Return the carcass of Ibicus to Karle Alfevson, Ota Yrling or Longbeard - or give it to a Musslaklan trader and take the tokens to Gazsi.
rows.FinishText: Ah! I must tell you, Longbeard and Ota have been crawling all over each other and everyone else in the town to get this beast! They both want to claim it as their prize! Ha! Well, not that I want to get involved in the in-fighting on the dwarven kobold expedition, but really, somebody had to end this <Player> obsession once and for all. I figured it'd be a better thing for me to have <Player>. That way, Longbeard and Ota can't spend precious time trying to outdo each other. Oh! But imagine the looks they will have when they see <Player>! Just a small benefit from all this! Here, I promised you a reward, though. Thanks. You've be a great help!

rows.Name: Tomte Plot
rows.Description: So, I walked over to Hulda the shield merchant and spoke with her. She didn't know much either, but she told me about her cousins. Ever since their sister was attacked as a child by the tomtes, they have watched them and learned everything about them. Hulda told me that they would help me learn more about why the tomtes had turned on me. But I [ran into a problem].
rows.SourceText: So, Smack is behind all this mess, is he? I hope you were able to take care of him. If he's gone, perhaps I can move back to my farm and go back to the life I enjoyed. Please, give me proof that you were able to rid this world of Smack.|||||
rows.TargetText: Hail and well met! You look like a (your class here) with a purpose for coming here. I don't think you seek a shield, but perhaps [information]? I thought so! I figured Thorgil would have to send someone in his place, since I've heard others say that Inga has begun teaching him the art of making and selling arrows. I was very sorry to hear that Thorgil has lost his farm to the tomtes. I was so busy selling shields that I hadn't had a chance to get over and speak with him about what happened. I was glad when he came in here the other day [to ask me] about the tomtes. I don't know much, but as Thorgil probably told you, my cousins do. When Thorgil came to me, I couldn't say no to his plea for help. I went and visited each of my brothers and told them of Thorgil's situation. They were both very intrigued by the whole thing, for they have been watching the tomtes around here for many years. Both said they recently observed some changes in [the tomtes' behaviour]. They both spent a few days watching the tomtes and then trying to make sense of what they saw. I recently received word from both of them, telling me who Thorgil should speak to. But since you are helping Thorgil, I shall tell you [which of my cousins] to speak to. Both sent me word that they think Edvard would be the best one to help Thorgil. He has noticed some happenings around the tomte camps he watches that his brother Emmerick hasn't noticed. Most people don't know where Edvard likes to hide so I shall tell you. Go across the stone bridge northeast of here to the guard tower. You will find him on the top most level. Take care in climbong the ladders, they can be tricky! Remember to tell him Thorgil sent you!|Yes? Is there something I can do for you? I am rather busy, and I am also waiting for someone. Oh he did? Well then, you are the one I am waiting for. My cousin Hulda said that Thorgil was having problems with the tomtes. I wasn't surprised to hear it, because I have been watching them and I have noticed a change in their behavior lately. Most of the time they just pester people traveling along the road or thos that stray too close to the camps. But as I watched, I noticed that the tomtes were organizing [specific attacks]. I believe that the tomtes are trying to find a way to push the people of Audliten and its surrounding area off the lands that once belonged to the tomtes. As more people have moved into the area, the tomtes have been pushed to smaller and smaller areas. There are only a few camps left around here, and because of that ,the residents around here have grown to think the tomtes have moved on or disappeard from this world. But that is [far from the truth]! The tomtes needed a place that wouldn't be taken over by the residents of the area. They searched and found a cave not far from where my brother watches them. They are crafty little men, and began to carve out a home for themselves under the earth. They worked quickly, and soon their new home was ready. Led by the strongest of the tomtes, <Player>, most of them left their lands and headed deep underground. Now, some people believe that the tomtes in the camps around here don't like dank surroundings of the cave, but that isn ot true. There is [another reason] they live above ground. All this time the tomtes have been planning ways to remove the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas and reclaim them for their own. The tomtes that live in the camps above ground are the eyes and ears for <Player> and report back everything they see. Recently I've noticed more messengers heading down from the north, yet my brother has not noticed and unusual activity around the entrance to the tomte caves. That has led us both to believe [someone else] is behind this plot to drive Thorgil and the others from this area off their land. I've noticed many messengers heading in and out of the camp of Edigo. It's my guess that something is going on and he knows about it. I've watched Edigo for some time now and I know he is plotting something. Most likely he's kept the messages that have been sent to him. You must get those messages so we can figure out what is going on and who is sending them. Edigo's camp is not far off from here. Head back through Audliten and take the road east out of town. Go over the stone bridge and keep going until you see the wooden tower. It's not far from Thorgil's old house. You will find Edigo there, but do not go alone! The other tomtes will anwer Edigo's call for help. Return to me when you have any messages. [Step #4] Slay Edigo and obtain any tomte messages. Go through Audliten and head east out of town. Cross the stone bridge and continue to the wooden tower near Thorgil's farm house. (Note: Another possible path for step 4: "Slay Ocug to obtain the tomte messages. To find him, swim across the river beside the guard tower, then head east up the coast to the tomte camp. Do not face Ocug alone! I am impressed. I watched over your battle with the tomtes from here and I liked what I saw. Thorgil did well in selecting you to help him. Now, let's see the messages you obtained. It's good you brought these to me. They happen to be written in the ancient language of the tomtes, and my brother and I are experts at reading and writing it. It seems that Edigo has been following orders to drive the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas away and reclaim the land. I'm not surprised to see that the orders were issued by Smack. He has always been [eager to succeed]. A long time ago, Smack displeased <Player> and was forced to leave the tomte caves and live among the races of Midgard. Since then, he has been working to get back into <Player>'s good graces. It seems that he thinks if he can clear the land of invaders, as he sees them, then <Player> will be pleased and restore him to the position he once held. It appears that SMack has recruited Edigo to help in his plot. But now that Edigo is dead, Smack will try to recruit another of the tomtes. You must [stop Smack]! Gather your forces and lead t hem to Smack's stronghold. You must stop him from contacting any of the other camp leaders. Smack's stronghold isn't hard to find. Take the road east out of Audliten again, and cross the stone bridge. Continue down the road until you see a small stone fort to the southeast. That is where you will find Smack. While you are off dealing with Smack, I shall send word to Thorgil of what you are doing. Return to him when you are finished with Smack.||Yes? Is there something I can do for you? I am rather busy, and I am also waiting for someone. Oh he did? Well then, you are the one I am waiting for. My cousin Hulda said that Thorgil was having problems with the tomtes. I wasn't surprised to hear it, because I have been watching them and I have noticed a change in their behavior lately. Most of the time they just pester people traveling along the road or thos that stray too close to the camps. But as I watched, I noticed that the tomtes were organizing [specific attacks]. I believe that the tomtes are trying to find a way to push the people of Audliten and its surrounding area off the lands that once belonged to the tomtes. As more people have moved into the area, the tomtes have been pushed to smaller and smaller areas. There are only a few camps left around here, and because of that ,the residents around here have grown to think the tomtes have moved on or disappeard from this world. But that is [far from the truth]! The tomtes needed a place that wouldn't be taken over by the residents of the area. They searched and found a cave not far from where my brother watches them. They are crafty little men, and began to carve out a home for themselves under the earth. They worked quickly, and soon their new home was ready. Led by the strongest of the tomtes, <Player>, most of them left their lands and headed deep underground. Now, some people believe that the tomtes in the camps around here don't like dank surroundings of the cave, but that isn ot true. There is [another reason] they live above ground. All this time the tomtes have been planning ways to remove the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas and reclaim them for their own. The tomtes that live in the camps above ground are the eyes and ears for <Player> and report back everything they see. Recently I've noticed more messengers heading down from the north, yet my brother has not noticed and unusual activity around the entrance to the tomte caves. That has led us both to believe [someone else] is behind this plot to drive Thorgil and the others from this area off their land. I've noticed many messengers heading in and out of the camp of Edigo. It's my guess that something is going on and he knows about it. I've watched Edigo for some time now and I know he is plotting something. Most likely he's kept the messages that have been sent to him. You must get those messages so we can figure out what is going on and who is sending them. Edigo's camp is not far off from here. Head back through Audliten and take the road east out of town. Go over the stone bridge and keep going until you see the wooden tower. It's not far from Thorgil's old house. You will find Edigo there, but do not go alone! The other tomtes will anwer Edigo's call for help. Return to me when you have any messages. [Step #4] Slay Edigo and obtain any tomte messages. Go through Audliten and head east out of town. Cross the stone bridge and continue to the wooden tower near Thorgil's farm house. (Note: Another possible path for step 4: "Slay Ocug to obtain the tomte messages. To find him, swim across the river beside the guard tower, then head east up the coast to the tomte camp. Do not face Ocug alone! I am impressed. I watched over your battle with the tomtes from here and I liked what I saw. Thorgil did well in selecting you to help him. Now, let's see the messages you obtained. It's good you brought these to me. They happen to be written in the ancient language of the tomtes, and my brother and I are experts at reading and writing it. It seems that Edigo has been following orders to drive the inhabitants of Audliten and the surrounding areas away and reclaim the land. I'm not surprised to see that the orders were issued by Smack. He has always been [eager to succeed]. A long time ago, Smack displeased <Player> and was forced to leave the tomte caves and live among the races of Midgard. Since then, he has been working to get back into <Player>'s good graces. It seems that he thinks if he can clear the land of invaders, as he sees them, then <Player> will be pleased and restore him to the position he once held. It appears that SMack has recruited Edigo to help in his plot. But now that Edigo is dead, Smack will try to recruit another of the tomtes. You must [stop Smack]! Gather your forces and lead t hem to Smack's stronghold. You must stop him from contacting any of the other camp leaders. Smack's stronghold isn't hard to find. Take the road east out of Audliten again, and cross the stone bridge. Continue down the road until you see a small stone fort to the southeast. That is where you will find Smack. While you are off dealing with Smack, I shall send word to Thorgil of what you are doing. Return to him when you are finished with Smack.||
rows.StepText: Speak with Hulda the shield merchant in Audliten.|Speak with Edvard Averrson at the top of the guard tower across the bridge northeast of Audliten. Tell him [Thorgil] sent you. (whisper: Thorgil)|Slay Edigo at the wooden tomte tower near Thorgil's farm and obtain the tomte messages.|Give Edvard the tomte messages.|Seek out the tomte Smack in his fort southeast of the road between Audliten and the rope bridge, near the drakelings.|Give Thorgil the leg bone of Smack.
rows.FinishText: A staff, eh? Then take this leg bone Eirik here in Audliten and he shall make it into a staff for you. Thank you, and keep an ear out for my call, I may have need of you again!

rows.Name: Covet Wiley
rows.Description: Hail adventurer! I have a task you may be [able to assist] with.
rows.SourceText: Ah! Good work to thee. I have an item here that would suit you well. It is of some value alone, yet I have been told it has unlimited potential.|
rows.StepText: Olag has been noticed around the camp at night. Find and slay him.|Return to Aesirdia in Dvalin for your reward.

rows.Name: Thorgil's Daughter
rows.Description: My daughter is gone! I know I've spoken of her before. Thorhalla is the sweetest little girl and her mother and I love her very much. She went outside to visit the merchants yesterday like she always does, but when it began to grow dark, she didn't come home. I thought that perhaps she was staying with Hulda or Josli, so I went to visit both of them. Neither of them had seen Thorhalla since the middle of the day. That's when I [started to worry]
rows.SourceText: Thank you. Here, take the note that was left. After talking with Hulda, she said that Emmerick would be best to help with this matter. He's in a guard tower down the road. Go east out of town and across both the stone bridge and the rope bridge. He's at the top of the tower, watching the tomtes. Be careful on those ladders! Hulda says they can be tricky. Please, get my daughter back!||||||
rows.TargetText: Hello there. My cousin Hulda said Thorgil was going to ask you for help again. I'm glad to see you agreed, for from what Hulda says, Thorgil and his daughter Thorhalla are both very nice people. Hulda sent word that Thorgil found a note written in the tomte language. Let me see it so I can read it. blah blah and they won't return her until Thorgil pays them for the loss of Smack or they may demand that the people of Audliten abandon the town in exchange for the girl. I don't want to think of the other possibility. you must find out what has become of Thorgil's daughter Thorhalla. To do that, you must be able to understand what the tomtes [are saying]. Some of them speak the common tongue we all speak, but most of them speak their own language. My cousin Edvard and I have enchanted different pieces of jewelry that allow the wearer to understand the language of the tomtes. Wear this at all times when you enter the [lair of Nisse]. Once you enter the lair, seek out the handler Nioll. Hopefully he will have some clue that will lead you to Thorhalla. So you have returned. I'm glad to see you made it out alive. I saw Thorhalla come running out of Nisse's Lair and head back toward Aedliten. Her father will be very pleased that you were able to save the young girl. Now, I wish I could allow you to keep the tomte tooth earring I gave you, but alas, I cannot. Please give it to me now. Thank you. Why, what's that you have? Is that a book you obtained in Nisse's Lair? Please, let me see it! I have been trying to obtain anything the tomtes have written. Hopefully it will be something I can use to aid in the fight against the tomtes. This is a treasure you have brought me! This is the Executioner's log and it contains a list of people he has executed and many orders from Misse himself, as well as future plans for the tomtes. Ny brother and I cannot thank you enough for bringing us this. Please, take this coin and use it to buy yourself something nice. I must go study this and you must go check on Thorhalla. Head back up to Audliten and speak with Thorgil.||||Hello there. My cousin Hulda said Thorgil was going to ask you for help again. rows.StepText: Give the tomte note to Emmerick Averrson in the Dvalin guard tower, across the stone and rope bridges.|In Nisse's Lair, wearing the earring, seek out the tomte handler Nioll in the first room on the right.|Seek out the tomte captor Rygnol at the south entrance to the Executioner's room.|Kill the Executioner to save Thorhalla.|Return the tomte tooth earring to Emmerick.|Give Emmerick the Executioner's log.|Return to Thorgil in Audliten and select your reward.
rows.FinishText: Here is your Tomte Skin Bracelet. I got this from old Dielf over there. He said he made it a long time ago from the skin of a tomte shaman. Try it on, I know it will look good on you! Thank you again. Let's hope I won't need your help again, but id I should ever call, I know you will answer!

rows.Name: Kyllikki's Scrolls
rows.Description: Can you feel it? Can you feel the magic that flows through this land from the great mother of Morvaltar? At time I think I can fell it, but it still eludes me. If only I could touch that power for just an instant, I know I could [harness it and use it]! Then my enemies, ah, the enemies of Midgard would cower in the fear before me, er, the armies of King Goran!
rows.SourceText: Kyllikki has the scrolls hidden in the house she lives in. It is up to you to figure out a way to get them. I've asked her for them before but she refused, but again, I think it is because she does not like me. You could try that if you wanted, or you could try [getting them out] of her house yourself.|
rows.TargetText: Hello there. Is there something I can do for you? You want my scrolls do you? Well, they are not for just anyone! They contain information about powerful magic that has been used by my people since the dawn of time. It is not for the weak or fearful! I'm guessing someone told you I had these scrolls and sent you to get them. What I wonder is who sent you. I have a guess, but I wonder, whom are you getting them for? Perhaps you should tell me before we go any farther. Why don't I believe you? Foolish being, return to Catla! She will have to continue her study of Morvaltar magic on her own. I will not help her anymore. Go back to her now and tell her I would not give you the scrolls. If she wishes to have them, she should have come herself!|
rows.StepText: Talk to Kyllikki in her house west of Catla over the bridge and tell her you seek the [scrolls of magic].|Take the scrolls to Catla in Aegirhamn.
rows.FinishText: You destroyed them? How? The only way to destroy them is to use them! By Hel and all the other gods of Midgard, I told you not to use them! Do you not listen? And now I bet you expect me to give you a reward? Hah! You?re lucky, because I have found a Valkyn who will tell me more about the mother. Here take this; I don?t want it. Do not let it be said that Catla doesn't fulfill her promises.

rows.Name: Looking Ahead
rows.Description: I know nothing of my [ancestry]. Go see my uncle in Mularn; take this ticket and a pint of stout.
rows.SourceText: Speak to Greyfell's uncle in Mularn.|||
rows.StepText: Speak to Greyfell's uncle in Mularn.|Kill the skogsfru Guthr at the fork in the river in West Svealand.|Search the cabinets in Audliten for the key.|Take the key and the chest to Greyfell in the Fort Atla tavern.

rows.Name: Evenings Empty Blessing
rows.Description: You have learned much since I spoke to you last.
rows.SourceText: Take the bear mask to Kell, the weapon merchant in Fort Veldon.||||||
rows.TargetText: I see you have spoken to Aegan. I'm glad you have come, we are having some [terrible upsets] here lately. Each evening, as dark appraoches, you can see a clan of what seems to be walking bears [coming from the hills] and laying waste to the area. They [scare and steal] any livestock our past dark as well as many of our goods. We can 't seem to get anyone to trade with us or to stay in the area for long. Perhaps [Sydney] can tell you more. Sydney can be found in guard tower up on the hill. You should hurry.|There have been many rumors throughout my lifetime [about bears] threatening our homelands. I never thought I would see it with my own eyes. They are clans of bear-men, known as the vendo. They [come from the hills] with little else in mind but terrorizing innocents. Be wary, and keep a good lookout. I have watched as night falls how the hills to the west come alive with motion. Please make haste and be careful. There are many different ones out there, but thou must seek [a specific one]. Seek out the Vendo Bone-Collectors in the surrounding hills. Bring back to me anything you may be able to obtain from them. Hmm, it appears there is writing upon these skins. However I cannot [translate what it says]. I only know of one person who could translate such runes. I, however, don?t know where to [find Virge]. Please find Virge and have him translate. He is the only one who can help solve this riddle now. You have returned! I feel you are just in time, the evening comes quickly. All it says is [Rathis]... Rathis must be important. Possible a leader. That should be our target.||There have been many rumors throughout my lifetime [about bears] threatening our homelands. I never thought I would see it with my own eyes. They are clans of bear-men, known as the vendo. They [come from the hills] with little else in mind but terrorizing innocents. Be wary, and keep a good lookout. Possible a leader. That should be our target.|Well hello stranger. What is this you give me? You have gotten this from a fabled vendo! I have nothing like this in my lifetime. Tis quite amazing I tell you. May I [keep this]? I shall try and translate these runes the best I can and send you back with it.|There have been many rumors throughout my lifetime [about bears] threatening our homelands. I never thought I would see it with my own eyes. They are clans of bear-men, known as the vendo. They [come from the hills] with little else in mind but terrorizing innocents. I only know of one person who could translate such runes. I, however, don?t know where to [find Virge]. Please find Virge and have him translate. He is the only one who can help solve this riddle now. You have returned! I feel you are just in time, the evening comes quickly. All it says is [Rathis]... Rathis must be important. Possible a leader. That should be our target.|
rows.StepText: Take the bear mask to Kell, the weapon merchant in Fort Veldon.|Speak to Sydney in the guard tower near the fort.|Search for the Vendo bone-collectors in the surrounding hills and bring back what you can.|Return the ragged bear skin to Sydney.|Find Virge in Huginfell and have him translate the runes on the bear skin.|Return to Sydney with the translation.|Seek out the Vendo captain Rathis with the hunting party in the valley.

rows.Name: Lover's Circle
rows.Description: Good day to you. I have heard stories of your travels being told at some of the tables at our local inn. I wish someone like you were around during [last winter].
rows.SourceText: Oh thank you! I will tell you what I know. The creature that robbed me kept repeating the same words over and over. It said swift as swift may be, you can catch me. I believe I was near the boundary gates but I can't be for sure. I will reward you greatly for my ring if you manage to find it. Journey well and good luck.|
rows.StepText: Search for Swift near the boundary gates.|Give the ring to Sugnhild in Huginfell.
rows.FinishText: Oh thank you so much. I am so happy. Thank you! Thank you! Oh. Oh but wait. Here, you should keep it. You've gone through so much to get it. I've learned it's not the most important thing to me at all.

rows.Name: Paranoid Guard
rows.Description: Hail. You look well. These are tense times for the guards. We have noticed more shadows in the surrounding area lately. We believe something or someone is [getting ready to attack].
rows.SourceText: This is just the proof I needed. Great job! I am going to go and give this to Bork so he can show it to the council. Thank you again for the excellent work.|
rows.StepText: Search the river in front of the blodfelag hut and get proof of spying from the water sprite Squirt.|Give Squirt's notes to Agnor Crusher.

rows.Name: Reach of the Shadow
rows.Description: Is it true you are a [protector] of Midgard?
rows.SourceText: One rainy night, a wild man came out of the lands directly behind our tent. He kept babbling about evil spectres and weird mages summoning creatures for the night. I thought he had lost his mind until the same thing happened a [few nights] later.
rows.StepText: Travel deep into the forest past the blodfelag camp and find Ulga.
rows.FinishText: I would start by looking in the forest where the travelers came from. You might find something off in that direction. Be wary my friend. We wouldn't want to have to go hunting for you as well. [Step #1] Travel deep into the forest and find Ulga. To find Ulga, from Aylarn (in front of lean-to) run west, then you'll see the tower and the camp of Bloodfellags. At the camp take the path and head a bit northwest (maybe a bit more north than west) then we saw her wandering around. *Alternate directions: Go to Audliten, go north across the bridge and take a left at the crossroad. Follow that trail a ways until you get to the top of the hill where there is another crossroad. Take a left (If you go right, you will end up at the West Gate). Follow the path until the next crossroad. There are 2 stumps, one on the south side of the path and one on the north side. If you stand next to the one on the south side and point yourself due South, go forward and you will run into a tree. Just past that tree is where I saw her each time. I hope this helps reduce some of your search time. Be careful, there are also some wolfpacks running around there too. Ulga conned blue at lvl 15 Approximate Loc sights (she does roam): 34560,21480 32525, 23114 36448, 22846 37500, 19300 34600, 22300 Kill Ulga, she conned blue to a level 15. She did attack, did not have to provoke her.

rows.Name: Brack: Rollo's Story
rows.Description: Unjust! Yes, I have been wronged! I shall not rest, nay, I [can't rest]!
rows.SourceText: Kill Ugnof Toestubber, who patrols around Huginfell with a blodfelag henchman and a wolfhound.||
rows.StepText: Kill Ugnof Toestubber, who patrols around Huginfell with a blodfelag henchman and a wolfhound.|Return to Hilde in Haggerfel.|Give the word of dwarven deeds to your trainer.

rows.Name: Protect Huginfell
rows.Description: Hail, the town needs your help. I have received word from our spies that the Blodfelag are planning to attack. We must stop them before they do. Do you think you have the strength of [character] to help us?
rows.SourceText: Ahh, good! Perhaps this may not be our darkest day afterall. The Blodfelag have a camp down the road past the Svartalf village where they plan to attack from. You must go to that camp and find their Captain, a man called [Thegn Aki]. He is an infamous killer who wil show no mercy to you or any that aid you. I suggest you gather as many men as you can before you attack his camp.
rows.StepText: Find the Blodfelag camp and slay Thegn Aki.
rows.FinishText: Go gather your forces and quit wasting time! There will be time to worry about Redhands later. May the gods have mercy on us if you fail.

rows.Name: Tomte of Doom
rows.Description: The tomtes are building a powerful artifact. Help me keep this from [happening].
rows.SourceText: Kill the Haunt in the spider section of Nisse's Lair.||||||||Choose your reward: [Vest of Audhumbla], [Sleeves of Buril], [Leggings of Borr], [Jewel of Bestla], [Gloves of Woden], [Circlet of Willi], [Boots of Weh].
rows.StepText: Kill the Haunt in the spider section of Nisse's Lair.|Kill Nisse in the large room.|Use the map, then return to Yandu: the map is not complete.|Kill Hnaki in Nisse's Lair.|Kill Skirr around the Warlord's room.|Kill Callilepis Nocturna, the boss of the spider area (stealthers may slip past).|Search the area behind Callilepis Nocturna for the artifact.|Give the artifact to Yandu for your choice of rewards ([inventory]).|Choose your reward: whisper Yandu the name of the item you want (Vest of Audhumbla, Sleeves of Buril, Leggings of Borr, Jewel of Bestla, Gloves of Woden, Circlet of Willi, Boots of Weh).

rows.Name: Waking of the Fallen
rows.Description: Well met, <Player>. Our Lady Eir has giving me [visions] that you would come. The goddess has delivered you to us.
rows.SourceText: Oh thank you! We are truly blessed today. Perhaps you will find something of value that you can use to champion the lands of Midgard. Let me see if I can remember how to [find the creature] from my visions.
rows.StepText: Kill Broch before he summons his minions, on the ridge across from the Svartalf village west of Huginfell (he walks at night).
rows.FinishText: The foul stench of the creature is enough to almost guide you there but you may find it by heading down the road and walking on the ridge across from the Svartalf village. May Thor himself smile on your journey.

rows.Name: Protecting the Healer
rows.Description: You are here just in time! I just have gotten a report that the svartalf have send [assassins] to slay Saydyn, our town healer. You must stop then before they can do that.
rows.SourceText: Hurry and protect the healer Saydyn: talk to him, and the assassins come.||
rows.TargetText: Thank the gods you were around to save me. I would shudder to think what may have happened if you were not there. Perhaps this gift may aid you in protecting other people as well.||Thank the gods you were around to save me. I would shudder to think what may have happened if you were not there. Perhaps this gift may aid you in protecting other people as well.
rows.StepText: Hurry and protect the healer Saydyn: talk to him, and the assassins come.|Kill the assassin Golga.|Talk to Saydyn and make sure he is alright.

rows.Name: Morana's Tunic
rows.Description: Greetings fellow adventurer. Would you care to hear a [tale]?
rows.SourceText: I'm glad to hear you're up for a challenge, no matter how fantastical the story is. You can find <Player> to the southwest of here, along with her kinsmen. What they are in search of, though, I do not know. Good luck adventurer!
rows.StepText: Seek out Morana to the southwest, near the hill at the base of the mountain, and return her spirit to her god.

rows.Name: The Wanestone Jewel
rows.Description: Go find Gokstad, the troll who wanders outside the gates of [Muspelheim].
rows.SourceText: Find Gokstad outside the gates of Muspelheim. He attacks when spoken to; as he dies he speaks of a jewel eaten by Haglion's minions - one is true and two are false.||
rows.StepText: Find Gokstad outside the gates of Muspelheim. He attacks when spoken to; as he dies he speaks of a jewel eaten by Haglion's minions - one is true and two are false.|Hunt Haglion's minions, large wolves southwest of Gna Faste among the mora dancers after dark, until you find the Wanestone Jewel.|Return the jewel to Singrid in Jordheim.

rows.Name: Fervent
rows.Description: One of our senior elders has declared war on the [two-leggers] and slays any who cross her path. She must be removed.
rows.SourceText: Find Wildtooth and her minions behind the blodfelag fort in West Svealand.|
rows.StepText: Find Wildtooth and her minions behind the blodfelag fort in West Svealand.|Return to the Elder Sveawolf.

rows.Name: Helping the Arachites
rows.Description: Work with Dunfjall to improve your standing with the [arachites].
rows.SourceText: Talk with Dunfjall about the arachites.||||||
rows.StepText: Talk with Dunfjall about the arachites.|Kill a shrieking willow on the southeast shore of the lake south of Askheim for an axe handle.|Kill a dark hound in Gotar at night for its tooth.|Return the items to Dunfjall.|Kill the svartalf sorceress Te'Delna west of the first guard tower in Myrkwood from Gotar.|Return her blood to Dunfjall.|Meet the arachite Thraxia by the skull post across the bone bridge near Nalliten (8 A.M. to 4 P.M.) and give her the axe.

rows.Name: Helping the Svartalfar
rows.Description: I can create a bracer for you to improve your standing with the [svartalfar].
rows.SourceText: Kill a dark hound south of Gna Faste among the mora dancers for its fur.|||||
rows.StepText: Kill a dark hound south of Gna Faste among the mora dancers for its fur.|Kill a great tingler north of Gna Faste for its silk.|Return the fur and silk to Dunfjall.|Kill the werewolf Fasolt at the tower outside Askheim (the Spirit of Fasolt rises after).|Take the werewolf blood back to Dunfjall.|Meet Terje at the skull-topped pole by the bridge south of Nalliten (4 P.M. to midnight).

rows.Name: Helping the Werewolves
rows.Description: The [werewolves] need weapons. Help me get the items to fashion a sword for them.
rows.SourceText: Seek out the dryad blossoms in Skona Ravine for skin for the hilt.||||Choose your reward: [Silver Wolfhead Bracer], [Silver Full Moon Bracelet], [Silver Wolf Cuff].
rows.StepText: Seek out the dryad blossoms in Skona Ravine for skin for the hilt.|Kill a phantom wolf in West Svealand (they appear at 10 P.M.) for its tooth for the blade.|Return the items to Dunfjall.|Find the svartalf priestess Te'Delna near the svartalf camp in Myrkwood and kill her.|Choose your reward: whisper Te'Delna the name of the item you want (Silver Wolfhead Bracer, Silver Full Moon Bracelet, Silver Wolf Cuff).

rows.Name: The Creatures of Myrkwood
rows.Description: Well, hello there. How are you enjoying Myrkwood? It's a nice place, if you can get along with the creatures that live here. Unfortunately, I can only get one group [to leave me alone] and that's the werewolves.
rows.SourceText: Excellent! I think it will really be worth your time to do what Dunfjall tell you. Now, I guess you need to know where to find him. He's been hiding out in Nalliten because he's kind of on the outs with the blodfelags right now. He's in Nalliten, hiding under the boats. When you see him, tell him that Atzar sent you and he'll be very helpful! Good luck!|
rows.TargetText: Yeah? What do you want? Oh, you know Atzar? He's a nice gu. He was having a problem with the werewolves and I helped him out. Is that why he sent you here? You have [a problem] with some of the creatures of the forest? That happens a lot around here. People get into trouble with the svartalfs and they can't get out of it without some help. I'm that help. I know all their secrets, plus those of the arachites and werewolves. Unfortunately, if I'm popular with one group, the other two groups usually hate me until I do something for them. Then the first group hates me again. It's a never-ending cycle. One day I'll figure out how to get in good with all three groups, but until then, I'll take them one at a time. Now, it's [decision time] for you. Like I said, I don't know how to become friendly with all three groups. What you do may not make you friendly, but it will help you get close to that goal. I will also warn you now, sometimes you may need a partner to help you do the things I ask. So now, you must choose which group you want to improve your standings with. Will it be the [werewolves], the [svartalfs], or the [arachites]? Choose wisely for you may not change your mind, nor may you work with me again. I cannot reveal all my secrets to you or I would lose my place with all three groups! Now, choose.|Yeah? What do you want? Oh, you know Atzar? He's a nice gu. He was having a problem with the werewolves and I helped him out. Is that why he sent you here? You have [a problem] with some of the creatures of the forest? That happens a lot around here. People get into trouble with the svartalfs and they can't get out of it without some help. I'm that help. I know all their secrets, plus those of the arachites and werewolves. Unfortunately, if I'm popular with one group, the other two groups usually hate me until I do something for them. Then the first group hates me again. It's a never-ending cycle. One day I'll figure out how to get in good with all three groups, but until then, I'll take them one at a time. Now, it's [decision time] for you. Like I said, I don't know how to become friendly with all three groups. What you do may not make you friendly, but it will help you get close to that goal. I will also warn you now, sometimes you may need a partner to help you do the things I ask. So now, you must choose which group you want to improve your standings with. Will it be the [werewolves], the [svartalfs], or the [arachites]? Choose wisely for you may not change your mind, nor may you work with me again. I cannot reveal all my secrets to you or I would lose my place with all three groups! Now, choose.
rows.StepText: Seek out Dunfjall hiding under the boats on the beach at Nalliten. Tell him [Atzar] sent you. (whisper: Atzar)|Choose which faction - werewolves, arachites or svartalfs - you would like to improve.

rows.Name: Living Warning
rows.Description: You might not like what you hear. Fridgeir used to be a guard here in Huginfel, one of the best actually. I sent him on a secret mission to spy on the [Blodfelag] and he never returned.
rows.SourceText: Good luck my friend. Whatever you do, do not let Redhands capture you. Otherwise you may find out that there are things far worse than death.
rows.StepText: Find Fridgeir, who patrols the path beyond the blodfelag fort with a warhound and a haxa, and release him from the spell.

rows.Name: Widower Hunt
rows.Description: There are oddities with the soot harvester spiders in [Muspelheim]. Please travel there and bring me their legs.
rows.TargetName: soot harvester;100|Yver Tiu;100|Darrius;100|Yver Tiu;100|blodfelag haxa;100|Yver Tiu;100|Averrius;100|Yver Tiu;100|Widower;100|Yric Tiu;100
rows.SourceText: Oh ho! You've returned! Glorious! Now, for the next task. You need to retrieve some more [parts] for me.|||||||||
rows.TargetText: |<Player> has truly outdone himself this time. I do now see the oddities of which he spoke about in his last letter. Now friend, there is [more to be done].||You continue to amaze me brave Kayje. Now, before this rite can be performed, you must take this bundle to Averrius, in Myrkwood. He is an enchanter and can open the magic within these pieces so I may properly focus on the corruption.||The package, thank you friend, thank you. Please wait while I perform this rite and cease the corruption of the Blodfelag once and for all.|Interesting, very interesting. Let me see what I can do with this. Please wait. I am finished. You may return these to Yver. He will now be able to do his rite. I hope he discovers who is behind all this.|While I though it was merely a legend, something to scare children with at night, I see now that I have been a fool. There is a spider of immense power called the [Widower] who roams the woods of Myrkwood.||So, Averrius, I should have known. You Arachite traitor! How dare you defile Midgard with your devious magic! We shall destroy you! You have done well young Kayje. I wish to reward you for your valiant attempts. I will make you a shield with the parts from his carapace. Let me imbue them with the power of Valhalla. This will only take a moment. Here you are. Use this shield well, and never forget the lessons we both learned here today.
rows.StepText: Go to Muspelheim and slay a soot harvester.|Return the bundle of harvester legs to Yver in Haggerfel.|Take the note to Darrius in Fort Atla.|Take the spinnerets to Yver.|Travel to West Svealand and kill a blodfelag haxa.|Return the charm necklace to Yver.|Take Yver's bundle to Averrius in Gna Faste near the guard tower.|Return the enchanted spider parts to Yver.|Go to Myrkwood and slay the Widower with Yric, Yver's brother, just northwest of the Spindelhalla entrance.|Speak with Yric again.
rows.FinishText: I fear Midgard is in peril friend. Quickly, travel to Myrkwood, he will meet you at the web covered tree near Spindelhalla. Quickly, you must hurry!

rows.Name: Silent Death
rows.Description: You seem to be string enough to take on a real monster. A bounty issued for a [creature] that is terrorizing the lake near Galplen. Perhaps you have heard of it?
rows.SourceText: Well you are a brave soul. The creature can be found in the darkest depths of the Myrkwood lake. Good fortune on your jouirney and I really hope to see you again, my friend.||||Choose your reward: [Njessi Carved Fang], [Njessi Bone Hammer], [Njessi Staff of Pure Thought], [Njessi Short Tooth Axe], [Njessi Crossed Short Tooth Axe], [Njessi Skull Bone Hammer], [Njessi Short Tooth Spear].
rows.TargetText: |You have returned. Amazing! Did you bring anything of Njessi back?|Greetings. Bork said you miught be coming by. I have heard tales of your travels as word spreads quickly around these parts. Please give me the skull so I can take a look at it. I have an interesting idea. I believe that a magic staff can be crafted by driving slivers of skull bone deep into hardened wood. Only Gord in Galplen could make one of those. You must journey there and meet with him. He will be able to help you.|I can make a staff that you will be able to use. The head is starting to rot though so I must start now. Would you like me to [make one] or [not]? Now these are very powerful staffs. You will be expected to uphold the traditions of all the Spiritmasters that have come before you. I will give you one of the staffs that I have already prepared. That way you din't have to wait. Here is your staff. Now I expect you to spread the word and tell others that I can create these staffs. Just be sure and tell your friends to bring one of the Njessi heads so I can craft a new staff for the next person. May Hel guide your hand in battle.|
rows.StepText: Travel to the lake between Gna Faste and Galplen and slay Njessi.|Return to Bork in Huginfell. Do not sell him the head.|Find Raker in Huginfell and see if the head can be crafted into anything.|Journey to Galplen and speak with Gord the smith, who will craft your weapon.|Choose your reward: whisper Gord the name of the item you want (Njessi Carved Fang, Njessi Bone Hammer, Njessi Staff of Pure Thought, Njessi Short Tooth Axe, Njessi Crossed Short Tooth Axe, Njessi Skull Bone Hammer, Njessi Short Tooth Spear).
rows.FinishText: I have heard that Raker, the town enchanter, has been looking for one. Perhaps he can do something with it. You should do talk with him.

rows.Name: Sugnhild's Revenge
rows.Description: Please revenge my husband. Go and kill [Redhands] for me.
rows.SourceText: Thank you. I shall pray to Tyr tonight in hopes he will watch over you. I shall be forever in debt to you my friend.|
rows.StepText: Journey to the blodfelag fort with the moat and slay Redhands in the centre room toward the back.|Return to Sugnhild.
rows.FinishText: My husband's spirit can now rest. I can never repay you enough but perhaps this may help you.

rows.Name: Trustan's Belongings
rows.Description: Greetings. My name is Trustan, and I have just moved here from near Gna Faste in Myrkwood Forest. Have you been there? It is quite a pleasant place, except for [all the fighting] that goes on there.
rows.SourceText: Thank you! I will be in your debt. When I came up here, I purchased this return ticket to Gna Faste to go back and get the rest of my things. I can't use it now, but you can. Please, take it and go give it to Prulgar the Stable Master and he will give you a horse to Gna Faste. When you get there you should find Atzar at the top of the guard tower. Speak with him and tell him I sent you. Thank you! I shall await your return.|||||||
rows.TargetText: You were? That's wonderful! You have solved one of the problems I was dealing with. I did not know how I was going to get his belongings to him. I heard about his adventure with the horse and do not wish to repeat it. I am not skilled at riding, and I fear I would break something too. But if you are here to collect his things, then I will not have to ride a horse. Now, if only I [had his belongings] to give to you! There was a disagreement between the rwo werewolves, and the one left, taking some of the others with him. They came here to Myrkwood and settled into the forest, not far from here. At first, the residents if the town, <Player>, did not know of their presence. Understand that back then, the werewolves had a human form during the day. It has only been over time that they changed and assumed the form the have today. I do not know the entire story, but I know that something bad happened and it resulted in the werewolves taking over [<Player>]. The werewolves that live there now raise their young and let them tear up the land and terrorize the people. It was those pups that attacked me and stole Trustan's favorite sword. I know Trustan would want it back, and I'd go and get it from him, but have some other things of his to find. Trustan loaned a few of this things to another friend and I must get those things back before I can send everything up to him. Please, seek out the werewolf pups that scamper behind Gna Faste and get back Trustan's sword. Please! It is good to see you back. Please give me Trustan's sword so I can make sure it is undamaged. Good, the sword was not damaged by those little fiends. Trustan will be happy, but he would be happier if I was able to return all his things. I received a note from Curka in Galplen. She's the one that Trustan loaned his shield to before he went to Huginfell. I need to get that shield back, but apparently Curka ran into some trouble with [the arachites] on her way here. The arachites are another group that like to cause trouble around here, but Curka can tell you more about them. Here, take this and grab a horse to Galplen. It's not far, but it can be dangerous getting there. Seek out Curka and tell her Atzar sent you for the shield. Once you have it come back to me, and then we'll send you up to Trustan! I see you have recovered the shield from Curka. Excellent. Hold on to it for now. I am almost ready to send Trustan's things to him, but there is one more thing [to recover]. I'm sure Curka talked about the svartlafs when you were with her. She always talks about them and how bad they get treated. Well, I can see why they get treated that way after what they did to me! While you were away, I wanted to get a peek at what the werewolves were up to. Living so close to <Player>, it's natural to want to know what's going on. While I was out in the forest I got attacked by the svartalfs! They seemed to think I [support the werewolves]. I know where these svartalfs who attacked me like to hide. Take the road south from here until you get to the rock that directs you to Galplen. Then you need to go east into the woods. They hide way back in the woods, so be careful! Just south of there you will find a full camp of the svartalfs! If they don't like you, and they may not after you get that helm back, they will attack. Oh, before you go, give me that shield so I can pack it up. Excellent! Now, hurry to find those svartalfs and get the helm back. I see you carry Trustan's helm. This is excellent. I have the rest of his things bundled up. Here, take them and a ticket to Huginfell and go take this stuff to him!||You were? That's wonderful! You have solved one of the problems I was dealing with. Worst thing that ever happened to Myrkwood were those arachites. They didn't start off the way they are, you know. A very long time ago they were spiders. But Myrkwood is a dark forest, and sometimes strange things happen. The power of Myrkwood [affected those spiders]. I had taken Trustan's shield over to Nalliten to show it to a friend of mine who wants to make his own shield. I went there and spent a few days helping my friend make his shield.
