rows.StepText: Travel to Gna Faste and speak with Atzar on top of the guard tower. Tell him you were [sent by Trustan]. (whisper: sent by Trustan)|Werewolf pups robbed Atzar of Trustan's sword. Kill one west down the path behind the tower.|Give Atzar the sword.|Go to Galplen and see Curka, the merchant by the stable man, about Trustan's shield.|Out the northeast gate, past the guard tower, southwest into the woods to the valley of arachite younglings: kill one for the shield.|Kill the svartalf who took Trustan's helm, east of the Galplen direction stone near the undead area.|Return to Atzar with the shield and helm.|Ride back to Huginfell and give the pack to Trustan.
rows.FinishText: Ah, thank you very much! Here is a fine reward for you that I made all by myself! I'm quite a craftsman, you know. I thank you for your help with my belongings. And watch out for those svartalfs, werewolves, and arachites on your travels!

rows.Name: Protecting Myrkwood
rows.Description: A staff was stolen by the [svartalfar]. The enchanter in the Gna Faste guard tower knows the rest of the tale.
rows.SourceText: See the enchanter in the Gna Faste guard tower.|||||||
rows.StepText: See the enchanter in the Gna Faste guard tower.|Kill the Tomb Priestess in the back left corner of her room in the Cursed Tomb (east of the skull pole past the bone bridge near Nalliten).|Take the top half of the staff to the enchanter in Gna Faste.|Go to the Vendo Caverns near Fort Veldon and kill Grjotgard in the second room.|Return the second half to the enchanter.|In Muspelheim, kill Haeng.|Use Haeng's scroll.|Return to Serilyna in Galplen for your reward.

rows.Name: Sulphine's Demise
rows.Description: Kill Sulphine, a named sulphur crab in [Muspelheim].
rows.SourceText: Find Sulphine at the lava lake in the north of Muspelheim.|
rows.StepText: Find Sulphine at the lava lake in the north of Muspelheim.|Return to Arnkatla in Haggerfel.

rows.Name: Bowyer's Draw
rows.Description: I can make you a good bow, but I need some [materials].
rows.SourceText: Get steel strand arachite silk from a great tingler near Gna Faste.||||
rows.StepText: Get steel strand arachite silk from a great tingler near Gna Faste.|Get a perfect willow branch from a weeping willow near Gna Faste.|Bring them back to Hakon in Huginfell.|Get a digestive sac from a Muspelheim fire ant in the northwest corner of West Svealand, up the hill near the snow.|Return to Hakon.

rows.Name: Foolish Dancers
rows.Description: Bring me what I need from [Muspelheim] and I can forge you a maul.
rows.SourceText: Kill a soot harvester at the entrance to Muspelheim.|||
rows.StepText: Kill a soot harvester at the entrance to Muspelheim.|Kill a fire flower past the first pass.|Return to Cornelis the smith in Fort Veldon.|Kill the ashen spirit Olash at the large lava pit along the north wall of Muspelheim (11 P.M. to 6 A.M.).

rows.Name: Helping the Weaponsmith
rows.Description: [Collect] some items for me and take them, with my note, to Cadbg in Hagall.
rows.TargetName: chilly skelett;151|skalklan shellcrafter;151|morvalt landflyke;151|Cadbg;151|Yrling;151|Styr;151|Shale Golem Emissary;151|Ghirni;151|Shale Golem Emissary;151|Yrling;151|Yrling;151
rows.SourceText: Get a chilly skelett bone around Bjarken.||||||||||Choose your reward: [Obsidian War Hammer], [Obsidian Bastard Sword], [Obsidian Long Spear], [Obsidian Staff], [Obsidian Great Spiked Hammer], [Obsidian Great Sword], [Double Bladed Obsidian Axe], [Obsidian Longsword], [Cursed Obsidian Staff].
rows.StepText: Get a chilly skelett bone around Bjarken.|Get skalklan blood from the skalklan camps straight out from Aegirhamn.|Get morvalt landflyke hair around Bjarken.|Take the note and the three items to Cadbg in Hagall.|Return the potion to Yrling in Aegirhamn.|Yrling's swords are missing; speak with Styer.|Return to Yrling; a shale golem emissary appears. Speak with it.|Find the morvalt renegade Ghirni off the road toward the water where the coral things spawn.|Give the emissary Ghirni's head.|Give Yrling the sword and choose a weapon.|Choose your reward: whisper Yrling the name of the item you want (Obsidian War Hammer, Obsidian Bastard Sword, Obsidian Long Spear, Obsidian Staff, Obsidian Great Spiked Hammer, Obsidian Great Sword, Double Bladed Obsidian Axe, Obsidian Longsword, Cursed Obsidian Staff).

rows.Name: Stripe
rows.Description: Yes, you look the [sturdy sort].
rows.SourceText: Halla is new here in town, and not really sure what the item is, but you can find Stripe in the Skona Ravine. Good luck in your travels!
rows.StepText: Go to Skona Ravine near the entrance to Malmohus and find Stripe.

rows.Name: Family Business
rows.Description: Hi there, have you ever heard of the Svartalfs? They're terrible! They are callous, cold-blooded killers, and I think my brother is [working for them]!
rows.SourceText: Thank you so much! You have no idea what this means to me. Piercer has been living in West Svealand, above and north of the main Svartalf camp. Be careful and stay far away from them, they don't [trust] anyone and will often attack.|||||||
rows.TargetText: What are you doing here, spying? Give me one good reason I shouldn't just kill you right now. So! You know my real name, do you? Keep your voice down, there are unfriendly ears nearby. My brother Thrand must have told you. I don't blame him for worrying, I'm in real trouble this time. I got involved with these treacherous Svartalfar and now they want me to [kill someone]. Shhhh! Not so loud. Yes, murder. You're probably not familiar with the Svartalfar, so before I ask you to help me I'll explain a little about them. The Svartalfar, the Arachites and the Varulv are all involved in a long-standing dispute over the Myrkwood area. The Svartalfar think that they were there first and that the other two groups are invading their [territory]. The three factions are constantly fighting amongst themselves, sometimes in open combat, but more often they send agents to murder key personalities and sabotage plans. The Svartalfar have become adept at sneak attacks and assassinations and are pretty unscrupulous about what they'll agree to do to increase their holdings and resources. I didn't realize they were such a bad bunch when I first got involved and now they won't let me leave. They say they're going to kill my brother Thrand if I don't do this job for them! Can you [help] me? Maybe Graesen will talk to you. I report to him, and if you tell him that I'd be a terrible assassin maybe he'll just let me leave. See the camp below? Graesen is just to the east of it. You're okay! I was so worried! Graesen came and said that he'd tricked you into working for them, then sent you into a trap! You're a true friend for risking yourself for me. Did you bring anything back with you? I've heard of Priest Thaxtix, he's the one the Svartalfar want me to assassinate. He and his priests have been performing ceremonies and sacrifices to gain enough power to launch a full attack on the Svartalfar. That's why Graesen wants him and his followers out of the picture so badly. You've got a lot more than that to worry about though. I overheard Graesen order someone to kill you if you [returned] from his trap! A Svartalfar named Rip was told to do the job. He's big, mean, and won't stop until he's done it. I think the best thing would be for you to take the initiative and go after him first. He is Southwest of here, under a tree outside the main camp. Nice work, I'm glad Rip won't be bothering us anymore. I wish I had courage like yours. Then my little brother wouldn't be in danger. Will you please [help] me take care of Priest Thaxtix? Please go and kill Priest Thaxtix for me. You might need to bring a few friends along to help because Thaxtix is usally surrounded by his lesser priests. Bring back proof that he's dead, so I can turn it in and then quit the Svatalfar. Here is some silver for you also, to reimburse some of what you've spent on travel. Taking a horse from Huginfell to Myrkwood and back can get expensive. You're back! Did you bring proof that you killed Priest Thaxtix? I don't know how to thank you, you've done so much for me and my brother. Perhaps you can get some use out of these boots. I came by them honestly, and they have some useful properties. Thanks gain for your help.|What brings you skulking around here? Lookin' for work? I've got plenty hereabouts. Good money in it for you, too. 'Course we don't want none of them types that gets cold feet, like [Piercer]. He's a new guy, and a pitiful fool that don't have no guts. Promised he'd do a job, now says he's scared. I 'spose we could call it off, but someone would need to contact our arachite agent and tell him. That ain't gonna be easy. Those arachites are fighters and he'll probably attack before he hears the message. Want to [do it]? The agent is in Myrkwood, disguised as an arachite priest (or weblasher or shadowslinker for another version). Just tell him Graesen sent you.||What are you doing here, spying? Give me one good reason I shouldn't just kill you right now. So! You know my real name, do you? Keep your voice down, there are unfriendly ears nearby. My brother Thrand must have told you. You're probably not familiar with the Svartalfar, so before I ask you to help me I'll explain a little about them. The Svartalfar think that they were there first and that the other two groups are invading their [territory]. The three factions are constantly fighting amongst themselves, sometimes in open combat, but more often they send agents to murder key personalities and sabotage plans. The Svartalfar have become adept at sneak attacks and assassinations and are pretty unscrupulous about what they'll agree to do to increase their holdings and resources. I didn't realize they were such a bad bunch when I first got involved and now they won't let me leave. They say they're going to kill my brother Thrand if I don't do this job for them! rows.StepText: Tell Piercer, on the ridge west of Huginfell overlooking the svartalf camp, that you have a message for [Halvor]. (whisper: Halvor)|Find Graesen in or around the svartalf camp and see if he will release Piercer from his svartalf obligations.|Find Graesen's agent in Myrkwood, disguised as an arachite priest, and tell him [Graesen sent me]. He will probably attack. (whisper: Graesen sent me)|Graesen tried to trick you. Tell Piercer of Graesen's trickery.|Find and kill Rip southwest of the main svartalf camp in West Svealand.|Talk to Piercer.|Kill Priest Thaxtix on the west shore of the lake north of the werewolf fort.|Return Priest Thaxtix's leg to Piercer.
rows.FinishText: Ah you're right. Piercer won't trust you either. Hmmm, let's see, I know! Tell him you have a message for Halvor. That's his real name and if you use it he'll know I sent you. Good luck, I just hope it's not too late. He's the only family I have.

rows.Name: Nimh's Secret
rows.Description: Kill Nimh, a rat in Skona [Ravine].
rows.SourceText: Search for Nimh among the wood rats along the north wall of Skona Ravine, past the werewolf skulkers.
rows.StepText: Search for Nimh among the wood rats along the north wall of Skona Ravine, past the werewolf skulkers.

rows.Name: Better Off Buried
rows.Description: You did a great job getting rid of that infamous Blodfelag camp. I hear they may be making other plans now, so be wary.
rows.SourceText: Good! The story starts many years ago when Huginfell was first being settled. Back then, the Blodfelag had not yet banded together and Redhands was still just another misguided warrior with a [few followers].|||||||
rows.TargetText: Greetings. I can tell by the look on your face that you were not able to destroy the book. Hand me the book and we shall see about sending you somewhere you can make a difference.|Hello again! I remember you. You gave me proof that the sprites were planning something. The other guards were beginning to think I had lost my mind. You look like you have done really well for yourself as well. What can I [do for you]? I knew this day would come. You are taking the book to destroy it? I hope you are strong enough not to give into the temptation that has claimed the others. I have been wearing this cursed ring since Gudlor asked me to [protect it]. I swear, I think that some of the creatures around here know I have it. The way they look at me makes me very nervous and paranoid. The ring is not even quenched and it still bothers me. I will tell you what I have learned about [the ring]. To quench the ring you must travel into Uppland, place the ring on your finger and then slay a boreal cockatrice. The ring will only be fed if you are wearing it when the creature dies. Be very careful, the ring will make you feel much weaker while wearing it. Once you have quenched its thirst, return here and I will tell you how to destroy the book. May Odin smile upon you, my friend. Good, you have returned. I was getting worried that you may have fallen to the ring's evil powers. If you do not destroy the book soon, I fear it may destroy you. To find where the book was buried, you must first go to the ridge just west of here and follow that southwest until you are over the Blodfelag's camp. Look for [a boulder] near the top of the ridge. The book was actually found there and not in Raumarik. I think that is the best place to try destroying the book. I will know you have failed if the ring appears back on my finger. If the our plan fails, just return the book to Gudlor and we shall try again. I think he was planning on sending you after that cursed crown as well. The ring can only be used to read the book near nidnight. Just stand next to the boulder and wear the ring, then read the spell from the book. Anyway, you should be off. Time is short and you do not want to have both the ring and the book on you any longer than you have to. Trust me, bad things may happen to you if you delay too long.||Hello again! I remember you. Time is short and you do not want to have both the ring and the book on you any longer than you have to. Trust me, bad things may happen to you if you delay too long.|||Thank you. At least you tried and that is what truly counts. There is another thing that remains undone. The [evil crown] of the Blodfelag still exists.|
rows.StepText: Learn the tale of the book av den dode from Gudlor in Huginfell.|Visit Agnor Crusher in the northwest corner of Huginfell and get the ring av den dode.|Journey to Uppland, wear the ring and slay a boreal cockatrice on the road from Svasud Faste.|Return to Agnor Crusher and learn how the book may be destroyed.|Find the small boulder on the ridge north of the blodfelag camp by the lake.|Wait there until midnight, wear the ring and use the book.|Return the book to Gudlor so he may protect it.|Journey to the island of fire just east of the Muspelheim entrance and slay the twisted blodfelag king Strykel.
rows.FinishText: Go now and one warning. If you are slain while wearing the crown, it may have the power to animate your corpse and slay your friends. Be forewarned, the crown is truly twisted evil. Safe journey to you, my friend.

rows.Name: Lost Maps
rows.Description: What do you want? I've got [no more maps] to steal, so you can just keep on walking before I call the guards to come get you out of here!
rows.AdvanceText: Sinna Redtoes|Modolf|||Modolf drowned and I got the map||||
rows.SourceText: Go then to Keirstyn Alfevson. She is much more reasonable person to deal with then that Karle. All he can think about is claiming land for his precious clan. Tell her Sinna Redtoes sent you and see what she has to say. I will reward you well if you can retrieve both maps.||||||||
rows.TargetText: Yes, what might I do for you? Oh dear, I feared it would come to this. I have heard that Sinna Redtoes had some maps stolen and that she thinks some of the Grenlock Clan was responsible. I'm not surprised that she sent someone here to speak with me. I'm sad to say I think [she is correct]. A few days ago I awoke to find that four members of the Clan had disappeared. At first I figured that my brother Karle had sent them into the wild lands, since their packs were gone. When I heard later that day that Sinna Redtoes had seen Grenlock Clan members around her packs, I began to wonder. I went to Karle and he denied sending the four on any kind of mission. It was then that I [remembered something]. That evening at dinner, before the four disappeared, I heard one of the men, Modolf, mention the town of Knarr in Munin Sound. I think I heard one of the missing women mention the word 'treasure' but I cannot be sure. Ever since I learned of the theft, I have been trying to track down the four without luck. I know Sinna sent you here to get the maps back. I cannot give you maps I do not have, but I can give you this. Use it to get to Knarr quickly and ask around the town to see if anyone has seen or heard of Modolf. I wish you luck.|Hail. Might I do something for you? Modolf? If you're looking for him, I'm sorry to say you won't have much luck. He's gone. I was on watch the night he came through here so I remember him. A few nights ago he came into Knarr all in a big rush, demanding I give him a boat. Well, I told him I wouldn't give him one but that I would sell him one. He argued and stomped around telling me that no one said no to Modolf, but I stood my ground. I paid good gold for that boat and wasn't going to just give it away! He finally relented and handed over a pouch of gold. I took him to [my little boat]. As he got into the boat I wondered if I had done the right thing selling him the boat. He had no clue what he was doing. Can you believe a Norseman who doesn't know how to handle a boat? I showed him how to row it properly and then he headed out northeast across the water and followed the coastline until I lost sight of him. I figured that was the last I'd see of him or my little boat but [I was wrong]. I wasn't on watch the next night, so I decided to do a little hunting before sunset. I went up the coast past the Shalklan camp and what did I find on shore? Modolf's pack, soaked with water and my little boat, upside down, with a big hole in it! I know I had sold the boat, but I was still upset. I began to drag the boat back to here when I realized that I hadn't seen Modolf anywhere, just his pack. I went back and search for him but I couldn?t find him anywhere. But that time the sun had set and that is [not a good time] to be far from home. Many people have drowned out in that part of the land. I think the mist menaces that roam around there confuse people and they end up capsizing their boats. At night the spirits of those drowning victims come out and haunt the land. If Modolf did drown, that's where you'll find his spirit. That's all the help I can give you. I wish you luck in finding him.|||Yes, what might I? where did you get that map you carry? I know that map! It is not yours and I know because I helped to steal it? I know where it came from. How did you come to have it? Did you steal it like a thief in the night? Tell me! I knew something like this would happen. It was such a bad idea to steal those maps. Yes, we stole them! I knew it was wrong but Modolf, Loden, and Idette convinced me to go along with them. I tried to talk Modolf into letting me go with him to Knarr and helping with the boat, but he insisted he could handle it himself. He sent me here to wait while he, Idette, and Loden all went off in search of the treasure. I think we will all [pay the price] for stealing from the dwarves. Then you must find Loden and Idette. I would go seek them myself, but I still have a shred of hope that they will return here. If they do I will get the maps from them and hold them until your return. The people here say they saw Loden and Idette heading kind of east from here, through a valley and then they turned north. How far they got, I don't know, but that's where you should start searching. I'm sure they won't give up the map halves easily, so be careful. You may even want to take some friends with you. Come back to me when you have both halves and I will reassemble the map for you. You have just confirmed my fears. Loden and Idette died in the avalanche, didn't they? It saddens me to hear that. When I have the courage I will return to the Clan and let them know of my wrongdoing and the deaths of the other clan members. But for now, give me a piece of the map so that I can put it back together and begin to make it up to the dwarves of Longbeard's group. Now the other piece please. There it is done. Please return this map to Sinna Redtoes, for we should have never stolen it from her. I will come in time to make my apologies to her and accept any punishment she may have for me. Please, take this to help you get back to her quickly. The quicker the maps are returned to her, the sooner I can begin to face what lies ahead of me. Go now and be well.|||Yes, what might I? where did you get that map you carry? I know that map! It is not yours and I know because I helped to steal it? I know where it came from. rows.StepText: Seek out Keirstyn Alfevson and tell her [Sinna Redtoes] sent you. (whisper: Sinna Redtoes)|Travel to Knarr and ask Heikki, by the stablemaster, about [Modolf]. (whisper: Modolf)|Past the shalklan settlement where the mist menaces roam, the drowned walk at night. Find Modolf's spirit inland from the shore and take the map.|Read the writing on the back of the map.|Travel to Bjarken and tell Merja that [Modolf drowned and I got the map]. (whisper: Modolf drowned and I got the map)|Retrieve Idette's half of the map.|Retrieve Loden's half of the map.|Return to Merja with both halves.|Return to Sinna Redtoes in Aegirhamn with the maps.
rows.FinishText: Here is your Potent Amethyst gem. I shall sing your praises tonight as I raise a horn of ale with Longbeard. May the House of Eir always watch over you.

rows.Name: Furf's Reward
rows.Description: Greetings friend. It's nice to see other adventurers roaming about these parts. I, too, used to [adventure].
rows.SourceText: To this day I wish we had been able to get back to Skone to teach that cat a lesson. If you're up for some excitement, you should go to Skona and find Furf. I'm sure he'll prove quite a challenge.
rows.StepText: Look for Furf on the raised sand bar in the centre of Skona Ravine near the werewolves' main camp and slay him.

rows.Name: Ota's Quest
rows.Description: Did you get the pelt [Agrisi]?
rows.TargetName: bergklan pelterer;151|Ota Yrling;151|griffon loner;151|hrimthursa brute;151|griffon loner;151|Ota Yrling;151
rows.SourceText: Ah, well, let me take a look at it. Oh this will do. It is a simple, primitive style. It will certainly stand out amongst the crowd. Oh! Especially when it's made of griffon fur! I can't wait! Alright, now, go find a griffon. You can find some griffon loners in the Gripklosa Mountains. That's the griffon pelt I want. When you kill the griffon, take the pelt to the pelterer. When the pelterer is finished, bring it to me, and I will reward you. Here, take part of the reward now, as a sign of good faith.|||||
rows.StepText: Bring the bag of trade items to a bergklan pelterer in the Gripklosa Mountains.|Return the pelt to Ota.|Hunt the Gripklosa Mountains for a griffon loner (SSE of Bjarken by the mylings). If the griffon inquires, speak of [Ota], then [bargain]. (either answer works here: bargain) (whisper: Ota)|Find a hrimthursa brute in the northwest of Delling Crater and kill it.|Take the giant nose back to the griffon loner.|Tell Ota the [griffon has many more] and give her the kobold skin.
rows.FinishText: You are insufferable! Reward? You wish a reward? For this betrayal? How dare you! I will have my griffon pelt! I will! As for you! Out of my sight!

rows.Name: Tale of Two Trolls
rows.Description: Greetings friend. Have you heard the news? My wife is due very soon. I am so happy. I am hoping for a wonderful baby girl but I will be happy with just a healthy baby. I have had to give up my studies and [stay home] to watch over my wife.
rows.TargetName: Aki;100|woodland badger;100|Aki;100|giant tree frog;100|Kedin;100|Alina;100|Noble Werewolf Alina;100|Baron Falwur;100
rows.SourceText: I guess they were friends until they bought my book. I saw them get angry and they started fighting. They almost crushed me by accident as they [rolled around] the floor. Finally, they tore my poor book in half.|||||||
rows.StepText: Journey to Galplen and seek out Aki, the troll merchant, for the first half of the book.|Aki will trade his half for a perfect badger pelt from a woodland badger in Skona Ravine.|Give Aki the pelt.|Kedin, the troll merchant in Gna Faste, wants oil from a giant tree frog near the standing stones in Skona Ravine.|Give Kedin the oil.|Give the halves to the mysterious woman Alina on the shore east of Askheim.|Confront Alina after sunset, when she wanders as a werewolf.|Kill Baron Falwur in the werewolf fort of Askheim and take the crown.
rows.FinishText: The crown sounds like it could be a worthy prize for someone strong enough to go get it. If I were you, I would go to the stables and get a horse. You can reach Galplen much faster if you ride. Aki should be selling his wares somewhere around town. Talk to him about it.

rows.TargetName: Aki;100|woodland badger;100|Aki;100|giant tree frog;100|Kedin;100|Alina;100|Noble Werewolf Alina;100|Baron Falwur;100
rows.SourceText: I guess they were friends until they bought my book. I saw them get angry and they started fighting. They almost crushed me by accident as they [rolled around] the floor. Finally, they tore my poor book in half.|||||||
rows.StepText: Journey to Galplen and seek out Aki, the troll merchant, for the first half of the book.|Aki will trade his half for a perfect badger pelt from a woodland badger in Skona Ravine.|Give Aki the pelt.|Kedin, the troll merchant in Gna Faste, wants oil from a giant tree frog near the standing stones in Skona Ravine.|Give Kedin the oil.|Give the halves to the mysterious woman Alina on the shore east of Askheim.|Confront Alina after sunset, when she wanders as a werewolf.|Kill Baron Falwur in the werewolf fort of Askheim and take the crown.
rows.FinishText: The crown sounds like it could be a worthy prize for someone strong enough to go get it. If I were you, I would go to the stables and get a horse. You can reach Galplen much faster if you ride. Aki should be selling his wares somewhere around town. Talk to him about it.

rows.Name: Young Fire Wyrm Lord
rows.Description: Ah greetings fellow Adventurer! I am Bolli, former Skald now retired. Have you time for a [tale] of love, adventure and loss?
rows.SourceText: Aye. I tried to use my traveling sone, but the rest of my group couldn't keep up. He [slaughtered] them, along with my beloved Gunnhildr.
rows.StepText: Go to Muspelheim, follow the wall left around to the wyrms, and destroy the young wyrm lord.
rows.FinishText: I don't know you too well, traveler, but if you're brave of heart and stout of spirit, then perhaps you'd like to visit the creature and slay him. I wish you luck on your journeys, friend. Be wary of the evils in Muspelheim.

rows.Name: Krrrck's Torment
rows.Description: Ah, you startled me! Are you here because of [Krrrck]?
rows.SourceText: You can find Krrrck living in Skona Ravine along with the other wild creatures. It is said the sadness that penetrates his heart will never be eased until he returns to his goddess and is avenged. Find him and release his soul. He has recently been seen to the west and south of the circle of stones in Skona Ravine.
rows.StepText: Seek out Krrrck south and west of the circle of stones in Skona Ravine, slay him and release his soul.

rows.Name: Juuso's Potion
rows.Description: Please tell me that you are here to help me! I have gotten myself in a bind and I'm not sure how to get out of it alone. If only I hadn't agreed to help [that crazy woman] I wouldn't be in this situation, but she scares me!
rows.SourceText: Do you have the fluid from Edrigu? Catla has been by three times asking for the potion! I fear if she has too wait to long Bogdar will not be able to save me. I gave my promise that I would deliver the potion. Now please, give me the fluid.|||||||
rows.TargetText: ||You wear an amulet I know. Who sent you to me? Juuso. He wishes to make the potion again? I wish he would not do that. It is not good for him. Too much power makes goo people bad. I see it many times. I will give you what Juuso needs. I know I cannot change Juuso?s mind, but I ask you not to drink the potoin he makes. It is bad and you seem good. Take it and go from here. No good will come from this potion. I know it!|This helps a great deal, but we are not done yet! All will be well when you get the rest of the ingredients! This fluid is only one part of the potion. You must now travel to Gripklosa Mountains and see out [three creatures] that dwell there.||||
rows.StepText: Obtain a wiggly tentacle from an ingester on the northern end of the island east of Knarr.|Use the amulet to complete it, then put it on. Do not attack any skalklan while wearing it.|Wearing the amulet, tell the skalklan Edrigu that [Juuso sent] you for the ingredient. (whisper: Juuso sent)|Give Juuso the skin of fluid.|Hunt a woolly mammoth east of Bjarken for its fur.|Fill a vial with the blood of a morvalt streber.|Fill the other vial with the blood of a morvalt vandarare.|Return to Juuso in Dyrfjall to complete the potion.
rows.FinishText: Take these vials and return them filled with the blood of the Morvalt vandarare and the Morvalt streber. Their blood, when mixed with the fluid from Edrigu and the fur, is what allows the communication with the mother. It will not work for Catla but she must learn that for herself. She will not listen to reason! Once you have filled both vials return to me so that I may complete the potion and save us both from Catla's wrath!

rows.Name: Lord Lauur's Wife
rows.Description: Lord Lauur is upset: his wife's spirit is held by the [svartalfar] and the arachites. Go talk to him (he walks only between midnight and 8 A.M.).
rows.SourceText: Talk to Lord Lauur.||||||
rows.StepText: Talk to Lord Lauur.|Talk to Hyua, the troll hiding behind a tree behind the Gna Faste merchants; she tries to kill you. Kill her instead.|Read the diary to learn where Lene's spirit is held.|Kill Te'Bui in Spindelhalla for the white spirit crystal.|Use the crystal to find the next one.|Kill an arachite tunnelhost for the black crystal.|Take both crystals to Lord Lauur so he can restore his wife's spirit.

rows.Name: Thraxia's Dilemma
rows.Description: Thraxia needs help: one of her priests is held [captive]. Go talk to her.
rows.SourceText: Talk to Thraxia by the skull post (8 A.M. to 4 P.M.).||||||
rows.StepText: Talk to Thraxia by the skull post (8 A.M. to 4 P.M.).|Find out where the priest is held: search the huts in Skona Ravine for a parchment.|Read the parchment.|Kill the svartalf Te'Bui in Spindelhalla, who possesses the spirit.|Use the totem to release the spirit.|Kill Thelod in Varulvhamn to free the priest.|Return to Thraxia.

rows.Name: Zrit-Zrit's Item
rows.Description: Kill Zrit-Zrit, a [timberland] badger in Skona Ravine, and find the item of the warrior it devoured.
rows.SourceText: Kill Zrit-Zrit northeast of the Sidhe Draoi camp in Skona Ravine.
rows.StepText: Kill Zrit-Zrit northeast of the Sidhe Draoi camp in Skona Ravine.

rows.Name: Mother's Children
rows.Description: Kill three skadedjur and bring back their remains, then [investigate] the strange sjoalfs to the north.
rows.SourceText: Kill three skadedjur. (1/3)|||||
rows.StepText: Kill three skadedjur. (1/3)|Kill three skadedjur. (2/3)|Kill three skadedjur. (3/3)|Bring the remains back to Shiake.|Investigate the strange sjoalfs north of Shiake.|Return to Shiake.

rows.Name: Black Plague
rows.Description: A sickness spreads. Speak with Arve the [enchanter] in the round hut by the Mularn entrance.
rows.SourceText: Go see Arve, the enchanter in the round hut by the Mularn entrance.|||||||
rows.StepText: Go see Arve, the enchanter in the round hut by the Mularn entrance.|Talk to Ottar, the merchant next to Arve.|Give the letter to Thora in the building left of the Huginfell inn.|Return to Ottar and hand him Thora's letter.|Speak with Arve again.|Go back to Nanna.|Kill Lecherous Gress above the Rocot rooms in Darkness Falls.|Take the stoppered wondrous potion back to Nanna.

rows.Name: Morvalt Crystal
rows.Description: Retrieve the Morvalt crystal. Find Kreg, a bergklan concoctor in the Gripklosa [Mountains], and get his map.
rows.SourceText: Find Kreg, a bergklan concoctor, and ask him for the [map]. (whisper: map)||||||Choose your reward: [Fur Brushed Chain Legs], [Mammoth Lined Leggings], [Mammoth Hide Pants], [Studded Mammoth Pants].
rows.StepText: Find Kreg, a bergklan concoctor, and ask him for the [map]. (whisper: map)|Follow the map to the morvalt camp and kill the morvalts there to learn the words. (1/3)|Follow the map to the morvalt camp and kill the morvalts there to learn the words. (2/3)|Follow the map to the morvalt camp and kill the morvalts there to learn the words. (3/3)|Run up to the fire by the crystal bearer and say the words [Rosa Er Kraft]. (whisper: Rosa Er Kraft)|Return the crystal to Kekov in Hagall.|Choose your reward: whisper Kekov the name of the item you want (Fur Brushed Chain Legs, Mammoth Lined Leggings, Mammoth Hide Pants, Studded Mammoth Pants).

rows.Name: Gazsi's Nightmares

rows.Name: Werewolf Bane

rows.Name: Gem of the Dwarven King

rows.SourceText: Find Ornulf by a rock just outside Dellingstad.||||||||Choose your reward: [Nattbrann], [Himmelbrann], [Gronnbrann], [Hvitbrann], [Glodende Brann], [Solbrann], [Hassafran].

rows.StepText: Speak with Londar at the top of the tower across the road from Haggerfel.|Seek the fire giants in Muspelheim and learn what you can from them.|Tell Londar of the [dream]. (whisper: dream)|Kill svards in the small house at the blodfelag fort for a worn journal.|Read the journal.|Kill werewolf guards outside Varulvhamn by the west Skona stables for a dwarf skin scroll.|Read the scroll.|Tell Londar the fragment is in [Raumarik]. (whisper: Raumarik)|Find Gris in the smithy behind the tavern by the north gate of Jordheim and tell him [Londar] sent you. (whisper: have the casket)|Talk to Drav by the tavern entrance in Galplen.|Kill the Raumarik Revenant in the undead fortress in Raumarik.|Return to Drav.

rows.Name: Breaking the Blade
rows.Description: Prince [Abdin's] plans must be broken.
rows.SourceText: Kill Director Kobil.||||||Choose your reward: [Mithothyn's Crown of Song], [Mithothyn's Crown of Piety], [Mithothyn's Crown of Rage], [Mithothyn's Crown of Might].|Choose your reward: [Vigdis's Protector], [Vigdis's Singing Protector], [Vigdis's Heroic Protector].
rows.StepText: Kill Director Kobil.|Return to Mystemas.|Kill Prince Abdin.|Return to Mystemas for a belt.|Mystemas sends you to kill Legion.|Return to Mystemas for another reward.|Choose your reward: whisper Mystemas the name of the item you want (Mithothyn's Crown of Song, Mithothyn's Crown of Piety, Mithothyn's Crown of Rage, Mithothyn's Crown of Might).|Choose your reward: whisper Mystemas the name of the item you want (Vigdis's Protector, Vigdis's Singing Protector, Vigdis's Heroic Protector).

rows.Name: Balle's Potion
rows.Description: Sub-quest of Dark Places of the Soul: gather the [ingredients] for my brew.
rows.SourceText: Find the green orms in Skona Ravine and kill one for its bile.|||
rows.StepText: Find the green orms in Skona Ravine and kill one for its bile.|Find the forest vipers in Vanern Swamp and kill one for venom.|Find the large enslaved orms and kill one for a teardrop.|Give Balle the list, the bile, the venom and the teardrop, in that order.

rows.Name: Strange Powers
rows.Description: [Sub-quest] of Dark Places of the Soul.
rows.SourceText: Find Goi Halfdan upstairs in the house behind the stone wall in Mularn and hand her the sack.|||||
rows.StepText: Find Goi Halfdan upstairs in the house behind the stone wall in Mularn and hand her the sack.|Speak with Garon in the first house southwest of the Audliten drop-off.|Seek out Eresidae on a ridge southeast of Dun Crauchon in Emain Macha.|Hand Garon Eresidae's carcass.|Give Goi Goran's antidote.|Hand Yver Tiu the enchanter antidote.

rows.Name: Dark Places of the Soul
rows.Description: [Something] stirs in the dark places of the soul. Find Jytal in Gna Faste and say my name.
rows.TargetName: Jytal;100||Jytal;100|Gunflor;100|Jytal;100|Idona Tiu;100||Idona Tiu;100|Blackpaw;101|Idona Tiu;100|Goi Halfdan;100|Besje;100|Alfgeirr;101||Alfgeirr;101|Besje;100|Goi Halfdan;100||Grumblebelly;100|Idona Tiu;100|Yver Tiu;100
rows.AdvanceText: Idona||defeated|||||Yver is cured||The Werewolves have allied||stone bowl|magical bowl||||||Dark magic|Errick lives|
rows.SourceText: Find Jytal in the Gna Faste hut and say [Idona]. (whisper: Idona)||||||||||||||||||||
rows.StepText: Find Jytal in the Gna Faste hut and say [Idona]. (whisper: Idona)|Ride to west Skona, head east, and watch the arachites go into the building with the werewolves.|Tell Jytal whether the arachites were [defeated] or [victorious]. (either answer works here: defeated) (whisper: defeated)|Kill the svartalf Gunflor in the building on the little island with the well east of Gna Faste.|Hand Gunflor's head to Jytal.|Talk with Idona in Fort Veldon again.|Go to Haggerfel and complete Yver Tiu's Strange Powers.|Tell Idona [Yver is cured]. (whisper: Yver is cured)|Find Blackpaw in the northeast corner of Jordheim.|Tell Idona [the werewolves have allied]. (whisper: The Werewolves have allied)|Speak with Goi in Mularn.|Tell Besje in Huginfell [stone bowl]. (whisper: stone bowl)|Ask Alfgeirr by the Jordheim forge about the [magical bowl]. (whisper: magical bowl)|Find the cold stone between the stones northeast of Glenlock Faste.|Take the stone back to Alfgeirr.|Take the bowl to Besje in Huginfell.|Take the bowl to Goi in Mularn.|Find Balle in Uppland and brew his potion.|Find Grumblebelly around Galplen and say [dark magic] to make Errick appear. (whisper: Dark magic)|Return to Idona and say [Errick lives]. (whisper: Errick lives)|Find Yver in Skona Ravine.

rows.Name: Catla's Downfall
rows.Description: I have come to help stop Catla [Gardasdottir's] mad plans.
rows.SourceText: Travel to Aegirhamn and talk to Catla.|||||||Choose your reward: [Avboyning Bracer], [Skjold Bracelet].
rows.StepText: Travel to Aegirhamn and talk to Catla.|Read Catla's note.|Get a large spore from a cadby in Iarnvidiur's Lair.|Obtain some hairs from the head of a redcap davin.|Take the items to Juuso in Dyrfjell.|Seek out Catla's spirit on the westernmost of three large boulders outside Dyrfjell and give her the potion.|Give Medana the stone and choose two bracers.|Choose your reward: whisper Medana the name of the item you want (Avboyning Bracer, Skjold Bracelet).

rows.Name: Final Rest
rows.Description: The dead of this land find no rest. [Kill] what I ask.
rows.SourceText: Kill a spectral snake.||||
rows.StepText: Kill a spectral snake.|Kill a spectral feline.|Kill a corrupted howler.|Kill the morvalt Basilus in the camp in the northeast corner (he brings friends).|Return to Shiake for your reward.

rows.Name: Stoneheart
rows.Description: A rejected dwarf's tale leads to the depths of Trollheim and the ancient [Stoneheart].
rows.SourceText: Find Damekia in the Gripklosa Mountains (daytime).|||||||Choose your reward: [Troll's Fist Great Hammer], [Stoneheart staff/axe/hammer/sword/hand-to-hand, 1h or 2h].
rows.StepText: Find Damekia in the Gripklosa Mountains (daytime).|Kill a lone saber-toothed cat east of Dellingstad.|Kill a redcap herbalist at Iss on the north wall of the Gripklosa Mountains.|Return to Damekia; she gives you the runed cloak of the trolls. Wear it for the rest of the quest.|Fight your way into Trollheim, up the undead morvalt valley, across the bridge room to the spiral ramp, and find Darac.|Kill Dagar (two groups advised).|Return to Jago in Dyrfjell and choose your weapon.|Choose your reward: whisper Jago the name of the item you want (Troll's Fist Great Hammer, Stoneheart staff/axe/hammer/sword/hand-to-hand, 1h or 2h).

rows.Name: Morvalt Streber Scalps -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Hello there. What in the wide wide world of Midgard are you doing here? This place is dangerous friend. Nasty dangerous! We've got more foes than Albion has rats. hehe! Well, since you're here, maybe you'd like to [do some good].
rows.SourceText: Well, you made it back, and with a scalp no less. Interesting. Alright, well, if you're still brave, go get somemore scalps.
rows.StepText: Kill morvalt streber and bring Topi the Morvalt Streber Scalp.

rows.Name: Ice Water -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Hello. I could really use your [assistance].
rows.SourceText: Kill snow giant and bring Maerta the Ice Water.
rows.StepText: Kill snow giant and bring Maerta the Ice Water.

rows.Name: Yellowed Skeleton Bones -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Good day to you Agrissi. I am in need of some [assistance] if you could help.
rows.SourceText: Ah, some bones, thank you friend. If you happen to get anymore, I would gladly take them from you.
rows.StepText: Kill yellowed skeleton and bring Anakoll the Sack of Bones. Yellowed skeletons on the ridge directly east of Dellingstad.

rows.Name: Woolly Mammoth Hides -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Oh, you new to our tribe aren't you? Yes, yes you are. I was told to five you tasks. So I have good task for you to do. [Listen] closely.
rows.SourceText: Kill woolly mammoth and bring Torlieva the Woolly Mammoth Hide. Torlieva stands in a skalklan camp.
rows.StepText: Kill woolly mammoth and bring Torlieva the Woolly Mammoth Hide. Torlieva stands in a skalklan camp.

rows.Name: Redcap Red Cap -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Hello there Shaman. MightI interest you in a bit of [information] this day?
rows.SourceText: Kill redcap skulker and bring Frakki the Redcap Red Cap.
rows.StepText: Kill redcap skulker and bring Frakki the Redcap Red Cap.

rows.Name: Cave Lioness Sinew -- Kill Task
rows.Description: Oh, you new to our tribe, aren't you? Yes, yes you are. I was told to give you tasks. So I have good task for you to do. [Listen] closely.
rows.SourceText: Kill cave lioness and bring Rith the Cave Lioness Sinew.
rows.StepText: Kill cave lioness and bring Rith the Cave Lioness Sinew.
